Title: Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x) in the field of AI & Satellite Data
Description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

LiveEO uses satellite data and AI to monitor critical infrastructure at scale. As a Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x), you’ll sit at the heart of our operations, working with geospatial and satellite data to make sure our analytics projects are delivered reliably, accurately, and on time.

You’ll work closely with Project Managers, our Operations Support Studio, engineers, and product teams - investigating data, understanding our analytics pipelines, solving delivery issues, and helping us continuously improve how our technology performs in real-world use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure.

This role is a maternity leave cover and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 1 year.

Your challenge


Analyze, validate, and interpret geospatial and satellite data across global customer projects
Take ownership of analytics deliveries and help ensure high technical quality and reliability
Understand and adapt to different analytics use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure
Investigate data and pipeline issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to engineering teams
Work closely with engineers, Project Managers, and the Operations Support Studio to resolve issues and keep deliveries moving
Develop a strong end-to-end understanding of our analytics pipelines and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality
Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams when you identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement
Use AI coding and analysis tools such as Claude or Cursor for data validation, pipeline debugging, and analysis - while critically validating their output before acting on it
Work with tools and technologies including QGIS, Python, SQL, AWS, remote sensing tools, and large-scale geospatial datasets


Your profile


A degree in geoinformatics, remote sensing, geography, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or another quantitative/technical field
Hands-on experience working with geospatial data and GIS tools, ideally QGIS
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex data or technical issues in a structured way
A high level of ownership and self-management - you ask questions, seek clarity, and proactively move problems toward resolution
Comfortable using AI coding and analysis tools as part of your daily work, while applying your own judgement to verify results
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and customer requirements can change
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
A collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
You live in Berlin or are willing to relocate


Nice to have:


Experience with Python and SQL
Remote sensing / Earth Observation experience
Experience with geodatabases and large-scale data management
AWS or other cloud infrastructure experience
Machine learning or deep learning knowledge
Software engineering experience
Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect


Your Benefits


The opportunity to work with satellite and geospatial data on real-world infrastructure challenges across the globe and contribute directly to how LiveEO delivers its analytics products.
We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.
Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.
A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons, with the opportunity to learn across geospatial analytics, AI and satellite technology.
Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.
Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.
Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, Jobrad, corporate pension program.
A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities.


About Us

LiveEO is a well funded startup founded in 2018 and based in Berlin. Our primary service is modelling risk to our customers’ assets and infrastructure from vegetation, ground deformation and change detection. We currently have around 160 employees from all over the world with a variety of backgrounds

Das KI-Labor bündelt KI-Expertise und KI-Talente in einer zentralen Einheit in der Stabsstelle Digitalstrategie und digitale Transformation. Als Expertenteam für KI und Anwendungsfall-Fabrik bringen wir KI in die DRV Bund und stehen allen Fachabteilungen als Ansprechpartner*in mit unserem Unterstützungs- und Beratungsangebot zur Seite. Unterstützen bei der Entwicklung und Implementierung komplexer Data Science-Anwendungen im Bereich des maschinellen Lernens und im Kontext GenAI
Konsolidieren und Aufbereiten von Datensätzen aus verschiedenen Quellen
Visualisieren und Analyse großer Datenmengen, zum Beispiel zur Detektion von Mustern, Bias oder Daten-Drifts
Entwickeln von aussagekräftigen Visualisierungen und Dashboards zur Kommunikation

Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen, um Daten- und Analyseanforderungen zu verstehen

Ausgezeichnete analytische und Problemlösungs-Fähigkeiten, Sie teilen gerne ihre Erkenntnisse mit anderen Teammitgliedern und entwickeln diese zusammen weiter
Begeisterung für die Bereiche Data Analytics, Künstliche Intelligenz / Artifical Intelligence und Geschäftsprozessautomatisierung, insbesondere im Kontext des öffentlichen Sektors (GovTech)
Ihr Profil wird abgerundet durch einen ausgeprägten Teamgeist und eine kundenorientierte und agile Arbeitsweise

Fort- und Weiterbildungs-möglichkeiten

Title: Senior Product Analyst
Description:
Team description

The Central Product Analytics team sits at the heart of how SumUp understands and improves the experience of millions of merchants using our products every day. This role owns the Engagement domain — covering merchant engagement, product activation, support responses, and navigation across the SuperApp and web dashboard — and is the primary analytics partner for the Engagement product team. It's a genuine opportunity to take full ownership of a domain, build the measurement foundations from the ground up, and shift the team from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-led decision-making.

What you'll do


Define event taxonomies and measurement plans, implement and QA tracking (GA4), and make sure analytics is built into new product features from day one
Build and maintain scalable datasets in Snowflake — including funnels, customer behaviour models, and feature adoption metrics — and use them to generate insights that directly inform product decisions
Design and evaluate A/B tests: define success metrics, assess statistical validity, and communicate results clearly to product and engineering stakeholders
Create and maintain intuitive dashboards and reusable query templates in Tableau that help teams answer their own questions without always needing an analyst
Partner with product managers to develop and map out KPI trees, identify measurement gaps, and improve the quality and accuracy of engagement tracking across the domain


You'll be great for this role if…


Proven experience as a Data or Product Analyst, with a strong track record of working with customer behaviour data and translating it into product decisions.
Advanced proficiency in SQL, including writing, optimising, and validating queries, building data models, and participating in code reviews.
Strong knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI, and experience with data warehousing platforms like Snowflake, Postgres, or Redshift.
Comfortable designing and analysing end-to-end experiments, including A/B tests and feature flag rollouts, with a solid understanding of statistical validity.
Ability to communicate complex data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with strong written and verbal English skills.


Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🏋️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Title: Principal Product Analyst (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

Data is a critical pillar of our product development process, and the Product Analytics team serves as the chief advocate for its quality, consistency, and strategic usage.

We are seeking a data-driven and user-centric professional to drive the strategy, evaluation, and optimization of our digital products. In this role, you will define how we value user interactions, measure success, and tie product features directly to overarching business outcomes.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Drive the implementation and evolution of a standardized cross-organizational product performance measurement framework, eliminating metric fragmentation by establishing consistent core KPIs (such as Weekly Active Users, Conversion Rate, and the Overall Evaluation Criterion) across all business units.
Own the technical architecture and attribution models for user value scoring, developing complex data structures to quantify and weigh both upper-funnel engagement actions (e.g., browsing, saving, content interaction) and lower-funnel transactional behaviors.
Advance the content flywheel into a measurable insight engine that definitively proves how content experiences translate into long-term financial, visit frequency, and business value.
Lead the engineering of advanced data solutions and complex analytics pipelines, including session-level tracking, cross-premise identity stitching, and methodologies to mitigate the "Winner’s Curse" in product experiments.
Design, align, and analyze rigorous high-stakes experimentation, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments designed to drive sustainable growth across diverse business models.
Democratize insights and act as a strategic advisor to Senior Leadership Team, Product Managers and Applied Scientists.


WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


You have 7+ years of experience in product analytics, ideally within a large-scale e-commerce, or product-led environment.
You possess a strong analytical and technical background, with high proficiency in SQL and deep experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and building scalable data pipelines.
You are an expert in A/B testing frameworks, user behavior analytics, experiment design, and managing complex attribution or scoring systems.
You bring a dual understanding of funnel performance, mapping upper-funnel engagement metrics (views, watch time, retention) to lower-funnel transactional performance (conversion rate, contribution margin impact).
You have hands-on experience applying advanced causal inference methodologies (such as Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences, or Synthetic Controls) when randomized controlled trials are unfeasible.
You have proven leadership capability to excel in highly ambiguous environments, shift organizational models, and lead through influence to align senior executives.
You are a master storyteller with data, confident in communicating complex technical frameworks into simple, actionable strategic recommendations.
You have experience working with modern data visualization and analytics tools to scale data-driven accountability.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

Description:
Job Title

EIC Research Analyst

Job Description Summary

The Research Analyst is responsible for research, data & analytics and reporting activities across the German market. This role is designed to support the organic growth of the German businesses by thought leadership and insight outputs to help generate leads and opportunities in the business.

The role will directly report to and work closely with the Research Team Lead, Germany to ensure consistency of client experience, processes and operational excellence across the EMEA region. The role will also cooperate with colleagues from local business services departments, as well as other central functions, mainly Marketing and Data & Analytics teams.

Job Description

Title: Consultant Digital Analytics (all genders)
Description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE


Analytics-Konzeption: Entwickle Analytics-Strategien und konzipiere individuelle Lösungen für komplexe Herausforderungen in Web- und App-Projekten.
Implementierung: Implementiere Analytics-Tools und richte Tag-Management-, Tracking- und Consent-Management-Systeme für unsere Kunden ein.
Reporting & Dashboards: Erstelle Berichte und interaktive Dashboards, visualisiere Ergebnisse und interpretiere diese gemeinsam mit internen Teams im Online Marketing.
Compliance & Prozesse: Optimiere Prozesse und unterstütze unsere Kunden dabei, technische und rechtliche Anforderungen wie die Cookie-Compliance einzuhalten.
Wissensvermittlung: Vermittle Wissen, indem du interne und externe Schulungen zu Analytics-Themen durchführst.
Strategische Beratung: Berate Kunden und begleite sie beim strategischen Ausbau ihres Trackings.


DEIN PROFIL


Analytics- und Tracking-Systeme: Durch deine mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 3 Jahre) kennst du bereits Tools wie Piwik PRO, Matomo oder Google Analytics und bist mit Tag-Management- und Dashboard-Systemen vertraut. Aber auch Consent Management Plattformen sind dir nicht unbekannt und du verstehst die Funktion von Cookie Bannern auf Webseiten und in Mobile Apps.
Online-Marketing Expertise: Insbesondere datengetriebene Kampagnen gehören zu deinem Fachwissen.
Technisches Verständnis: Du bringst fundiertes Know-how in Webtechnologien und Programmiersprachen wie HTML, CSS und JavaScript mit.
Kenntnisse zur strategischen Analytics-Beratung: Idealerweise bringst du erste Erfahrung mit ganzheitlichen Datenstrategien für Unternehmen mit und bist begeisterungsfähig für technologische Entwicklungen und Trends im Analytics-Bereich.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist vertriebsorientiert und begeisterst andere für das Thema Digital Marketing.
KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.


Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Title: Demand Planning Expert
Description:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

We are currently looking for a Demand Planning Expert who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering directly with Commercial, Category Management, Finance and Supply Planning teams, your focus will be on delivering accurate, data-driven demand forecasts that support product availability, optimise inventory investment and enable commercial growth. In this role, you will combine your analytical expertise with your commercial insight to continuously improve forecast accuracy and planning performance. You will develop skills crucial to advancing in a competitive, fast-paced retail sector, all within a company that prizes dedication and results.

What You Will Do


Develop and maintain accurate demand forecasts across categories, channels and markets, combining statistical forecasting with commercial insight and incorporating promotions, product launches and market trends.
Partner with Commercial, Category Management, Marketing, Finance and Supply Planning teams to create a robust consensus demand plan, challenging assumptions and ensuring timely, high-quality inputs.
Analyse forecast performance and planning KPIs, including forecast accuracy, forecast bias and service levels, identifying risks, opportunities and actions to improve planning performance.
Support the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process by preparing demand planning outputs, presenting insights and providing recommendations to support informed business decisions.
Act as the subject matter expert for demand planning systems, forecasting methodologies and data, driving continuous improvement through automation, advanced analytics and AI-enabled forecasting techniques.



What You Should Bring


Significant experience in Demand Planning or Forecasting, ideally within retail, ecommerce or FMCG.
Strong understanding of forecasting methodologies, demand planning principles and S&OP / Integrated Business Planning processes.
Experience using demand planning and forecasting systems, with advanced Excel skills and the ability to analyse and interpret large datasets; Power BI experience is desirable.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
A continuous improvement mindset, with experience enhancing planning processes, systems and data quality; exposure to automation, AI or advanced analytics is desirable.



What We Can Offer You


A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events
Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun
Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration
Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.



Our interview process


CV review
Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
Hiring Manager Interview
Hiring Team Interview
Leadership Interview



Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note-taking. We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI-driven note-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role.

We currently have a hybrid work model supporting a blend of in-office and remote work (3 days per week in-office)

If we sparked your interest and you are open to embarking on your professional path with us, please visit our Lovehoney careers page to apply: Careers | Lovehoney Group

Our privacy policy is available here: Privacy Policy | Lovehoney Group

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Data Engineer CPO (m/w/d)
Description:
Deine Aufgaben


Du entwickelst unsere Datenstrukturen und Datenbanken weiter und schaffst damit die Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen im CPO.
Du definierst gemeinsam mit Operations und Management relevante KPIs und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter.
Du analysierst Daten, erkennst Muster und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
Du entwickelst pragmatische Reports und Dashboards, die im operativen Alltag wirklich genutzt werden.
Du integrierst unterschiedliche Systeme und Datenquellen und sorgst für verlässliche Datenflüsse.
Du baust automatisierte Schnittstellen und Prozesse auf.
Du stellst eine hohe Datenqualität und konsistente Stammdaten sicher.
Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Product, Tech und Management zusammen und bringst deine Perspektive aktiv ein.


Dein Profil


Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung
1-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung oder Praktika im Bereich Startups, Energie, Tech-Consulting, Business Development oder Technologie
Du bringst Kenntnisse in SQL mit; Erfahrung mit modernen Datenbankplattformen wie Supabase und Neon Database sowie mit NoSQL, z. B. Firebase oder Azure Table Storage, ist ein Plus.
Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für APIs, Systemintegrationen und Automatisierungen
Du hast Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen, Datenmodellierung und Datenbanken
Unternehmerisch geprägte, proaktive Arbeitsweise mit klarer Owner-Mentalität
Du hast Freude daran, technische und operative Fragestellungen miteinander zu verbinden
Starkes Interesse an der Energiewende und an integrierten Lösungen aus PV, Ladeinfrastruktur, Stromliefermodellen (z. B. PPA/IPP) und Batteriespeichern
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Warum wir?

CUBOS verfolgt die ambitionierte Vision, Europas führender Anbieter für betriebliches Energiemanagement-as-a-Service zu werden. Als innovatives Technologieunternehmen entwickeln und implementieren wir eigene Hardware- und Softwarelösungen, die den Weg in eine nachhaltige Zukunft ebnen. Unsere holistischen Angebote reichen von Ladeinfrastruktur und Photovoltaik über Beratung und Installation bis hin zu fortgeschrittenen Energiemanagementdiensten. Gemeinsam treiben wir den Übergang zu einer grüneren Energiezukunft voran und stellen uns den drängenden Herausforderungen des Klimawandels.

Unsere Strategie ist klar: Wir setzen auf Ende-zu-Ende Ladelösungen und PV-Systeme aus einer Hand, unterstützt durch unsere innovative Software CUBOS.connect und unsere modular entwickelte Hardware. Dabei sind wir nicht nur technologisch, sondern auch in unserer Herangehensweise innovativ. Wir expandieren strategisch, nutzen Eroberungsstrategien, die auf unsere Zielkundensegmente zugeschnitten sind, und arbeiten eng mit Partnern zusammen, um unsere Vision zu verwirklichen. Hierfür benötigen wir Dich. Hast Du Interesse, die Mobilitätswende aktiv voranzutreiben? Du erfüllst nicht genau alle Anforderungen? Bewirb Dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

Deine Benefits


Gestalte die Energiewende aktiv mit: Arbeite an realen, wirkungsvollen Projekten, die einen echten Unterschied machen.
Erlebe Startup-Spirit mit Stabilität: Profitiere von flachen Hierarchien, hoher Verantwortung und direktem Impact, gepaart mit der Sicherheit eines etablierten Unternehmens.
Flexibilität und faire Vergütung: Wir bieten Dir flexible Arbeitszeiten, die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice und ein attraktives Gehaltspaket.
Modernes Büro: Arbeite direkt Unter den Linden in Berlin

Title: Datenanalyst:in Bedarfsplanung
Description:
Die Kassenärztliche Vereinigung (KV) Berlin ist eine Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts und eine wichtige Schlüsselfunktion im Gesundheitswesen. Wir sind für die Sicherstellung der ambulanten medizinischen und psychotherapeutischen Versorgung der gesetzlich Versicherten in der Hauptstadt zuständig. Wir gewährleisten diese in Zusammenarbeit mit der Ärzteschaft auf einem hohen Qualitätsniveau – rund um die Uhr. Unser Hauptsitz befindet sich in einem modernen Bürogebäude in zentraler Lage mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung durch Bus und Bahn.

Die Kassenärztliche Vereinigung Berlin (Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts) sucht für ihre Abteilung Arztregister und Bedarfsplanung zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt auf Vollzeitbasis (Teilzeit möglich) befristet für 1 Jahr eine:n

Datenanalyst:in Bedarfsplanung

Als Datenanalyst:in in der Bedarfsplanung analysieren, strukturieren und visualisieren Sie versorgungsrelevante Daten für die ambulante Versorgung in Berlin. Im Rahmen Ihrer Tätigkeit unterstützen Sie das Team bei seinen Aufgaben und wirken beim Aufbau des Versorgungsradars als Monitoring-, Planungs- und Prognoseinstrument mit. Aufgrund der Zuordnung zum Projekt „Versorgungsradar“ ist diese Stelle befristet.

Ihr Aufgabengebiet


Analyse der ambulanten Versorgungssituation in Berlin zur Ermittlung von Versorgungsgraden und -bedarfen
Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung des Bedarfsplans auf Basis gesetzlicher Vorgaben und fundierter Datenanalysen
Durchführung von Versorgungs-, Bedarfs- und Prognoseanalysen zur zukunftsorientierten Steuerung der ambulanten Versorgung
Aufbereitung, Visualisierung und Präsentation komplexer Daten für Vorstand, Fachbereiche und externe Stakeholder, insbesondere unter Einsatz von Power BI
Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Dashboards und interaktiven Berichten in Power BI zur Unterstützung von Monitoring-, Planungs- und Entscheidungsprozessen
Entwicklung von Handlungsempfehlungen und strategischen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Gremien und Führungskräfte
Prüfung versorgungsrelevanter Anträge und Sachverhalte unter Berücksichtigung bedarfsplanerischer und rechtlicher Kriterien
Optimierung datenbasierter Prozesse und fachliche Begleitung technischer Lösungen zur effizienten Bedarfsplanung


Ihr Profil


Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (Fach-)Hochschulstudium im Bereich Gesundheitswissenschaften, Gesundheitsökonomie, Public Health, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Mathematik, Verwaltungsrecht o. Ä. bzw. vergleichbare für die Stelle relevante Kenntnisse/Erfahrung
Detailliertes Fachwissen und Erfahrungen zu den komplexen Prozessen der ambulanten Bedarfsplanung und der Abrechnung der Vertragsärzt:innen
Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Statistik und Modellierung sowie Datenauswertung und -darstellung
Gute Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Microsoft Power BI, insbesondere bei der Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Dashboards, Berichten und Datenvisualisierungen
Analytisch-logisches Know-how sowie lösungsorientiertes Handeln
Zuverlässigkeit und Engagement
Souveränes Auftreten im abteilungsübergreifenden Kontakt und im Kontakt mit Ärzt:innen, Krankenkassen, Behörden und sonstigen Institutionen


Wir bieten Ihnen


Vergütung nach TV-L Berlin, inklusive einer Jahressonderzahlung und 30 Tage Urlaub
38,5 Stunden/Woche (Vollzeit) und flexible Arbeitszeiten/Teilzeitmodelle
Bis zu 11 Tage mobiles Arbeiten monatlich (nach Ende der Probezeit)
KV-Card (50 € monatlicher Sachbezug) zum Einkaufen in der Region
Zahlreiche Angebote zur Gesundheitsförderung und unternehmenseigene Fitnessräume
Sehr gute ÖPNV-Verkehrsanbindung, gesicherte Fahrradabstellplätze und kostenlose öffentliche Parkplätze

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Scrumconnect Consulting

Scrumconnect Consulting is a multi-award-winning digital consultancy, recognised for delivering impactful and innovative technology solutions across UK government departments. Our work has positively influenced the lives of over 40 million UK citizens.

We are passionate about user-centred design, agile delivery, and building digital services that make a real difference. Our teams work at the forefront of innovation, helping organisations transform and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that truly matter.




Overview :




The Data Analyst will be responsible for analysing data, developing insightful dashboards, and providing data-driven insights to support informed decision-making.




Key Responsibilities & Skills

Report Design & Delivery

Advanced experience translating stakeholder requirements into intuitive, accessible dashboards and reports that enable self-service data exploration.
Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI, DAX and Excel to develop data models and create efficient, optimised and scalable reports and visualisations.
Ability to design dashboards that clearly communicate complex data and insights to a range of stakeholders.

Data Analysis & Synthesis

Strong experience integrating multiple data sources into a conformed data model for analysis.
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Power Query and M.
Experience in data cleansing, transformation and preparation for reporting and analysis.

Statistical Analysis & Techniques

Proven experience applying a broad range of statistical techniques to support data-driven decision-making.
Strong understanding of averages, standard deviation, correlation, regression and statistical significance testing.
Ability to interpret statistical results and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technical Understanding of Dash boarding Products

Experience monitoring emerging technologies and assessing their potential application to dashboard and data visualisation products.
Ability to provide recommendations on tools and technologies that can improve reporting and data visualisation capabilities.

Key Skills: Power BI | DAX | Excel | SQL | Python | Power Query | M | Data Modelling | Data Visualisation | Statistical Analysis










Diversity & Inclusion

At Scrumconnect Consulting, we believe that diversity drives innovation and better outcomes. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every individual is valued, respected, and supported.

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and actively encourage individuals from under-represented groups, including women, people with disabilities, and diverse communities, as well as those seeking flexible working arrangements.

As a Disability Confident Level 1 employer, we are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and during employment to ensure equal opportunities for all.

Title: Audience Data Analyst
Description:
Salary: Up to £41,440 per annum based on skills and experience
Full time; 40 hours per week
Permanent position
Based in: Covent Garden, London.


The Royal Ballet and Opera, situated in our Covent Garden theatre has been at the heart of London and British cultural life for three centuries. We are home to two world-class Companies: The Royal Ballet and The Royal Opera.

The Royal Opera House describes the place we work, not who we are. The whole is always more than the sum of its parts – we may be a House, but three quarters of our audiences experience what we do outside this building. While our Covent Garden theatre is the nerve centre, the impact and influence of the organisation can be felt in every corner of the country, and around the world. Understanding our global audience (their behaviours, preferences and habits) is central to our mission to engage more people with our art forms through programming and commercial development, as well as reporting accurately to our funders and supporters.

We are seeking to recruit an Audience Data Analyst to join our Analytics and Insight Team as we enter a new and exciting season of ballet and opera programming. This role will focus on delivering high-quality data analysis, ensuring that we continue to develop a holistic and evolving image of RBO audiences and sales. The postholder will provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders across the organisation, enabling them to make strategic, evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate will have an analytical mind, with the ability to operate independently to agreed deadlines, producing high quality and accurate work for a range of stakeholders at pace. They will be able to contribute to the output of a multi-functional and collaborative team, working with a range of specialists across UX and CX Research, Pricing, Ticketing and Marketing.

The Successful Candidate Will Be Able To Demonstrate


Strong practical data analysis skills, including SQL skills
Strong numeracy, analytical reasoning and attention to detail
The ability to understand the underlying questions of an analytics request and to translate stakeholder requests into clear, focused analysis briefs
Strong collaboration skills, with the confidence to work constructively with stakeholders, technical colleagues and subject matter experts
Clear experience of taking analytical work from an initial question through to accurate findings, clear conclusions and actionable insight.


An Understanding Of The Below Will Be Beneficial And Highly Regarded So Please Do Reflect These In Your Application If You Have


Experience with ticketing or CRM data
Experience working across multiple data sets
Experience with audience, visitor, member or customer data in a performing arts or visitor attraction environment
Experience using Python, R or another analytical programming language for data analysis or automation.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The Role:




Brook Green Supply (BGS) is a leading independent B2B gas and electricity supplier, delivering tailored energy supply and Net-Zero solutions to industrial and commercial consumers.




As a Senior Data Analyst, you will use advanced SQL and analytical skills to extract, transform and interpret data from large relational databases. You will design intuitive dashboards that turn complex data into clear, actionable insight, helping the business understand performance, identify trends, spot risks and opportunities, and make informed decisions.




You will ensure data accuracy and integrity by developing efficient SQL scripts for analysis, reporting and troubleshooting. Working closely with Data Engineers and the wider Tech team, you will streamline data processes, contribute to data models and provide insight that supports business decision-making.




This role suits an ambitious, flexible and technically strong analyst who enjoys explaining the story behind the data, improving reporting quality and helping colleagues use data with confidence.




Essential Functions of the Job:




Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data requirements and understand business needs.
Write, optimise and maintain complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation and analysis across large datasets.
Clean, analyse and transform large and complex datasets into accurate, actionable information.
Identify trends, patterns and correlations in data to uncover insights that support business decision-making.
Perform ad hoc data analysis and provide clear recommendations based on findings.
Produce visually clear, engaging and user-friendly dashboards.
Validate data accuracy and quality to support reliable reporting.
Stay up to date with industry trends and best practice in data visualisation and analytics.
Present findings and insights to stakeholders in a clear and concise way.
Coach and mentor colleagues and new starters on data topics, helping the business unlock greater value from data.
Support improvements to data processes, reporting models and analytical ways of working.







Skills & Experience Required:




Proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar role, with a focus on data visualisation using Tableau.
Strong knowledge of SQL, with Python, R or similar programming languages desirable.
Demonstrated ability to write and optimise complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation and analysis.
Experience working with large, structured datasets and producing accurate reporting outputs.
Strong technical background, with excellent analytical skills and high attention to detail.
Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex information to non-technical stakeholders.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and confidence working across multiple web-based platforms.
Experience using a CRM system is desirable.
Degree-level education in a numerical subject, with a STEM degree desirable.
Self-starter who takes ownership, creates solutions and improves business processes.
Able to work independently and as part of a team, prioritising workload effectively with minimal supervision.
Able to coach and mentor colleagues across the business on data topics.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment and responding to changing business needs.
Experience in the electricity or gas industry is not required, but is preferred.
Interest in developing knowledge across commercial decision-making, wholesale markets, non-commodities, forecasting, analytics and energy regulation.




Brook Green Supply is committed to ensuring equal opportunities, fairness of treatment, dignity and respect, and the elimination of all forms of discrimination in the workplace for all employees/contractors and job applicants.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst | Financial Technology | Victoria, London | 4 Days a Week in Office | £55,000 to £65,000




I’m working with a growing financial technology client in London who are looking to hire an early-career Data Analyst into a maturing data function.




This would be a great role for a talented Data Analyst with aspirations of growing into a Data Science position over time. The immediate need is analytical and commercially focused, but you’ll be learning from a technically strong Data Scientist who can provide hands-on coaching and development.




This is not a deep data science or machine learning role from day one. It is a business-facing analyst position, working closely with finance, operations, marketing, and senior leadership to turn data into clear commercial insight.




The role will suit someone bright, curious, and early in their career who wants proper coaching, genuine exposure, and the chance to learn how a financial services business works from the inside.




You’ll report into a highly capable Data Scientist who is stepping into management and will provide hands-on technical guidance, with regular exposure to the Finance Director and CEO. The structure is flat, the data engineering team is already well established, and the environment is set up for someone to learn quickly without being left to figure everything out alone.




What you’ll be doing:

Analysing commercial, finance, and operational data
Spotting trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
Communicating insight clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Working with established data processes and tooling
Partnering closely with more senior people before running independently with ideas
Building your commercial understanding of a fast-moving fintech environment




What they’re looking for:

Strong SQL and some Python experience
Exposure to modern data tooling such as dbt or Airflow
Some experience with data visualisation and reporting
Strong communication skills, especially with non-technical stakeholders
High EQ, curiosity, and willingness to learn
A collaborative mindset and the maturity to ask questions before building in isolation
Fintech, financial services, or card issuing experience would be a bonus, but is not essential




The key here is attitude and commercial thinking. The client is not looking for someone who wants to disappear into technical work. They want someone who can understand a business problem, work with others, and explain findings in plain English.




Interview process:

1st stage: Intro chat with senior finance and data stakeholders
2nd stage: Technical interview
Final stage: In-office meeting with the wider leadership and data team




If you’re a Data Analyst who wants to build strong commercial foundations while developing towards Data Science over time, this could be a really strong fit.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Company




We’re Octopus Legacy: one of the fastest growing tech companies in the country, part of the UK’s most exciting and best-trusted group (you may have heard of some of our sister companies…) and we have a mission.




We’re on a path to scale, aiming to become a household name while transforming a long-established industry and helping our customers prepare for, and find support after, death.




But we can’t do it alone, and that’s why we’re assembling a team of top performers to build with us.




Ready to be part of something big?




The Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing data team at Octopus Legacy. You’ll play a central role in helping teams across the business make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.




While you’ll sit within the data team, your day-to-day will involve working directly with stakeholders from across the organisation such as Growth, Product and Operations. You’ll turn messy real-world data into actionable insights, bring structure to ambiguity, and help the business better understand what drives performance.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role in a fast-moving environment. You’ll need to be comfortable navigating shifting priorities, championing a data culture, and bringing rigour to complexity.




We’re still early in our data journey - right now, the focus is on building the foundations: modelling key metrics, creating dashboards, and getting reliable data into the hands of the people who need it. As our data maturity grows, there’ll be opportunities to go deeper into analysis, experimentation, and more advanced analytics.




Key Responsibilities:

Act as a thought partner to teams across the business - helping them define problems, clarify questions, and uncover the metrics that matter
Translate stakeholder needs into end-to-end data solutions: from raw data to dbt models to dashboards in Metabase
Define and document clear, consistent metrics to support better decision-making across departments
Build intuitive, impactful dashboards that make data accessible and actionable for non-technical users
Deliver ad-hoc and project-based analysis to evaluate initiatives in growth, product, operations, and beyond
Collaborate with the data team to improve the reliability, clarity, and accessibility of our data models and pipelines
Operate with a high degree of autonomy - scoping projects, pushing for clarity, and challenging assumptions when needed
Contribute to a culture of curiosity and rigour, laying the groundwork for more advanced analytics and data science over time




Who Are You?

You have 2+ years of experience in a data analytics role, ideally in a startup or a company building out its data capability
You're proficient in SQL and have worked with BI tools (like Metabase, Looker, or Tableau) to build dashboards that help teams make better decisions
You have hands-on experience with dbt or similar tools, and a solid understanding of data modelling best practices
You’re comfortable working with messy or incomplete data, and know how to turn it into something clean, structured, and useful
You enjoy working with non-technical stakeholders - you ask thoughtful questions, clarify ambiguous requests, and help teams think through what they really need
You take ownership of your work, are comfortable scoping projects with limited direction, and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions
You’re curious, pragmatic, and excited by the idea of shaping a modern data function from the ground up
Bonus: you have an interest in experimentation or data science, and are keen to grow into more advanced analytics over time




Skills and Knowledge




Must haves:

Strong curiosity and proactive mindset, with the ability to independently explore data, ask the right questions, identify opportunities, and drive projects forward without requiring constant guidance.
Experience in data analytics and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.
Proficiency with SQL, DBT, python is desirable.
Proven ability to work closely with business stakeholders and translate their needs into data-driven solutions.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards to monitor key metrics.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex data in a way that is understandable and actionable for non-technical stakeholders across departments.
Proficiency with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Metabase).




Nice to haves/we can work on these:

Basic programming skills in languages such as Python.
Understanding of statistical methods and their application to business problems.
Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.




Bonus if you:

You have a basic understanding of Data Science concepts and are interested in learning more.
You have experience in training or educating non-technical teams on data literacy.




Our Mission

When people think about planning for death they think about wills, life insurance and funerals. We take these cold processes and turn them into something more human. Share more than money: leave voice notes, music, recipes. Shape a legacy that connects you while you're here. And after you're gone.




Founded by Sam after his mum died suddenly, we’re a group of people who work in death because we’ve been affected by it. We know the difference a good plan makes, and what it’s like when there isn’t one.




Death can come between us, leave mess, legal fees, frustration. But it can also make us stronger. We see a world where people talk openly about death, and work out the real meaning of legacy, one that connects to them. We’re here to make that world happen.




Benefits:

Octopus share incentive scheme.
Hybrid working (London Bridge).
Flexible holiday + extra day off for your Birthday.
Work from anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks per year.
Vitality Health & Life Insurance.
Pension scheme.
Enhanced parental leave.
Free Will & LPAs + discounts on other Octopus services.
Cycle to Work Scheme and access to the Electric Vehicle (EV) Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
Octopus Giving: we match any charitable fundraising that you do up to £500.
Octopus Springboard: where we help our employees become fully-fledged entrepreneurs.
Dog friendly office.
Breakfast every day, snacks and wellness activities




We know that to be truly innovative, we need to have a diverse team around us. That is why Octopus Legacy is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

YOU MAKE US MORE

Join Moorfields Eye Hospital NHS Foundation Trust

At Moorfields, people’s sight matters—and so do the people who make it possible.

For over 200 years, Moorfields has been at the forefront of ophthalmic care, research, and education. With more than 2,300 dedicated team members and over 700,000 patients seen annually across our City Road site and 22 networked sites, we are proud to be a global centre of excellence.

We're also a vibrant community where kindness, equity and excellence shape every aspect of our work. Whether it’s pioneering research through our partnership with UCL Institute of Ophthalmology and Moorfields Biomedical Research Centre or training the next generation of global eye care leaders, we’re united by one mission—delivering world-class eye health, sustainably and at scale.

And we’re just getting started.

From 2027, we’ll move to our brand-new Oriel site in St Pancras, Camden—a state-of-the-art centre that will unite eye care, research, and education under one roof. Music is Universal

It’s the passionate and dedicated team at Universal Music who help make us the world’s leading music company. From A&R to finance, legal to digital, sales to marketing, Universal Music is the place to grow and develop your career within a truly commercial and innovative business that leads in everything it does.

Everyone is welcome to apply for our roles, and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment because of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, age, marital status, background, pregnancy, or caring responsibilities. We also recognise the importance of diversity of thought within our teams and are fully committed to embracing the talents of people with autism, dyslexia, ADHD, and other forms of neurocognitive variation.

We will always seek to make appropriate adjustments to recruitment, workplaces, and work processes to be fully inclusive to people with different needs and working styles. If you need us to make any reasonable adjustments for you from application onwards, including alternatives to the online form or to disclose a neurocognitive condition, please email UniversalMusicCareers@umusic.com.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience


Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.


Just So You Know…

However, the business operates in an environment that demands change and the jobholder's specific responsibilities and activities will vary and develop. Therefore, the job description should be seen as indicative and not as a permanent, definitive, and exhaustive statement.

Location: City of London (3 days per week)

Salary: £70,000–£85,000 + 20–40% bonus + benefits




Gravitas has partnered with a well-established London Market insurance organisation to recruit a Senior Data Analyst into its Data Analytics team. This is a priority hire with a real need for someone who can add value quickly, particularly in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric and who is confident partnering with underwriters and senior stakeholders.




Background note: Lloyd’s / London Market experience is still preferred, but we are now open to candidates from broader insurance and financial services backgrounds. Exceptional candidates from outside these sectors will be considered if they are technically strong and commercially minded.




The Role




Reporting to the Data Analytics Manager (Ballint’s team), you’ll sit in the “bridge” between the business and data/IT teams—translating stakeholder needs into well-scoped analysis and high-quality Power BI deliverables.




This role is commercially led (stakeholder partnership, requirements shaping, influencing decision-making) rather than deep pipeline engineering. You’ll also work closely with the Senior Data Scientist to agree clear handover points between analytics and data science.




Key Projects

Delegated data programme (multi-year): delivering granular, underwriter-ready insight and MI.
Power BI adoption & rationalisation: improving standards, reusability, governance, and reducing duplicated / inconsistent reporting.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
About Salary Finance

Working with employers, we provide a financial wellbeing platform as an employee benefit, helping employees to understand their money better, get out of debt faster and save for their future. We already have a reach of over 4,000,000 employees through our relationships with over 600 of the biggest companies in the UK.




By improving employee financial wellbeing, we have a very real and meaningful impact on people’s lives. We remove the stress and worry associated with financial difficulties by dramatically reducing the interest rates employees pay on their personal debt, and provide them with the tools needed to start saving sooner and be more financially secure. We are backed by some of the biggest brands, including investments from Blenheim Chalcot (the UK’s leading venture builder), Legal and General (the FTSE 100 insurer and asset manager), Experian and funding partnerships with JP Morgan and Blue Owl.




Launched in 2015, we have made excellent progress, and are scaling fast. We are named BITC’s Responsible Business of Year 2018, included in KPMG’s Global Fintech 100, listed top of the Forbes' list of socially-responsible startups, and profiled by the Financial Times, the Times, the Wall Street Journal, the Guardian, the Telegraph, CityAM and the Institute of Directors.




Your role in our mission

We are looking for a talented Enterprise Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Hub. Reporting to the Lead Enterprise Data Analyst, you will help translate business questions into trusted data products and Power BI dashboards, supporting Salary Finance's mission to help our customers get out of debt faster and save for their future. You'll work alongside senior analysts, engineers and stakeholders across the business building the datasets, reports, and insights that inform decisions and enable safe growth of our loan book. This is a role where you'll grow your craft, contribute to team standards, and see the impact of your work reach real customers.




What you’ll do

Build High-Impact Dashboarding:

You will liaise with stakeholders of all data literacy levels to develop robust dashboard requirements
You will build, design, develop and maintain best-in-class Power BI dashboards which serve a purpose and deliver value to the business

Drive Operational Efficiency

You will help the automation of manual reporting processes and end-to-end operational workflows, ensuring high uptime and seamless maintenance of production reports.
You will regularly audit existing report performance and SQL scripts to reduce technical debt and improve processing speeds as data demand scales.

Support Data Integrity:

You will follow the team's data governance standards and contribute to documentation across your analytical outputs

Engineer Data Foundations:

You will build optimised scalable data products and robust data marts, creating a structured environment for self-service analytics.
You will collaborate with Enterprise Data Engineers to refine ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring the upstream data architecture supports downstream analytical requirements.




About you

Essential:

Proven Track Record: At least 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or similar roles, with a demonstrable history of progressing from technical execution to strategic delivery.
SQL Mastery: Advance level proficiency in writing, optimising, and debugging complex queries. You should be comfortable handling large-scale datasets and understanding relational database architecture.
Power BI & DAX Specialist: Advanced command of the Power BI ecosystem. You don't just build reports; you create sophisticated DAX measures and perform complex data modeling to solve intricate business logic.
Strategic Stakeholder Management: A proven ability to act as a bridge between technical data and business needs. You can translate "vague requests" into concrete technical requirements and present findings to executives with confidence.
Insight Delivery & Storytelling: You possess a "so what?" mindset. You have a track record of moving beyond descriptive reporting to deliver predictive insights that drive measurable commercial value.
LLM Literate: You are comfortable using LLMs (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to accelerate your workflow, whether for logic verification, documentation, or streamlining code development.




Nice to have:

Experience in financial services or a similar regulated industry (e.g., FinTech, banking).
Prompt Engineering for Data: You are well-versed in prompt engineering techniques to optimise data cleaning, generate SQL scripts, or automate metadata documentation.
Python for Analytics: Ability to use Python for data manipulation (Pandas/NumPy), automation scripts, or basic statistical modeling to augment standard BI toolsets.
Data Governance Frameworks: Practical experience establishing data dictionaries, lineage, and quality protocols to ensure a "single source of truth."
Forecasting & Predictive Modeling: Experience building time-series forecasts or predictive models to help the business anticipate trends, demand, or churn.
Technical Mentorship: Experience in peer-reviewing code (SQL/DAX) and coaching junior analysts to uphold high standards of accuracy, performance, and design.




Who you are

While we embrace diverse backgrounds and perspectives, we’re united by a shared mindset. We look for team members who live these values every day:

Take Ownership: We own the entire journey and see outcomes through from start to finish
Dig Deeper :We ask why, investigate root causes, and build solutions that last
Stronger Together :We choose collaboration, share knowledge freely, and lift each other up
Momentum Matters :We act with purpose, remove blockers, and default to action
Make a Lasting Impact :We think long-term, put people before numbers, and change the system for good




What do you get for all your hard work?

Company bonus scheme 💰
25 days holiday with an additional day off for every year of service up to 30 days and an extra day off on your birthday 🎂
Hybrid working arrangements so you can work from the office and from home with a budget to help you get set up 🏠
Generous company benefits to include pension and life assurance and an annual allowance to spend on medical insurance, health cash plan, denplan, gym memberships 🤸
Enhanced policies that are family and pet friendly, to include company sick pay and peternity leave 🐶
Great career development in a fast paced environment 🚀
Volunteer days as part of our CSR program 🤝
Regular company socials & more great perks to include weekly snacks, tuckshop, cycle to work, help to save and much more! 🍭




The typical interview process

Introductory call with our Talent Manager (phone call - 20 mins)
1st Stage: Technical interview (PowerBI exercise) with Hiring Manager and team (video call - 60 mins)
2nd Stage: Past work experience and culture interview with Hiring Manager and team (in person - 60 mins)




We’re looking for people that will get stuck in and make a difference. We have a great collaborative, entrepreneurial team and are passionate about what we do. If you want to join a team that is changing people’s lives for the better then we’d love to hear from you.

Learn more at salaryfinance.com




Salary Finance is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where all employees and applicants can flourish.




If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs
A proactive mindset — you don't wait to be asked; you spot something unusual and you dig in
Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)

Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams where priorities shift quickly.
Proficiency with a spreadsheet tool (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, or any other alternative)
Enjoy autonomy and a flat structure: we have millions of customers and a flat hierarchy so any individual can have an outsized impact
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field


Experience With The Following Would Be a Plus


Data governance
Python or any other scripting language
Git or any other version control tool

Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
