Title: Senior Data Analyst (Marketing Analytics)
Description:
What is the job?

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics to help us uncover what’s truly driving growth, understand where the biggest opportunities lie and shape where we focus next.

This is a high-impact, hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who loves getting under the skin of the data, connecting the dots behind performance and turning complex findings into clear, commercially meaningful action. You’ll be equally excited by the technical side of analytics - working with data, tools and reporting infrastructure - as you are by solving real business problems and influencing decisions.

Working closely with teams across paid media, CRM and lifecycle marketing, you’ll become a trusted partner to the wider marketing function. You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth.

This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey.

We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact.

What will you be doing?


Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM.
Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making.
Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics.
Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources.
Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs.
Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality.
Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders.


What do you need?


Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment.
Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders.
Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action.
A confident communicator who can explain complex analysis in simple, practical terms. You’re able to identify the what and the why to help shape decisions.
Self-starter mindset - able to navigate ambiguity and work independently.
Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms is a strong advantage.


What we offer:


Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays
Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions
Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more
Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact
Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave


About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Compensation Range: £60K - £70K

You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth.

This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey.

We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact.

What will you be doing?

  • Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM.
  • Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making.
  • Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics.
  • Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources.
  • Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs.
  • Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality.
  • Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders.

What do you need?

  • Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action.
  • A confident communicator who can explain complex analysis in simple, practical terms. You’re able to identify the what and the why to help shape decisions.
  • Self-starter mindset - able to navigate ambiguity and work independently.
  • Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms is a strong advantage.

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays
  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions
  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more
  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact
  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Support business intelligence, reporting automation, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
Present findings, trends, and recommendations in a polished, concise, and business-friendly manner to senior stakeholders.
Participate in special projects and ad hoc analytical initiatives requiring a strong mix of technical skill, business judgment, and communication.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related field.

5+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, commercial analytics, business insights, or a related analytical role.
Advanced SQL skills are a must. This role requires someone who can independently write complex queries, pull and manipulate large datasets, validate outputs, and use data to solve business problems.
Strong experience analyzing large datasets and turning complex information into clear, relevant, and actionable insights for the business.
Experience with Power BI, Excel, and other reporting / visualization tools. Exposure to VBA, Python, Tableau, or similar tools would be considered an asset.

Strong presentation skills, executive presence, and the ability to simplify complex information into a clear and compelling message.

Strong critical thinking, curiosity, and problem-solving ability, with the instinct to dig into root causes and connect data back to business performance.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in a visible role with accountability to senior stakeholders.
Polished, professional, and credible communicator with a strong business partnering mindset.

Hybrid work environment.
Highly visible role with regular exposure to senior leadership and key decision-makers.
Opportunity to influence business decisions through data, analysis, and strategic insight.
Blend of technical analytics, reporting, and stakeholder-facing business support.
Strong long-term career growth opportunity within a well-established Canadian organization.

Collaborative and team-oriented culture.
Strong commitment to employee development and continuous learning.

Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Senior Data Analyst - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with production and product management partners to drive data-informed decisions within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data investigator, visualizer, and designer, helping to enhance the core experiences of our global player base.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.
Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets.
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners.
Explore user behavioral patterns to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies.
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making.
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis.
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a plus.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

The Game Intelligence team within the Enterprise Intelligence organization is involved in every aspect of data at EA, using it to deliver valuable insights and solutions for game teams and players. We drive strategy, build data and AI tools, and support personalization, experimentation, and analytics. Join GI to work with experts dedicated to improving understanding, workflows, and player experiences.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Analyst, Insights to join our analytics team supporting a high-definition title in development. In this hybrid role based in Vancouver, you’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, game designers, and quality teams to enhance player experiences and drive business outcomes through data. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, gameplay features, technology, testing, and overall quality.

What You'll Do


Analyse player and product data to uncover patterns and recommend opportunities to improve performance, stability, automation and test coverage and bug metrics
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences


What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, software, mobile apps, or similar
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
Ability to independently manage assigned tasks including work planning for assigned deliverables


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our analytics team supporting a high-definition title in development. In this hybrid role based in Vancouver, you’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, and quality teams to enhance development quality, product stability and drive business outcomes through data. Reporting to the Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, technology, testing, and overall quality.

Communicate with studio stakeholders to identify opportunities where data can better support decision making
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights


What You'll Bring


4+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, mobile apps, or other digital products
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.


Pay Transparency - North America

British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our San Francisco or Toronto offices, and to translate complex healthcare and product data into clear, actionable insights that drive strategy and business impact. You are a fit if you thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, own analytical deep work end to end, and enjoy influencing decisions through rigorous, well-communicated analysis.

What you’ll do:


Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.
Mentor other analysts and raise the bar for data storytelling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder influence across the organization.


What we look for:


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages.
5+ years of experience with a programming language such as Python or R.
5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques.
Strong experience working with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, including modeling and analyzing customer, pipeline, and revenue data.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings from data and models into compelling insights for technical and non-technical audiences.


Bonus (Nice to have):


Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or a related field.
Experience working with sales organizations and familiarity with funnel and pipeline processes.
Strong mentorship and leadership skills, with a track record of elevating scientific standards and developing junior talent across teams.


Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:


Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.


(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

Notice to Candidates:

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page.

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About The Opportunity

Job Summary

Under the supervision of the Data Quality & Research Administration Analytics Manager and with support of senior level team members, the Senior Data Analyst will work closely with key stakeholders to identify and conduct data analysis projects that support the mission and goals of the University and Northeastern University Research Enterprise Services (NU-RES). The Senior Data Analyst will provide support to key projects through data collection, computational support, and data interpretation and reporting, and will ensure data accuracy and consistent reporting by designing and creating optimal processes and procedures to systematize the data reporting process. The incumbent will use advanced data modeling, predictive modeling, and analytical techniques to develop reports used in key data submissions to internal and external stakeholders. Possess a good sense of humor, ability to be calm under pressure, and effectively communicate with report requestors to ascertain requirements for reports that tell an accurate story.

This job may also be based in Boston. If you are based in the United States, please apply here

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant subject area (e.g., computer science, data science, mathematics, statistics, information technology, or related field); 3+ years of experience with querying databases, SQL, and Microsoft Excel; experience developing robust dashboards using Tableau and/or Power BI; creating visuals using data visualization best practices.
Proficiency with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Cognos or Snowflake preferred.
Understanding of, and experience in, using analytical concepts and tools, including data modeling and predictive analytics.
Project management, time management, and communication skills necessary to execute responsibilities in a collaborative, academic setting.
Teamwork and collaboration in a professional setting.
Demonstrated curiosity, problem-solving skills, and ability to meet deadlines.
Excellent written and oral communication skills with ability to advise and clearly communicate ideas and results to non-technical audiences.
Strong ability to manage multiple assignments while working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Ability to maintain a positive attitude and work well independently, within a team environment, and with external users as well as a variety of internal audiences.
Experience working with university research administration data and systems preferred.
Experience documenting business procedures and processes preferred.
Understanding of, and experience in, using AI-enabled tools to provide appropriate levels of support to daily work.
Familiarity with electronic research administration (eRA) systems (e.g., Coeus, ePAWS, or similar eRA platforms) preferred.



Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

45% — Data Collection, Assessment, Interpretation, and Reporting

Collect relevant data (both internal and external) to be used by college constituents to support decision making and strategic direction, resource allocation, internal and external reporting, and other operational decisions. Success factors include the accuracy and relevance of the data, analysis, and the clarity and usefulness of final reports. Develop and iterate on self-service reports and dashboards with an eye towards automation and re-use. Manage data sourced from both legacy systems (e.g., Coeus) and current eRA platforms (e.g., ePAWS 2.0), ensuring continuity and accuracy across reporting environments.

25% — Data Visualization

Oversee the development and maintenance of key performance dashboards that show progress toward strategic and operational goals related to research. Work closely with Research Enterprise Services stakeholders to identify opportunities for additional dashboard requirements as needs evolve. Develop and iterate on self-service reports and dashboards with an eye towards automation and re-use. Tools include Tableau (including Tableau Prep and Tableau Server), Cognos, and other visualization platforms as applicable.

10% — System Support

Evaluate and test back-end changes to electronic research administration systems as they impact data quality and access, including connectivity with Tableau and the Cognos Data Warehouse environment. Monitor data quality in reports and adjust as needed. Support migration activities between legacy and current systems, including data validation and reconciliation tasks.

10% — Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to define areas for process improvement and work with stakeholders to design and build technical processes that improve efficiencies and address business issues and needs. Develop and maintain documentation of data pipelines, reporting logic, and source-of-truth definitions to support team continuity and institutional knowledge.

10% — Ad Hoc Duties

Perform ad hoc research and analysis to support special projects and strategic initiatives serving faculty and staff across Research Enterprise Services in meeting their reporting and analytical needs. May include supporting AI-assisted data extraction, research analytics benchmarking, and cross-institutional data collaborations.

Applicants must have current work authorization for the country in which they will be based. The University is unable to sponsor a visa or work permit for this position.

Position Type

Data Planning and Analysis

Additional Information

Under the supervision of the Data Quality & Research Administration Analytics Manager and with support of senior level team members, the Senior Data Analyst will work closely with key stakeholders to identify and conduct data analysis projects that support the mission and goals of the University and Northeastern University Research Enterprise Services (NU-RES). What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Founded in 1953, Thomas Cavanagh Construction has continued to set the standard for quality construction and materials in Eastern Ontario. With our strategically located pits and quarries, our unmatched fleet of trucks and heavy equipment, our state-of-the-art facilities, and our dedicated employees, Thomas Cavanagh Construction has earned a reputation as one of Ottawa’s most trusted and respected contractors.




Overview:

The Data Analyst supports the Organizational Change Manager (OCM) and the broader digital transformation initiative by building reports, dashboards, and data views for business leaders and teams across Thomas Cavanagh Construction, using the Palantir Foundry ontology built and maintained by Cavtera. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role suited to someone strong in business intelligence, data querying, and communicating insights across all levels of the organization.

Requests that can be met using existing ontology objects — reports, dashboards, and data views — are handled directly by this role. Requests that require creating, modifying, or removing foundational ontology objects are routed to Cavtera for build. As the digital transformation function grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on broader reporting and analytics responsibilities over time.




Duties and Responsibilities:




Reporting & Dashboard Development

Build reports, dashboards, and data views within the Palantir Foundry ontology, using objects already created by Cavtera
Translate requests from business leaders and teams into clear, usable reports and dashboards
Maintain and update existing reports and dashboards as business needs evolve
Ensure reports and dashboards are accurate, well-organized, and easy for end users to interpret




Data Analysis & BI Support

Query and analyze data across the ontology and connected data sources to answer stakeholder questions
Identify data quality issues, gaps, or inconsistencies and flag them to Cavtera
Support ad hoc reporting and analysis requests from business leaders and operational teams
Apply BI and database best practices to keep reports and dashboards reliable and maintainable




Cross-Functional Collaboration

Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for developers, business leaders, and end users on approved reporting work, with new requests coming through the OCM
Gather and clarify reporting requirements from stakeholders at all levels of the organization
Work closely with the Cavtera team to understand ontology structure and available objects
Communicate reporting timelines, limitations, and options clearly to stakeholders




Scope Awareness & Escalation

Assess incoming requests to determine whether they can be met with existing ontology objects or require ontology changes
Route requests that would create, modify, or remove foundational ontology objects to the Change Management Priorities list for further assessment
Escalate reporting risks, data issues, or unresolved stakeholder needs to the OCM
Support the OCM in maintaining a clear view of reporting and dashboard requests across the organization




Requirements:

1-3 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, data analysis, or database-related work
Strong working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying structured data to investigate business questions and produce reporting outputs
Experience working with relational data, databases, or business intelligence platforms
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an unclear business question and determine what information is needed to answer it
Clear, professional communication skills, with the ability to explain data and reporting concepts to non-technical audiences
Personable and collaborative, comfortable interacting with developers, business leaders, and employees at all levels
Comfort working with ambiguity and evolving processes
Experience in the construction industry is an asset
Exposure to Palantir Foundry, including tools such as Workshop, Quiver, or Contour, is an asset but not required; training will be provided on the job




Cavanagh Employee Benefits:

Family oriented work environment
Attractive, competitive compensation for qualified candidates
Internal growth opportunities
Training and development opportunities
Benefit, Wellness and Pension Plans




Wage Range:

The salary range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $65K and $90K per year. However, the range offered is based on local job market factors and may vary further depending on factors specific to the selected job candidate, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

We may use AI-enabled tools to support a fair and efficient recruitment process. All results are reviewed by a Recruiter. Please contact Human Resources if you have any questions.

They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. Title: Analyste principal de données / Senior Data Analyst - CX
Description:
Aperçu du poste :

Genetec recherche actuellement un analyste principal de données pour son organisation dédiée à l'expérience client (CX). Nous recherchons une personne dynamique et réactive, capable de s'épanouir dans un environnement dynamique et animé, et de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables.

À ce poste, le candidat apportera son soutien à l'équipe CX Shared Services (CXSS) en jouant un rôle clé dans l'ensemble du cycle de vie des activités de reporting et d'analyse, depuis la collecte des besoins et l'extraction des données jusqu'à la création et la diffusion de rapports automatisés. Ce poste permettra à l'organisation CX de Genetec de se démarquer en fournissant à ses collaborateurs des indicateurs détaillés, des analyses et des calculs approfondis et précis, ainsi que des présentations claires facilitant la prise de décision. Ces rapports, analyses et présentations seront étroitement liés aux performances de nos opérations CX, les données provenant de bases de données issues de différents systèmes (CRM, ERP, portail Web, IVR, chat, etc.). Ce poste exige de solides compétences en matière d'intégration, de validation et d'interprétation des données.



Votre journée en un coup d'oeil :

Recueillir les besoins en matière d'analyses, de rapports et de présentations auprès des différentes parties prenantes au sein de l'organisation CX et les traduire en spécifications techniques
Concevoir et fournir des rapports, des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et des visualisations, en garantissant l'intégrité des données provenant de multiples sources
Extraire, compiler et agréger des données issues de multiples sources afin de les présenter sous un format simple et intuitif, qui sera utilisé dans les rapports et les présentations
Compiler les exigences relatives aux rapports récurrents en vue de leur automatisation dans Power BI et participer à leur test une fois développés
Élaborer et exécuter des plans de test, résoudre les problèmes et améliorer en continu les rapports et tableaux de bord BI
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes et les équipes techniques internes (par exemple, Digital Information) pour garantir la livraison en temps voulu des modèles de données, une communication claire et la résolution des obstacles
Contribuer à la production de rapports ponctuels et ad hoc basés sur des données provenant de différentes sources
Travailler en collaboration avec différents services pour garantir l'exactitude des rapports
Travailler simultanément sur plusieurs initiatives et hiérarchiser les tâches en fonction des livrables à venir

Ce poste exige un grand souci du détail, la capacité à synthétiser des informations et à les présenter sous une forme simple et claire, tant au niveau de la mise en page que de la présentation, tout en sachant les communiquer de manière claire et concise.



Ce qui fait de vous un excellent candidat :

Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, finance ou gestion d'entreprise avec une formation en analyse opérationnelle, ou expérience équivalente
Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente
Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine du reporting ou de l'analyse
Excellentes compétences analytiques et de présentation
Solides compétences organisationnelles
Bonnes compétences en gestion du temps et en hiérarchisation des priorités
Orientation client
Capacité à travailler sous pression et à respecter des délais stricts
Motivation à travailler dans un environnement dynamique
Capacité à travailler aussi bien en équipe qu'en autonomie
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit (ce poste nécessite des interactions avec nos collaborateurs et clients internationaux)



Votre expertise technique :

Connaissances avancées de Power BI Desktop et intermédiaires de Power BI Service
Maîtrise approfondie du langage DAX (Data Analytics Expressions)
Expérience en extraction et manipulation de données à l'aide de requêtes SQL, de la fonction « Recherche avancée » de CRM et des rapports Power BI existants
Bonne maîtrise des concepts liés aux bases de données et au stockage de données
Connaissances avancées de la suite Microsoft (Word, Excel et PowerPoint)
La connaissance des systèmes CRM et Finance & Operations (MS Dynamics 365) est un atout



Voilà ce que nous offrons !

Régime de rémunération attrayant
Programme de remboursement des frais de formation
Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à un horaire de travail flexible
Repas subventionnés à notre incroyable Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Café et fruits gratuits à volonté
Espace de stationnement gratuit pour tous les employés
Centre de conditionnement physique sur place avec entraîneur personnel, ainsi que plusieurs ateliers de santé et de bien-être

Job Overview:

Genetec is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst for its Customer Experience (CX) organization. We are seeking a dynamic and responsive individual who can thrive in a fast-paced and lively environment and transform complex data into actionable insights. 

In this role, the candidate will support the CX Shared Services (CXSS) team as a key contributor to the entire lifecycle of reporting and analytics efforts—from gathering requirements and extracting data to creating and delivering automated reports. This role will help Genetec's CX organization distinguish itself by providing its team members with detailed metrics, in-depth and accurate data analysis and calculations, and clear presentations that drive decision-making. These reports, analyses, and presentations will be closely related to the performance of our CX operations, with data sourced from databases across different systems (CRM, ERP, Web Portal, IVR, Chat, etc.). The Data Analyst plays a key role in driving data-informed decision-making across Scotiabank by transforming complex data into meaningful insights that support business strategy, operational excellence, and customer outcomes. Working closely with business partners, data engineers, and analytics teams, you will leverage data to uncover opportunities, solve business challenges, and deliver actionable recommendations that create measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights


Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
Translate data into clear recommendations that support strategic and operational decision-making.


Stakeholder Collaboration


Partner with business leaders across areas such as Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Risk, and Finance to understand business needs and objectives.
Translate business questions into analytical solutions and data-driven recommendations.
Present findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Support data governance initiatives and adherence to enterprise standards and best practices.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities.


Advanced Analytics & Innovation


Support predictive analytics, customer segmentation, performance measurement, and business improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers on advanced analytics and innovation projects.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting and enhance data processes.


What You'll Bring

Technical Skills


Strong SQL and data querying skills.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Advanced Excel proficiency.
Experience with Python or R is an asset.
Familiarity with cloud and data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake, Hadoop, GCP, or similar technologies.


Core Competencies


Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder relationship skills.


Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Financial services, banking, customer analytics, or risk analytics experience is considered an asset.


Why Join Scotiabank?


Work on high-impact projects that influence strategic business decisions.
Partner with diverse teams across one of Canada's leading financial institutions.
Gain exposure to modern analytics tools, cloud technologies, and enterprise-scale data environments.
Be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team to help build out the analytics and data infrastructure behind one of our newer business lines. You'll start by strengthening the production dashboards and data onboarding that our stakeholders rely on every day, then move into designing new data models largely from the ground up, helping shape what additional data sources could sharpen our analysis.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership: you'll work directly with stakeholders across the business to understand what they need, shape the data models and pipelines that get them there, and communicate your findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike. If you're energized by ambiguity, enjoy building something net new, and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You’ll Do


Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and onboarding data pipelines that our business stakeholders rely on.
Design and build out new data models largely from scratch, helping identify additional data sources that could strengthen our analysis.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis and reporting.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings, models, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We’re Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, i.e., Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience with consumer credit or lending analytics, ideally from a banking background.
Fintech or SaaS fintech experience is strongly preferred.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.
Python or another coding language.
Experience with dbt,Airflow, and Snowflake.


Why You’ll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership – opportunity to build your process and influence the company workforce and at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by leading a critical part of our customer experience.
You’ll have a broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - 125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst

Vacancies: This posting is for (1) new role

Location: Toronto, ON (Detailed office location information can be found by visiting this link: https://cancer.ca/en/contact-us)

Work Model: Hybrid Work Model

Salary Band: 5 ($70,000 - $75,000 CAD)

HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF CANCER CARE IN CANADA

The Canadian Cancer Society works tirelessly to save lives, improve lives and drive collective action against cancer. Together with patients, volunteers, donors and communities across the country, we raise funds to invest in transformative cancer research, we provide a caring support system for everyone affected by cancer and we advocate to governments to create a healthier future for all. It takes a society to take on cancer – and the Canadian Cancer Society is leading the way




MAKING AN IMPACT

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Governance and Analytics, the Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining analytics solutions, reports, and dashboards that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Leverage SQL, scripting, and modern analytics platforms to extract, transform, and analyze complex datasets, delivering actionable insights and recommendations that align with business goals
Partner with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and well-governed analytics solutions
Support a culture of data-driven decision-making by applying automation, engineering best practices, and modern design patterns to improve how data is analyzed, visualized, and utilized across the organization




What You’ll Be Doing




1.Analytics & Reporting Development

Report & Dashboard Development

Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using Salesforce CRM Analytics, Salesforce Reporting, and Power BI to support organization teams
Build and optimize semantic models and datasets to support business reporting and analytics needs
Optimize reporting and dashboard assets for usability, performance and accessibility

Analytics & Insights

Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities across business functions
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business teams
Use predictive models and statistical analyses to support donor segmentation, campaign targeting, and fundraising forecasting
Leverage advanced analytics techniques including propensity scoring, trend analysis, and cohort modeling to inform business strategy

Collaboration & Engagement

Partner with cross-functional teams including business partners, data engineers, and digital teams
Provide guidance and support to business users on reporting and analytics tools




2.Data Development & Transformation

Data Preparation & Processing

Extract, transform, and prepare analytical datasets using SQL, Python and scripting languages
Build and maintain reporting datasets, dataflows, and curated data assets incorporating key metrics and business data
Utilize enterprise data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric) as supporting data sources where required

Data Modeling & Documentation

Contribute to the design and optimization of data models that support reporting and analytics platforms
Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, data definitions, and analytical processes




3.Operational Excellence

Automation

Automate repetitive reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows using Python and scripting

DevOps

Utilize version control practices for analytics assets, reports, and code
Contribute to CI/CD processes for analytics solution deployment using Azure DevOps

Quality

Develop and maintain automated testing for reports, datasets, and analytics solutions
Support monitoring and validation of analytics pipelines and reporting processes
Apply development best practices including code quality, documentation, and peer review




4.Data Governance & Standards

Governance & Compliance

Apply data governance, compliance, and data quality standards when developing analytics solutions
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting outputs
Adhere to data privacy, security and compliance requirements (PII, PHI etc.)

Data Standards

Support adherence to established data policies, standards, and best practices




5.Other

Contribute to our culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging and equity (DIBE) by ensuring that all staff feel represented, valued, and heard across all aspects of their identity, including gender, age, religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and sexuality.
Other duties as assigned




QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline
More than 3 years, up to and including 5 years - similar or related general experience in progressively more important positions




Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and analytical dataset development
Proficiency in Python and/or scripting languages for data analysis and automation
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Salesforce Reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics and Power BI
Experience building and optimizing semantic models and analytical datasets
Experience working with Fabric to build and manage data pipelines, dataflows, automated workflows, and analytics solutions.
Understanding of data modeling concepts and relational database design
Others may apply




Operational Excellence

Experience with DevOps practices including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks
Experience automating reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows
Knowledge of Agile development practices including code quality, testing, documentation, and peer review
Experience developing and maintaining automated testing for analytics solutions and reports




Analytical Skills

Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable analytics solutions
Strong exploratory data analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Ability to identify trends, patterns, and insights from large and complex datasets
Experience with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, or data-driven segmentation techniques




Communication Skills

Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to present complex data findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience collaborating across business functions to support data-driven decision-making
Bilingualism (French/English) is highly preferred , with French being an asset due to the organization’s nationwide operations and the need for effective communication across various regions




What You Can Expect From Us

CCS provides impactful opportunities to transform the lives of Canadians affected by cancer. We are devoted to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates diverse experiences and skills, encouraging all qualified candidates to join us. Our inspiring culture is rooted in our core values and commitment to meaningful change: COURAGEOUS UNITED CARING RIGOROUS




COME AS YOU ARE

At CCS, we celebrate individuality and the strength of diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace that empowers everyone. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, including those from equity-deserving groups such as BIPOC, 2SLGBTQI+ communities, individuals with disabilities, veterans, and others who contribute to the richness of our organization. Together, we unite Canadians to shape the future of cancer care.




How To Apply

Qualified candidates are invited to submit their resume, cover letter, and salary expectations by August 27, 2026




Other Information

CCS is dedicated to employment equity and encourages applications from all qualified candidates . In accordance with the local provincial Accessibility Act, accommodation will be provided as requested throughout the recruitment process . For nearly 100 years, we have pioneered advancements in engine development, supporting cargo and equipment, transportation, wildfire suppression, and passenger travel.

Our expectations:

The Data analyst in the Spare parts department is responsible for automation and improvement of various reports. He also develops data analytics tools to detect and anticipate issues. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Lookout, Inc. is the leader in mobile AI security, delivering continuous threat exposure management for the modern, mobile-driven enterprise. Built on over 15 years of specialized expertise and informed by a global dataset analyzing hundreds of millions of mobile devices and applications, Lookout protects organizations against both behavioral and structural mobile risk.

Through its unified platform, featuring AI Visibility & Governance and the Mobile Software Exposure Center (MSEC), Lookout secures both sides of the mobile AI equation: governing user-to-AI interactions to prevent outbound data leakage while illuminating the mobile software supply chain to neutralize inbound, machine-speed vulnerabilities. By seamlessly feeding real-time mobile telemetry into broader enterprise CTEM and SOC workflows, Lookout closes the mobile exposure blind spot, enabling organizations to reduce risk and operate with confidence. To learn more, visit www.lookout.com and follow Lookout on LinkedIn and X.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead the company's reporting and analytics function. As the sole Data Analyst, this role serves as an internal analytics consultant, partnering with teams across the organization to turn business, product, and security data into actionable insights.

The Senior Data Analyst analyzes business operations, customer behavior, mobile application telemetry, and security event data to support decision-making, measure product performance, identify trends, and inform strategic planning. They also contribute to financial reporting, assisting with quarter-end close, invoicing and reconciliation. Success in this role requires advanced SQL skills, strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, independence, and excellent communication skills.

What You'll Do

Business, Product & Security Analytics


Develop and maintain executive dashboards and operational reports using Tableau.
Analyze and contextualize:
business metrics including revenue, customer growth, subscriptions, retention, product adoption, and operational performance.
mobile application telemetry, customer behavior, product usage, and feature adoption.
security event data to monitor threats, trends, anomalies, and product effectiveness.


Partner with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and Security Intelligence to address recurring and ad hoc analytical needs.
Define and monitor KPIs and identify trends and opportunities for business and product improvement.
Translate complex data findings into clear insights and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.



Data & Reporting


Write efficient SQL queries in AWS Athena to extract and analyze large datasets stored in Amazon S3.
Integrate data from multiple internal systems to develop meaningful reporting and analytical solutions.
Design, develop, publish, and maintain Tableau dashboards used throughout the organization.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
Document data sources, business rules, report definitions, and analytical methodologies.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and analysis.




Qualifications

Required


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience delivering analytics or business intelligence solutions in technology, mobile applications, cybersecurity, or a related environment.
Expert-level SQL proficiency and experience working with complex relational datasets.
Experience with AWS Athena or a similar cloud-based analytical query engine.
Advanced Tableau or equivalent BI platform experience.
Strong understanding of relational databases and data modeling.
Experience analyzing software product telemetry, application usage, or operational event data.
Experience working with large-scale datasets in cloud environments.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects with minimal supervision.




Preferred


Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis, data exploration, and automation.
Experience in cybersecurity, mobile applications, and/or SaaS.
Knowledge of data governance and data quality practices.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and workflows for automating reporting and analysis.




Success In This Role

Success in this role means becoming a trusted analytics partner across the organization. The Senior Data Analyst will deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights; proactively identify opportunities for improvement; and continuously enhance the company's reporting and analytical capabilities.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




This role follows our in‑office work model and requires employees to be onsite four days per week to support collaboration and business needs.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries
