Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team to help build out the analytics and data infrastructure behind one of our newer business lines. You'll start by strengthening the production dashboards and data onboarding that our stakeholders rely on every day, then move into designing new data models largely from the ground up, helping shape what additional data sources could sharpen our analysis.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership: you'll work directly with stakeholders across the business to understand what they need, shape the data models and pipelines that get them there, and communicate your findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike. If you're energized by ambiguity, enjoy building something net new, and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and onboarding data pipelines that our business stakeholders rely on.
  • Design and build out new data models largely from scratch, helping identify additional data sources that could strengthen our analysis.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis and reporting.
  • Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
  • Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
  • Communicate findings, models, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
  • Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.

What We’re Looking For

Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
  • Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with a BI tool, i.e., Tableau or Power BI.
  • A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
  • A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with consumer credit or lending analytics, ideally from a banking background.
  • Fintech or SaaS fintech experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.
  • Python or another coding language.
  • Experience with dbt,Airflow, and Snowflake.

Why You’ll Love It At Clutch

  • Autonomy & ownership – opportunity to build your process and influence the company workforce and at every level.
  • Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by leading a critical part of our customer experience.
  • You’ll have a broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
  • We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
  • Above market health & dental benefits.

Employment Type

  • New, Permanent Full-Time
  • Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary range: $100,000 - 125,000
  • Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
  • Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 268731

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Purpose

The Data Analyst plays a key role in driving data-informed decision-making across Scotiabank by transforming complex data into meaningful insights that support business strategy, operational excellence, and customer outcomes. Working closely with business partners, data engineers, and analytics teams, you will leverage data to uncover opportunities, solve business challenges, and deliver actionable recommendations that create measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights


Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
Translate data into clear recommendations that support strategic and operational decision-making.


Stakeholder Collaboration


Partner with business leaders across areas such as Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Risk, and Finance to understand business needs and objectives.
Translate business questions into analytical solutions and data-driven recommendations.
Present findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Data Quality & Governance


Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Support data governance initiatives and adherence to enterprise standards and best practices.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities.


Advanced Analytics & Innovation


Support predictive analytics, customer segmentation, performance measurement, and business improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers on advanced analytics and innovation projects.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting and enhance data processes.


What You'll Bring

Technical Skills


Strong SQL and data querying skills.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Advanced Excel proficiency.
Experience with Python or R is an asset.
Familiarity with cloud and data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake, Hadoop, GCP, or similar technologies.


Core Competencies


Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder relationship skills.


Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Financial services, banking, customer analytics, or risk analytics experience is considered an asset.


Why Join Scotiabank?


Work on high-impact projects that influence strategic business decisions.
Partner with diverse teams across one of Canada's leading financial institutions.
Gain exposure to modern analytics tools, cloud technologies, and enterprise-scale data environments.
Be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in…

The Data Analyst utilizes their quantitative analytical skills and scientific thought process to interpret and

analyze large sets of complex data, while extracting meaningful insights for Kabam. This role works

closely with our internal gaming team to optimize every facet of player retention and monetization to

ensure the continued success of our games.

This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.

Provide Cross-functional Support

In this role, you can expect to:


Collaborate with various teams across the organization to understand their business goals and data needs.
Improve reporting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting enhancements.
Assist with larger-scale projects as required, contributing data-driven insights.


Data Exploration And Analysis


Use SQL to extract and manipulate data from various sources.
Perform hands-on exploration of data sets to answer business questions.
Utilize statistical analysis to identify trends, correlations, and patterns within the data.
Create data visualizations to communicate findings effectively.


Dashboard And Report Management


Develop and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports tailored to the needs of different teams within the organization.
Ensure that dashboards and reports are up-to-date and accurate.
Prepare ad-hoc reports as requested.


A/B Testing


Design, execute, and manage multiple A/B tests to gain insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) such as retention, acquisition, and monetization.
Analyze the results of A/B tests to draw actionable conclusions.
Make data-driven recommendations for optimizing business strategies based on results of A/B testing.


Product Feature Analysis And Optimization


Measure the success of newly released product features using key metrics and data analysis.
Drive data-driven iteration and optimization of product features to enhance performance and user experience.


Task Prioritization And Project Management


Assist in task prioritization within the data team based on business needs and project requirements.
Collaborate with team members to achieve project goals efficiently.


To Be Successful In This Role, Your Background Includes


Bachelor’s Degree in related field.
3+ years of industry data analysis experience, with solid knowledge of statistical methods.
1+ years of industry data experience in games (mobile, console, PC), online casino, slot games, or any high volume B2C mobile apps.
Expert SQL skills and experience querying very large data sets.
Proven ability to thrive using multiple mixed, varied, and inconsistent data sources.
Fundamental knowledge of project management methodologies.
Regular communication with stakeholders from other departments and drive actionable items for continuous improvement.
Experience with Google BigQuery, Tableau, JIRA and/or other project management software.
Experience working for a social or mobile game developer.
Understanding of game design concepts and principles.


Benefits

Our success is due to the hard work of our people. We share our success with our people through flexible benefits and reward programs, sweet swag, snacks, and more. Here’s a look at some of the support we provide our people:


Extended Health Coverage: effective day one, no waiting period! Our benefits cover health, dental, life, disability, and extended paramedical services such as vision care, mental health practitioners, massage, physiotherapy, acupuncture, and much more.
DEIB Benefits: DEIB is important to us and to our people - that’s why our benefits include gender-affirming care, fertility care, and other hormonal treatments and drugs.
Flexible Spending Accounts: our benefits are built on a flex credit model, so you’re able to choose the coverage levels that are right for you, and allocate the rest to a group RRSP/TFSA, Health Spending account, and/or Personal Spending Account.
RRSP Matching: everyone retires eventually, and we help our people save for their futures with a contribution matching program once you reach 90 days with us.
Commuter Benefit: we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, and want to support you in making it work for you! We provide a flexible, monthly cash allowance to help cover the costs of transit, parking, or even personal logistics like childcare and pet care.
PTO and Parental Leave: we offer paid parental leave, flexible paid time off, paid time off for volunteering, sick leave, and holiday closures.
Employee and Family Assistance Program: this program provides crisis management support, immediate mental health care, and generalized support for emotional, mental, and financial well-being.
Telus Virtual Health: we provide increased access to remote healthcare providers for prescription refills or referrals from the comfort of your home.
Learning and growth: We encourage people to grow both personally and professionally, and support this through regular lunch & learns and an education stipend.
Pay transparency: We share with employees the pay range their role falls within and clear career maps to determine how they can grow within their role or level-up to a promotion.
Cool spaces: Our offices are in Vancouver, Montreal, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. Whether it’s summers on the rooftop patio in Downtown Vancouver, or watching the fireworks in Montreal’s South Shore - we want our people to feel like their time spent in office is worthwhile!
Giving back: Kabammers have a dedicated paid day off every year to volunteer to a cause close to their hearts. Some teams even band together for group volunteer days off-site!


$73,300 - $91,600 a year

The typical hiring range listed above is specific to candidates located in Vancouver. The salary will be determined based on your knowledge, skills and competencies, and you’ll have room to grow after you join!

If you’re interested in the position but your expectations don’t fully align with the provided range, we still encourage you to apply! Considerations may be made based on your experience level.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst

Vacancies: This posting is for (1) new role

Location: Toronto, ON (Detailed office location information can be found by visiting this link: https://cancer.ca/en/contact-us)

Work Model: Hybrid Work Model

Salary Band: 5 ($70,000 - $75,000 CAD)

HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF CANCER CARE IN CANADA

The Canadian Cancer Society works tirelessly to save lives, improve lives and drive collective action against cancer. Together with patients, volunteers, donors and communities across the country, we raise funds to invest in transformative cancer research, we provide a caring support system for everyone affected by cancer and we advocate to governments to create a healthier future for all. It takes a society to take on cancer – and the Canadian Cancer Society is leading the way




MAKING AN IMPACT

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Governance and Analytics, the Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining analytics solutions, reports, and dashboards that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Leverage SQL, scripting, and modern analytics platforms to extract, transform, and analyze complex datasets, delivering actionable insights and recommendations that align with business goals
Partner with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and well-governed analytics solutions
Support a culture of data-driven decision-making by applying automation, engineering best practices, and modern design patterns to improve how data is analyzed, visualized, and utilized across the organization




What You’ll Be Doing




1.Analytics & Reporting Development

Report & Dashboard Development

Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using Salesforce CRM Analytics, Salesforce Reporting, and Power BI to support organization teams
Build and optimize semantic models and datasets to support business reporting and analytics needs
Optimize reporting and dashboard assets for usability, performance and accessibility

Analytics & Insights

Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities across business functions
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business teams
Use predictive models and statistical analyses to support donor segmentation, campaign targeting, and fundraising forecasting
Leverage advanced analytics techniques including propensity scoring, trend analysis, and cohort modeling to inform business strategy

Collaboration & Engagement

Partner with cross-functional teams including business partners, data engineers, and digital teams
Provide guidance and support to business users on reporting and analytics tools




2.Data Development & Transformation

Data Preparation & Processing

Extract, transform, and prepare analytical datasets using SQL, Python and scripting languages
Build and maintain reporting datasets, dataflows, and curated data assets incorporating key metrics and business data
Utilize enterprise data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric) as supporting data sources where required

Data Modeling & Documentation

Contribute to the design and optimization of data models that support reporting and analytics platforms
Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, data definitions, and analytical processes




3.Operational Excellence

Automation

Automate repetitive reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows using Python and scripting

DevOps

Utilize version control practices for analytics assets, reports, and code
Contribute to CI/CD processes for analytics solution deployment using Azure DevOps

Quality

Develop and maintain automated testing for reports, datasets, and analytics solutions
Support monitoring and validation of analytics pipelines and reporting processes
Apply development best practices including code quality, documentation, and peer review




4.Data Governance & Standards

Governance & Compliance

Apply data governance, compliance, and data quality standards when developing analytics solutions
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting outputs
Adhere to data privacy, security and compliance requirements (PII, PHI etc.)

Data Standards

Support adherence to established data policies, standards, and best practices




5.Other

Contribute to our culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging and equity (DIBE) by ensuring that all staff feel represented, valued, and heard across all aspects of their identity, including gender, age, religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and sexuality.
Other duties as assigned




QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline
More than 3 years, up to and including 5 years - similar or related general experience in progressively more important positions




Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and analytical dataset development
Proficiency in Python and/or scripting languages for data analysis and automation
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Salesforce Reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics and Power BI
Experience building and optimizing semantic models and analytical datasets
Experience working with Fabric to build and manage data pipelines, dataflows, automated workflows, and analytics solutions.
Understanding of data modeling concepts and relational database design
Others may apply




Operational Excellence

Experience with DevOps practices including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks
Experience automating reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows
Knowledge of Agile development practices including code quality, testing, documentation, and peer review
Experience developing and maintaining automated testing for analytics solutions and reports




Analytical Skills

Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable analytics solutions
Strong exploratory data analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Ability to identify trends, patterns, and insights from large and complex datasets
Experience with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, or data-driven segmentation techniques




Communication Skills

Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to present complex data findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience collaborating across business functions to support data-driven decision-making
Bilingualism (French/English) is highly preferred , with French being an asset due to the organization’s nationwide operations and the need for effective communication across various regions




What You Can Expect From Us

CCS provides impactful opportunities to transform the lives of Canadians affected by cancer. We are devoted to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates diverse experiences and skills, encouraging all qualified candidates to join us. Our inspiring culture is rooted in our core values and commitment to meaningful change: COURAGEOUS UNITED CARING RIGOROUS




COME AS YOU ARE

At CCS, we celebrate individuality and the strength of diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace that empowers everyone. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, including those from equity-deserving groups such as BIPOC, 2SLGBTQI+ communities, individuals with disabilities, veterans, and others who contribute to the richness of our organization. Together, we unite Canadians to shape the future of cancer care.




How To Apply

Qualified candidates are invited to submit their resume, cover letter, and salary expectations by August 27, 2026




Other Information

CCS is dedicated to employment equity and encourages applications from all qualified candidates . In accordance with the local provincial Accessibility Act, accommodation will be provided as requested throughout the recruitment process . We want to make the interview process a great experience for you!




Privacy Disclosure

We collect your personal information through forms, by phone or in person to evaluate your candidacy for the role(s) you have applied for, to contact you regarding your candidacy, and to generate recruitment-related reports. If selected for a position at CCS the information provided will be used for the purposes of pre-employment checks and added to your employee file. We may share your personal information with third parties, including recruitment consultants, within or outside your province or territory or outside Canada to carry out the purposes identified above, or as required by law. We may contact you by mail, email, phone or text. You can exercise your right to access your information or have it corrected, unsubscribe from communications or withdraw your consent by selecting these options within the ADP system, or by contacting privacy@cancer.ca . For more information about our privacy practices, visit cancer.ca/privacy.




AI Disclosure

We are committed to transparency and, the responsible use of technology in our hiring process. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used to assist with certain administrative or screening tasks; however, all hiring decisions are made by people. We review and approve AI-assisted outputs to ensure fairness, accuracy, and alignment with our values. For more information about our privacy practices, visit cancer.ca/privacy .

Title: Analyste sénior en intelligence d'affaires
HTML:
Sous la supervision de la Directrice-adjointe analyse, l'analyste en intelligence d'affaires senior jouera un rôle clé dans la conception de tableaux de bord, l'analyse de tendances et la production de prévisions basées sur les données. Il/Elle contribuera à la définition, la mise en place et l'évolution des indicateurs de performance, des mesures, des tableaux de bord et des schémas de données nécessaires au déploiement de l'intelligence d'affaires d'AGA.

L'analyste sera également responsable de promouvoir et d'assurer l'application de bonnes pratiques en matière de gestion et d'utilisation sécuritaire des données. Le développement de relations solides, tant avec les collègues multidisciplinaires de l'équipe qu'avec les clients internes sur le terrain, demeure essentiel pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Le·la titulaire de ce poste sera, entre autres, appelé à :

  • Collecter, transformer, nettoyer et organiser les données provenant de différentes sources internes, en veillant à leur qualité et à leur cohérence;
  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et rapports à l'aide d'outils de visualisation comme Power BI ou outils similaires;
  • Accompagner les équipes dans la gestion du changement lors de l'implantation de nouvelles solutions, notamment par la formation et la documentation;
  • Proposer et réaliser des analyses descriptives et exploratoires pour identifier des tendances, infos pertinentes, anomalies ou opportunités;
  • Collaborer avec l'ensemble des équipes métiers AGA (actuariat, finances, opérations, marketing, etc.) afin de comprendre leurs besoins, analyser leurs flux de travail afin de proposer des solutions et identifier des axes d'amélioration basées sur les données;
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de gestion de données et de production de rapports;
  • Documenter les méthodologies, les besoins, les indicateurs de performance, les mesures, les tableaux de bord, les schémas de données, les sources de données, les processus afin d'assurer la traçabilité et la fiabilité des analyses;
  • Déterminer les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), élaborer les mesures nécessaires à l'évaluation de la performance, analyser l'évolution des résultats et développer des modèles prévisionnels lorsque requis;
  • Effectuer des analyses ad hoc ou extraire des listes de données selon les besoins;
  • Documenter et mettre à jour de façon quotidienne et systématique l'ensemble de ses tâches et projets dans JIRA, afin d'assurer un suivi clair et en temps réel de l'avancement;
  • Créer et maintenir des flux Power Automate;
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe de même nature et en relation directe avec cet emploi ou à la demande de son supérieur.

Le·la candidat·e idéal·e possède ce qui suit:

Formation et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances, intelligence d’affaires, informatique / sciences informatiques / informatique de gestion, gestion de l'information ou Baccalauréat d’ingénieur (génie informatique / génie des technologies de l’information) et/ou d’ingénierie et analytique des données (Maîtrise est un atout);
  • 5-7 ans d’expérience en analyse de données, prévisions et création de tableaux de bord;
  • Expérience en assurances collectives est un atout.

Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise de Power BI;
  • Maîtrise d’Excel, de la suite Office et de SQL;
  • Compétences mathématiques et/ou académiques nécessaires pour recueillir, mesurer, organiser et analyser des données et effectuer des prévisions statistiques;
  • Capacité à transformer des données brutes en informations utiles et compréhensibles;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, pour collaborer efficacement avec nos équipes partout au Canada;
  • Connaissance de Power Automate un atout;
  • Connaissance de Power BI Report Builder un atout;
  • Familiarité avec un langage de programmation analytique (Python ou R) un atout;
  • Connaissance de base de JIRA et de Confluence un atout.

Qualités personnelles et professionnelles

  • Esprit analytique développé et grande rigueur;
  • Forte curiosité analytique et esprit critique pour proposer des axes d’analyse innovants et des visualisations percutantes;
  • Excellent sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités;
  • Aptitude à travailler en équipe et à communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs non techniques (vulgarisation des calculs ou des résultats);
  • Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité des données.

About The Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager – Supply Chain & Logistics, the Logistics Data Analyst plays a critical role in transforming warehouse, distribution, inventory, and service parts data into actionable insights that drive measurable operational improvements.

This role supports Enercare's supply chain strategy by developing dashboards, analyzing operational performance, improving inventory accuracy, and enabling data-driven decision-making across logistics, warehousing, and field service operations. The successful candidate brings strong analytical rigor, curiosity for operational processes, and the ability to convert complex datasets into meaningful recommendations that improve service levels, productivity, inventory management, and customer outcomes.

Accountabilities

Performance Management & Reporting


Develop, maintain, and continuously improve operational dashboards and performance reporting related to inventory accuracy, replenishment effectiveness, Parts on Truck (POT%), technician productivity, and other key logistics KPIs.
Transform large and complex datasets into actionable insights and recommendations for operational leaders and stakeholders.


Inventory Accuracy & Control


Redesign and manage ABC, control-group, and random cycle count programs; conduct gap analysis; establish counting frequencies; and recommend SOP improvements to improve inventory accuracy and compliance.
Support root-cause investigations and corrective actions related to inventory variances, stock discrepancies, and transaction integrity.


Warehouse & Distribution Analytics


Analyze warehouse and distribution material flow (receiving → put-away → storage → picking → packing → shipping) to identify bottlenecks, reduce cycle times, and improve operational efficiency.
Monitor inventory movement, aged inventory, and replenishment performance and recommend actions to improve service levels and reduce working capital.


Parts & Field Service Analytics


Conduct truck stock and service parts analytics, including usage modeling, min/max optimization, seasonality reviews, replenishment cadence evaluation, and standard truck stock recommendations aligned to 80/20 principles.
Develop insights and recommendations that improve Parts on Truck (POT%), parts availability, technician productivity, and First-Time-Fix performance.


Continuous Improvement & Automation


Support continuous improvement, Lean, and 5S initiatives by translating KPI trends into practical operational improvements, standard work, and visual management solutions.
Monitor, validate, and maintain analytical tools, dashboards, and automated reports to ensure data integrity and usability.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve data quality, and eliminate manual processes.


Ad Hoc Analysis & Business Support


Deliver high-quality, decision-grade analytics to support operations, procurement, supply planning, and cross-functional business initiatives.
Collaborate with operational leaders to identify performance gaps and develop actionable solutions.


Operational Flexibility


This role will evolve with the needs of the business. The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate flexibility and agility by taking on additional duties, special projects, and cross-functional responsibilities as assigned to support organizational objectives, operational priorities, and continuous improvement initiatives.


KPIs You Will Influence


Inventory Accuracy (%)
Cycle Count Compliance (%)
Variance Closure Time
Parts Replenishment Stability
Min/Max Adherence
Parts on Truck (POT%)
Technician Productivity
Inventory Availability and Fill Rate
Aged Inventory Reduction
Improvements correlated to First-Visit - Rate (FVR) through optimized truck stock and parts availability


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related discipline.
4-7+ years of experience in warehouse, distribution, inventory, or supply chain analytics with a demonstrated history of improving operational KPIs.
Proficiency with ERP, WMS, and reporting systems; SAP experience is considered a strong asset.
Advanced Excel skills and experience using Power BI for dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience working with SQL, Power Query, or other data analysis and transformation tools is considered an asset.
Experience cleaning, transforming, validating, and analyzing large operational datasets.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to develop structured, pragmatic, and actionable analytical approaches.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of logistics operations, including inventory control, replenishment, receiving, warehousing, picking, shipping, and supplier performance management.
Familiarity with Lean principles, 5S, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Job Description Summary

We are seeking an Analyst, Business Intelligence to support the design, development, and maintenance of interactive dashboards and reports for Inventory Management stakeholders. Responsibilities

Job Description


Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for Inventory Management processes (e.g., inventory health, stock levels, turns, aging, service levels, fill rate, OTIF, and KPI tracking).

Document data models, report logic, KPIs, and business definitions related to inventory management.
Provide training and support to end-users on Power BI dashboards and self-service inventory analytics capabilities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory optimization, working capital reduction, and service level performance.
Leverage Python for advanced data analysis, automation, and data transformation (e.g., building data pipelines, performing complex calculations, and enhancing Power BI datasets through integrated workflows).

3–5 years of experience in BI/reporting roles, with at least 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Power BI.
Strong proficiency in:
Power BI Desktop & Service
Power Query (M language)
Data modeling concepts
Solid understanding of Inventory Management and accounting principles.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Experience integrating data from ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.) is an asset.
Hands-on experience with Power BI Service, including workspace management and deployment pipelines.
Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric (Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, or related components) is an asset.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Title: Analyste des données commerciales et digitales / Business and Online Data Analyst
Description:
Votre mission

Au sein de l'équipe Business Intelligence et Performance, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'analyse de la performance commerciale et digitale de l'entreprise. Grâce à votre expertise analytique et votre maîtrise des outils de reporting, vous transformez les données en informations stratégiques permettant d'orienter les décisions et d'optimiser les performances.

Vous contribuez également à l'amélioration continue des outils, des processus et de la qualité des données, dans un environnement collaboratif et omnicanal.

Principales responsabilités

Analyse et suivi de la performance commerciale


Assurer une compréhension approfondie de la performance globale de l'activité et des principaux leviers opérationnels.
Produire, analyser et présenter les reportings bimensuels et mensuels destinés aux équipes et à la direction.
Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles afin de soutenir les priorités opérationnelles et les décisions stratégiques.
Accompagner les exercices de prévision, les revues d'activité et le suivi de la performance grâce à l'analyse des données.
Garantir la fiabilité, la cohérence et la qualité des indicateurs, rapports et tableaux de bord.


Analyse de la performance digitale


Suivre et analyser les performances des différents canaux digitaux (site web, campagnes médias, SEO, CRM, etc.).
Concevoir, développer et optimiser les tableaux de bord de suivi de la performance digitale.
Veiller à la qualité du suivi et de la collecte des données en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et les parties prenantes concernées.
Réaliser des analyses approfondies sur les performances des campagnes, des promotions et des tendances de marché.
Présenter régulièrement les résultats et recommandations aux équipes métiers et aux partenaires internes.
Participer à des projets digitaux internationaux et transverses.


Gestion des données et amélioration continue


Extraire, analyser, valider et interpréter les données à l'aide d'outils tels que BigQuery et SQL.
Maintenir et faire évoluer les outils de reporting et les processus d'analyse existants.
Répondre aux besoins quotidiens en matière d'analyses et de reporting des différentes équipes.
Contribuer aux projets liés à l'omnicanalité, à la business intelligence et à la transformation de la donnée.
Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités d'amélioration visant à optimiser les processus de reporting et la qualité des données.


Profil recherché

Formation et expérience


Formation universitaire en analyse de données, statistiques, informatique, finance, marketing analytique ou domaine connexe.
Expérience significative dans un rôle d'analyse de données, de business intelligence ou de performance digitale.


Compétences techniques


Excellente maîtrise de SQL et de BigQuery.
Solide expérience dans la création et l'optimisation de tableaux de bord via Power BI, Looker ou des outils similaires.
Maîtrise avancée d'Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, formules complexes, automatisations et macros).
Bonne connaissance des outils d'analyse digitale tels que Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager ou équivalents.


Compétences personnelles


Forte capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes.
Rigueur, souci du détail et sens de l'organisation.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en présentation de données.
Capacité à vulgariser des analyses complexes et à influencer la prise de décision.
Aisance à travailler en mode transversal dans un environnement dynamique et omnicanal.
Esprit collaboratif, curiosité et orientation résultats.


Atouts


Expérience dans les environnements e-commerce, marketing digital ou omnicanaux.
Connaissance des outils de visualisation et d'analyse avancée de données.
Expérience dans un contexte international ou multi-marchés.

Conduct in-depth analyses of campaign performance, promotional activities, customer trends, and digital initiatives.
Present performance results, insights, and recommendations to business and cross-functional teams.
Participate in global and cross-functional digital projects as required.

Title: Senior Operations Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
Your opportunity

By joining the Kardium team, you can help make a difference in the lives of millions around the world. We have developed a ground-breaking medical device for the diagnosis and treatment of the most common heart rhythm disorder, atrial fibrillation – which can cause stroke, heart failure, and other heart-related complications.

Kardium’s mission is to deliver the best treatment for atrial fibrillation. To achieve this, we have developed The Globe® Pulsed Field System – we have a fantastic technical team that has developed a product with strong, unique, and customer-valued differentiators versus other solutions on the market. We have built connections with key opinion leaders who are already using the Globe System and are helping to tell our story.

We have obtained FDA approval and officially begun the commercial launch of the Globe® Pulsed Field System. This is a pivotal and exciting time in our journey, as we bring this life-changing technology to patients!

We are seeking an Operational Analyst who you will be responsible for delivering high-impact dashboards, metrics and reporting across various operational teams. You will play a critical role in enabling real-time operational visibility and data-informed decision-making, supporting both daily execution and strategic planning initiatives. The analyst will work cross-functionally with operations, purchasing, and quality teams, with a strong focus on data quality and continuity during our transition to Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP system.

Please note, this opportunity is a hybrid work arrangement, located in Burnaby, BC.

Meaningful work you will be a part of

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Develop and maintain critical operational metrics and key process indicators (KPIs) to support manufacturing, planning, and quality functions
Create and manage visual dashboards to provide real time insight into operational performance using tools such as Power BI and Excel
Provide analytical support for continuous improvement initiatives and projects to identify and prioritize optimization opportunities for cost reduction and performance improvements.
Query and extract relevant data from ERP and other data sources using SQL or other relevant tools.
Partner with cross-functional teams to identify data requirements and alignment with operational goals
Collaborate with stakeholders to develop scalable reporting frameworks and templates to support future growth.
Advise on data architecture and structure as systems evolve and new systems introduced, ensuring the right data is collected and accessible.
Lead initiatives to improve data quality and governance, identifying gaps and implementing data validation processes.
Train and support end-users in interpreting dashboard data and utilizing insights for decision-making.
Ensure data security and compliance with relevant regulations and company policies.


What You Bring To The Team

Our Kardium team is smart, creative, and passionate about developing cutting-edge medical devices to help improve people’s lives. We work in a collaborative environment based on trust and respect. We understand that only by working together can we solve what was thought unsolvable.

You will be successful in this role because you possess these attributes:


Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years experience in data analytics or reporting in a manufacturing or supply chain environment.
Advanced skills in Power BI, SQL and Excel.
Highly analytic and data driven with the ability to organize data and derive conclusions
Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dashboards and reporting systems used by cross-functional teams.
Strong understanding of operational process (manufacturing, supply chain) as well as key operations metrics (e.g., OEE, throughput, inventory turns, supplier performance).
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working with ERP systems (Microsoft D365 or equivalent is a strong asset).
Knowledge and experience working in the regulated manufacturing industry is an asset.


Compensation

Kardium has listed the total cash compensation range (base salary + 5% RRSP contribution) that we expect to pay applicants for this role, as of the time of this posting. Pay offered will be determined based on numerous relevant business and candidate factors including, for example, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, and business or organizational needs. For candidates with more or less experience than listed above, the pay range will be adjusted.

As a permanent employee, you will also participate in Kardium’s stock option plan.


$90,000 – 125,000 (CAD Annually)


Your Benefits & Well-being

The total cash we’ve listed for this position includes a base salary, plus an annual contribution to a Retirement Savings Plan account to help support your financial goals.

Comprehensive medical & dental coverage for all permanent employees – effective as of Day 1, with no waiting period.

Work-day flexibility – we offer a flexible work environment for daily working hours. In addition, we provide 3 personal days per year.

Support for you (and your dependents) overall well-being.

Family building – we provide top up for maternity leave, adoptive leave, and parental leave for non-birthing parents. Employees can also enroll in benefit coverage for fertility drug treatment.

Career progression and learning support.

Professional membership support.

Life at Kardium

What makes us a great place to work?


Our Purpose
Our People
Our Culture


At Kardium, we embrace diversity of background, experience, and perspective and we’re committed to inclusion and equity at every level. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates who represent the full diversity of all communities.

We collaborate with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), as volunteer-led groups who share a common dimension of diversity and come together to provide support, education, and other opportunities across Kardium. Examples of our ERGs include Women ERG, Pride ERG, Race Ethnicity & Cultural Heritage (REACH) ERG, Truth & Reconciliation ERG, Persian ERG, Chinese ERG, Barangay Kardium (Filipino) ERG, Irish ERG, Brazilian ERG, and Early Career at Kardium ERG.

As part of your application, we encourage you to note if you require an accommodation for the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials, accessible meeting rooms or other accommodations). There will be an optional section in the application form where you can provide this information to the recruitment team.

Job title: Analyst, Benchmarking & Data Analytics

Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties

2+ years of professional or military experience

Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience

Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience

3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

Financial services or other regulated industry experience.

Enercare is the Experts at Home, operating under several brands including Enercare, HydroSolution, and Pioneer Plumbing & Heating.

We value a diverse, collaborative culture, and take pride in our commitment to health and safety, and knowing our work serves and supports our communities every day. No matter your role, we invest in making sure you have opportunities to grow, learn, and become the Expert you want to be.




Role: Workforce Management Analyst

Status: Full-Time

Reporting To: Manager - Workforce Management

Location: Niagara/Markham

Compensation: $59,564 - $95,302




Please note that the compensation range listed includes base salary and potential incentive pay. Incentives such as bonuses are not guaranteed and depend on individual performance and company results. Actual compensation within the range will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.




Job Summary

We are seeking an analytical and forward-thinking Workforce Analyst to support workforce planning for a Home Services contact center. This role is responsible for developing accurate call volume forecasts, staffing models, and capacity plans that enable the organization to achieve customer experience, service level, and cost objectives.




The primary focus of this role is leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI), predictive analytics, and advanced Microsoft Excel modeling to improve forecasting accuracy and uncover actionable business insights. The successful candidate will use AI-powered tools and forecasting technologies to identify trends, detect anomalies, model demand drivers, evaluate scenarios, and generate data-driven staffing recommendations. While workforce management experience is important, we are specifically seeking candidates who embrace AI as a strategic forecasting tool and understand how to combine AI-generated insights with operational expertise and human judgment.




This position is ideal for an intermediate-to-senior workforce professional who has experience using AI solutions, advanced analytics, and Excel-based forecasting techniques to solve complex workforce planning challenges in a high-volume contact center environment.




Key Responsibilities




AI-Driven Forecasting & Predictive Analytics

Utilize AI-powered forecasting tools and predictive analytics platforms to improve call volume forecasting accuracy.
Leverage machine learning and AI-generated insights to identify emerging trends, seasonality patterns, demand drivers, and operational risks.
Evaluate AI-generated forecasts and apply business knowledge to validate assumptions and refine outputs.
Use AI tools to automate data analysis, trend identification, anomaly detection, and forecast variance investigations.
Integrate traditional forecasting methodologies with AI-driven recommendations to create accurate and actionable demand plans.
Continuously assess new AI technologies and forecasting capabilities that can improve workforce planning effectiveness.




Forecasting & Capacity Planning

Develop monthly, weekly, daily, and interval-level forecasts for inbound contact center demand.
Analyze historical call volumes, AHT, service levels, customer behavior, marketing activity, weather impacts, and operational changes to support forecasting decisions.
Translate forecasted workload into staffing requirements, productive hours, schedules, and FTE recommendations.
Create multiple forecast scenarios to assess business impacts and staffing risks.
Monitor forecast accuracy and identify opportunities to improve forecasting models and assumptions.




Business Intelligence & Data Analysis

Combine AI-generated insights with advanced Excel analysis to deliver workforce recommendations.
Build dashboards, forecasting models, and reporting tools that support data-driven decision-making.
Utilize large datasets to uncover trends, root causes, and performance improvement opportunities.
Present findings and recommendations to Operations, Workforce Management, and senior leadership.




Required Qualifications

4–7+ years of Workforce Management, Forecasting, Capacity Planning, Workforce Analytics, or Contact Center Operations experience.
Demonstrated experience using Artificial Intelligence, predictive analytics tools, machine learning platforms, or AI-assisted forecasting solutions to support business planning and forecasting decisions.
Advanced Microsoft Excel expertise, including forecasting models, Power Query, Pivot Tables, statistical analysis, scenario modeling, and data visualization.
Experience translating demand forecasts into staffing plans and workforce recommendations.
Strong understanding of contact center metrics including call volume, AHT, service level, ASA, occupancy, shrinkage, and forecast accuracy.
Proven ability to evaluate AI-generated recommendations and apply business judgment to improve forecast outcomes.




Preferred Qualifications

Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, or similar platforms) to support forecasting analysis, reporting, trend identification, and productivity improvements.
Advanced Microsoft Excel capability, including the ability to build and maintain complex forecasting and staffing models.
Experience working with predictive analytics, machine learning models, or advanced forecasting software.
Knowledge of Power BI, SQL, Python, R, or other analytical tools used in workforce planning environments.
Experience implementing AI-driven process improvements or automation initiatives within Workforce Management functions.




Core Technical Competencies




AI-Assisted Forecasting & Predictive Analytics

Machine learning forecasting concepts
Predictive modeling
AI-driven trend analysis
Pattern recognition
Forecast optimization
Anomaly detection
Scenario modeling
Data interpretation and validation




Advanced Microsoft Excel Forecasting

Statistical forecasting models
Trend and seasonality analysis
Forecast accuracy measurement
Driver-based forecasting
Workforce capacity calculations
Power Query and data transformation
Advanced formulas and automation




Workforce Planning & Contact Center Analytics

Staffing requirement calculations
Capacity planning
Erlang concepts
Shrinkage modeling
Service level forecasting
Intraday planning
Forecast performance analysis

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Citylitics Inc.

Citylitics delivers predictive intelligence on where, how, and why infrastructure investments will occur across North America.

Infrastructure includes the foundational systems that shape our quality of life: water, transportation, transit, roads and highways, broadband, and power. It represents a multi-trillion-dollar market and a 20+ year megatrend in North America.

Citylitics transforms millions of documents across more than 40,000 cities, utilities, and public agencies into real-time market signals and high-value sales intelligence. Leading infrastructure vendors, engineering firms, and construction companies use the platform to identify and pre-position for major infrastructure opportunities earlier, helping them build relationships, shape project priorities, and influence scope before projects move to formal procurement.

Citylitics combines a network of AI agents, fine-tuned models, a proprietary infrastructure signals graph, and daily human-in-the-loop quality assurance workflows to deliver highly nuanced and reliable sales intelligence. The platform integrates seamlessly with CRMs, ERPs, and data lakes, embedding actionable insights directly into sales workflows so teams can prioritize the right pursuits and build stronger pipelines.

Our mission is to improve how infrastructure investments get made so critical needs can be addressed earlier and communities benefit from stronger, more resilient infrastructure.

Join Citylitics to work in a meaningful industry that will matter for decades to come while helping grow a company at the forefront of applied AI. We operate with a Results-Driven Mentality and a commitment to Raise The Bar, in a collaborative environment where Teamwork Makes the Dream Work as we tackle big challenges and celebrate wins together.

Who Are We Looking For?

Citylitics is looking for a Data Analyst to own our Custom Solutions practice. You'll scope and deliver client-specific data requests that don't fit our standard product.

You will partner directly with Sales, Customer Success, Product and leadership to triage incoming requests, assess feasibility before anything is promised to a client, query and validate data in BigQuery, and build the one-off dashboards or reports that answer a client's actual question.

This role fits someone analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, and disciplined about scope. You size up a vague ask fast, align stakeholders when it's over-committed, and educate clients on data availability and nuances while developing solution options to discuss with them. Once you've validated an approach with the customer, you hand the engineering work to the team. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need enough confidence in SQL and data structures to know what's realistic. You're also comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret what the results mean. You move quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing.

This role is based in our downtown Toronto office and requires 3+ days in-office per week.

Vacancy Status: This position is for an existing and active vacancy that Citylitics is currently seeking to fill.

What Will You Accomplish?

Triage and Scope Custom Solution Requests

You will own the front door for custom solutions requests, deciding what's worth committing to before it reaches a client.

Responsibilities include:


Field new custom-solution requests from Sales and Customer Success as they come in (Slack, demo follow-ups, live calls)
Assess feasibility and turnaround before anything is committed to a client
Align stakeholders when a request is over-scoped or under-priced
Educate clients on data availability and nuances
Develop solution options to discuss with the client before committing to delivery


Query, Validate, and Build One-Off Deliverables

You will do the actual data work behind each request, once it's been scoped.

Responsibilities include:


Query BigQuery to test and validate client-specific hypotheses
Build or update lightweight dashboards (Looker, etc) for one-off client deliverables
Disambiguate against existing coverage to avoid duplicating work


Hand Off to Engineering Once Customer Validation Is Achieved

You validate the approach with the customer before engineering builds it.

Responsibilities include:


Write up findings and requirements clients or account teams can act on directly
Hand off anything requiring pipeline or scraper-level work to engineering, with a clear spec
Surface it immediately when a client's own criteria don't hold up
Other duties as assigned


Requirements

Must-Have Experience


2+ years of experience in data analysis, solutions consulting, business analysis, or a similar role
Strong SQL fluency (BigQuery a plus), comfortable self-serve querying
Scopes an ambiguous request before diving in and defines what "done" looks like from the start
Strong written and verbal communication for client-facing summaries
Comfortable working directly with clients or internal commercial teams under a fast turnaround pace
Comfortable presenting data findings and methodology directly to clients and helping them interpret results, not just retrieving data
Moves quickly and decisively, without overanalyzing


Nice-to-Have Experience


Enough SQL/notebook fluency to spec engineering work credibly (not to build it)

Citylitics delivers predictive intelligence on where, how, and why infrastructure investments will occur across North America.

Infrastructure includes the foundational systems that shape our quality of life: water, transportation, transit, roads and highways, broadband, and power. It represents a multi-trillion-dollar market and a 20+ year megatrend in North America.

Title: Data Delivery Lead
Description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.

We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.

We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

OUR MISSION

Robotics will become the largest industry in human history — larger than anything that has come before it. As intelligent machines move into the physical world, they will dramatically expand global GDP, raise the material standard of living for everyone, and ultimately help make humanity a multiplanetary civilization. None of that happens without one thing: enormous amounts of high-quality, real-world data.

Mecka AI builds that foundation. We are the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI — the substrate that teaches machines to perceive, reason, and act in reality. Get this right, and we accelerate the most important technological transition of our time.

OUR CULTURE

Excellence as the baseline. We hold an extremely high bar and expect the best work of your career. Mediocrity isn't interesting to us.

Highly technical. We reason from first principles, not by analogy. The best argument wins — regardless of title or tenure.

Truth-seeking. We are relentlessly honest with ourselves and each other. We chase reality — measured, not assumed — and kill our own bad ideas fast.

Maniacal urgency. The work matters and the clock is real. We move fast, ship, measure, and iterate.

Extreme ownership. You own outcomes end-to-end — no hand-offs, no excuses, no waiting for permission.

Hardcore. This is a high-intensity environment for people who want to do the defining work of their lives.

THE ROLEOwn the last mile of Mecka's business

We're hiring a Data Delivery Lead to turn our raw captured, labeled, and validated data into the exact deliverable a frontier robotics lab pays for — assembled correctly, validated ruthlessly, and documented clearly.

This is a hands-on, data-native role. You come from a data analytics or data engineering background and are fluent in SQL and working with large, messy datasets. You'll live at the seam between our internal data systems and our customers' specs: translating what a lab asks for into concrete queries and quality gates, pulling and packaging the final cut, running it through validation before anyone else sees it, and producing the reports and catalogs that ship alongside it.

You make sure that when a deliverable leaves Mecka, it is exactly right — and that we are our own strictest customer long before the actual customer opens the box.

The role blends deep data analysis with technical delivery ownership. You won't necessarily write production pipelines day-to-day, but you'll understand our data stack well enough to direct engineering, query it directly, and catch problems no dashboard would surface.

Responsibilities

Deliverable assembly & export


Pull the final delivery cut from our internal data systems (document and columnar databases, and file stores)
Format data to each customer's schema; generate manifests, indexes, and packaging
Stage and hand off deliveries to customer buckets and cloud storage reliably and reproducibly
Own the mechanics of the drop end-to-end, so nothing ships half-assembled


Delivery QA & validation — the strictest-customer bar


Run every deliverable through Mecka's ship-gates before it goes out
Design and execute validation: coverage stats, stratified sample audits, schema compliance, quality-drift detection
Set an internal acceptance bar higher than the customer's own QC — catch it here, never there
Build and maintain golden reference sets and repeatable checks so quality is measured, not assumed


Spec translation


Turn a customer's data specification into concrete, testable gates and queries
Translate back into what capture, labeling, and CV operations must actually produce to hit that spec
Serve as the technical interpreter between customer requirements and internal execution


Customer-facing delivery artifacts


Produce delivery reports, data catalogs, sample packs, and schema documentation that accompany each drop
Keep a canonical "our strongest work, today" reference pack always current
Make the quality and shape of the data legible to a technical customer at a glance


Throughput & delivery management


Track delivery performance against timelines and SLAs; ensure they're consistently met
Identify bottlenecks in the assembly-to-ship path and drive them out
Ensure the delivery process scales as volume and customer count grow


Cross-functional & stakeholder execution


Partner with data capture, labeling operations, and engineering to close spec gaps
Own delivery communication with internal teams and external customers
Keep timelines, risks, and deliverable status transparent to everyone who needs it


Who You Are

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE


1–3 years in data analytics, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a similarly data-heavy role
Fluent in SQL; comfortable querying and reshaping large, imperfect datasets independently
Working proficiency with a scripting language (Python preferred) for data manipulation, validation, and automation
Solid grasp of data pipelines, schemas, and data-quality concepts
Proven ability to own a data workflow or deliverable end-to-end
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management abilities


STRONG SIGNALS


Experience in fast-paced startups or high-growth environments
Exposure to ML / AI training data, data labeling, or dataset delivery
Experience with NoSQL / document stores and/or columnar analytics databases (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake)
Built QA / validation tooling or data-quality checks
Strong intuition for prioritization and tradeoffs between speed, quality, and cost


YOU ARE


Rigorous and detail-obsessed — you find the error before the customer does
Structured in your thinking but flexible in execution
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast-changing environments
Data-native — your instinct is to measure, not assume
Calm under pressure, able to run multiple deliveries in parallel without dropping quality


WHY THIS ROLE


Own the last mile that every customer relationship ultimately depends on
Sit at the intersection of data engineering, operations, and customer delivery
Directly shape how Mecka defines and defends "gold-standard" data quality
High visibility and direct exposure to leadership and customers
Build the systems that let Mecka's delivery scale globally


Inclusive Hiring at Mecka

We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive candidate experience. Should you require any accommodation whatsoever during the interview process, please inform us without any hesitation. Mecka is dedicated to ensuring equal treatment and opportunity in all phases of recruitment, selection, and employment, in compliance with employment law. We do not discriminate based on gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other protected category. Mecka is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, fostering a culture of inclusivity and maintaining a work environment that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment

Mecka uses artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly to support administrative and efficiency-focused aspects of our recruitment process. This includes activities such as drafting job descriptions, generating interview questions, note-taking and recordings, and supporting sourcing and scheduling workflows. All candidate evaluations, interviews, and hiring decisions are made by members of the Mecka team. While AI tools may assist with screening and assessment, they do not replace human judgment in selection decisions. Our use of AI is intended to streamline routine tasks, improve consistency, and enhance the overall candidate experience. We are committed to upholding principles of fairness, transparency, and accountability in all hiring activities. Mecka regularly reviews its recruitment practices to mitigate bias and to ensure alignment with applicable laws and evolving best practices.

Compensation Range: CA$140K - CA$180K

Multimatic is looking for a high-impact IT Analyst to play a key role in advancing our next-generation reporting, analytics, data governance and AI capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of business architecture, SAP S/4HANA, finance, analytics, and emerging AI technologies, supporting initiatives across SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP Joule and SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC).

You will partner closely with business, finance and IT teams to transform data into meaningful insights, support enterprise decision-making and contribute to strategic digital transformation initiatives.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Data Reporting & Analytics


Contribute to the design and evolution of enterprise data models and reporting.
Support implementation of SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) for unified data access and analytics enablement.
Partner with technical teams on data models, reporting design and analytics delivery.
Lead testing, validation and business acceptance activities.
Establish and maintain data governance standards, including data quality, lineage and ownership.

Job ID: AR1030

Job Title: Data Quality Analyst

Closing Date: Sep 15, 2026, 12:00 p.m. (Eastern Standard Time)

Location: Peel Region, Ontario

Employment Type: Hybrid (mandatory minimum of two days onsite per week)

Salary: $55.00 per hour (all contractors must be incorporated)

Duration: November 2, 2026 – April 30, 2027 (with potential 6-month extension)

Hours of Work: 7 hours per day (35 hours per week)

Travel Requirements: None




Consider Your Next Contract with Aliant Resources and Our Municipal Government Client in Peel Region.




About Us:

Aliant Resources is a dedicated provider of IT staffing services, committed to promoting diversity, equity, inclusion, belonging, anti-racism, and accessibility in all facets of our operations. We invite you to join our team!




Role Overview:

Development Services (Public Works) is undertaking a comprehensive data quality improvement initiative to support the modernization of development application tracking systems.

The Contractor will be responsible for reviewing, validating, cleansing, updating, correcting, and maintaining data contained within a large, complex Excel-based repository. The resource will identify data quality issues, conduct record verification activities, resolve discrepancies, perform data reconciliation, document findings, and ensure the completeness, accuracy, and integrity of information in accordance with business requirements.

The work will support accurate growth forecasting, infrastructure planning, reporting requirements, and operational decision-making across Peel Region.

This role is heavily focused on document review and analysis with data validation and ability to perform quality control and cross referencing.




Deliverables:

Review and Validation

Review development application files from 2021 onward and validate information against source documentation for all submissions.
Validate that basic description information is correct and update if necessary.
Examine application forms, planning reports, site plans, approval notices, clearance letters, registration documents and related records.




Development Data Analysis

Extract and validate residential unit counts by housing type.
Extract and validate gross floor area (GFA) by land use classification.
Track changes through multiple application resubmissions and document revisions.
Compare successive submissions to identify changes in units, GFA, and development scope.
Maintain accurate records of initial, revised and approved development metrics.




Status Verification

Verify application status through review of approval documentation, registration records, regional clearance letters and municipal notices.
Confirm status dates and milestone events according to established procedures and business rules.
Record approval, draft approval, registration and clearance information in tracking systems.




Data Quality and Cross-Referencing

Identify data discrepancies, missing information and inconsistencies.
Cross-reference related development applications and associated files.
Flag records requiring escalation, clarification or correction.
Ensure compliance with established data governance standards and naming conventions.
Participate in ongoing quality control reviews and validation exercises.




Record Maintenance

Enter validated information into tracking spreadsheets and database systems.
Maintain progress tracking records and workload reporting tools.
Support the cleanup and migration of historical development application information.




Qualifications & Experience:

Minimum 3-5 years of experience in data quality, data analysis, data validation, data cleansing, or data governance roles.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including filtering, sorting, data validation functions and reconciliation techniques.
Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting large, complex datasets.
Experience identifying, investigating, and resolving data discrepancies, duplicates, missing information, and data integrity issues.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret and validate large volumes of information.
Experience documenting findings, corrections, assumptions, and data quality issues.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work independently and manage priorities while following established procedures and meeting established timelines.
Ability to interpret plans, charts, forms, reports and technical documentation.
Strong organizational and records management skills.
Ability to manage large volumes of repetitive work while maintaining accuracy.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Experience working with GIS, planning databases, records management systems, or document management systems.




Why Join Us:

Be part of a diverse and inclusive workplace.
Contribute to the delivery of essential services.
Opportunity for professional growth and development.

For over 130 years we had been located in the Kitchener area since the family’s original store opened in 1892. We are head quartered in Cambridge Ontario and we’ve expanded our roots far beyond. With manufacturing plants in North America and over 1400 employees, Dare is part of the fabric of Canada.




At Dare our dedicated team works passionately to uphold our tradition of excellence, innovation and quality in every aspect of our operations. Our state-of-the-art facilities utilize advanced technology to ensure consistency and quality while meeting the evolving needs of our consumers and customers.




Salary Target- $75,000

Onsite




Position Overview

As a key member of the Operations team this person will be responsible to assess and report on the financials of the Cambridge facility. This position will be the go to resource for the Production & Maintenance teams ability to meet budget and help ensure financial stability of the plant.

Production and Operations Analysis

Prepare and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly operational performance reports.
Analyze production efficiencies, labour utilization, downtime, waste, and yield metrics.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement.
Support plant management with data-driven recommendations to improve productivity and reduce costs.
Track production results against budgets, forecasts, and operational targets.

Cost and Financial Analysis

Assist in monitoring and analyzing plant manufacturing costs.
Investigate variances related to labour, materials, waste, and overhead expenses.
Support monthly financial reporting and plant performance reviews.
Maintain and update cost analysis reports and operational dashboards.
Partner with Finance to support budgeting and forecasting activities.

Inventory and Reporting

Monitor inventory levels and investigate discrepancies.
Support cycle counts and physical inventory processes.
Analyze inventory transactions to ensure data accuracy.
Maintain reporting databases and ensure the integrity of production and inventory data.
Develop and automate reports to improve business insights and reporting efficiency.

Continuous Improvement

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence projects.
Identify opportunities for process improvements through analysis of operational data.
Support root cause analysis for operational issues and performance gaps.
Assist with the implementation and tracking of corrective actions.

Cross-Functional Support

Collaborate with Production, Maintenance, Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, and Finance teams.
Provide analytical support for capital projects, productivity initiatives, and operational improvements.
Prepare presentations and reports for plant leadership meetings.
Support special projects and business initiatives as required.

Qualifications

Post-secondary education in Business, Finance, Accounting, Operations Management, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.
2 to 5 years of experience in a manufacturing, operations analysis, business analysis, or financial analysis role.
Experience working in a manufacturing or food production environment is considered an asset.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data analysis tools.
Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Dayforce, JDE, or a similar platform is preferred.
Experience using Power BI or other reporting and visualization tools is an asset.
Excellent organizational and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
