Title: Analyst, Data Quality & Governance
Description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is a global, luxury hotel management company. We manage over 130 hotels and resorts and 50 private residences in 47 countries around the world and growing. Central to Four Seasons employee experience and social impact programming is the company’s commitment to supporting cancer research, and the advancement of diversity, inclusion, equality and belonging at Four Seasons corporate offices and properties worldwide. At Four Seasons, we are powered by people and our culture enables everything we do.

Analyst, Data Quality & Governance

As the Analyst, Data Quality & Governance, you will collaborate with data owners, stewards, and custodians across our organization to ensure that the content, structure, and context of all data assets and related data lineage is clear and understood. As the Analyst, Data Quality & Governance, you will report to the Manager, Data Assets and Standards and will collaborate with data owners, stewards, and custodians across the organization to ensure data assets are trusted, discoverable, well-documented, and fit for purpose across reporting, analytics, automation, and AI use cases. You will help establish the metadata, lineage, business context, and governance controls required to make enterprise data assets usable by both people and AI systems.

In addition to managing data assets, you will leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to scale governance activities, improve metadata quality, accelerate documentation, and enhance data discovery. You will also contribute to the development of AI-powered governance capabilities such as intelligent assistants, agents, and automated workflows that improve access to trusted enterprise data.

What You’ll Be Doing


Assist in the implementation of relevant data governance policies and work closely with data stewards to enforce standards for data assets.
Enhance data cataloguing and metadata practices ensuring datasets are properly structured, classified, governed, and discoverable to support analytics, automation, AI agents, and generative AI solutions.
Complete and up to date data catalogue available for data discovery and data management.
Supports AI readiness by ensuring data assets is governed, trusted, and readily usable for advanced analytics and automation.
Trusted and well-governed data assets that can be confidently consumed by users, applications, analytics platforms, and AI solutions.
Establish lineage across systems to allow visibility of data flow across systems for stronger data governance controls.
Monitor and track usage of data assets to understand and report on patterns and trends.
Efficient use of data by stakeholders to minimize burden of data collection and maximize insights development.
Enhanced user experience and self-service access to governed data through AI-enabled capabilities.
Generate reports on data asset utilization and identify opportunities to optimize usage.
Design and maintain AI-powered governance solutions, including agents, copilots, and automated workflows that improve data discovery, knowledge sharing, and access to trusted data assets.
Manage and maintain reference data sets in informatica as a central source of truth to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
Assist in creating and maintaining documentation for reference data standards and procedures.
Collaborate with data stewards to update and validate reference data regularly and resolve any data issues.
Maintain an up-to-date and comprehensive business glossary and semantic layer that supports consistent business understanding by users, analytics platforms, and AI systems.
Collaborate with business units and subject matter experts to define and document business terms.
Leverage AI and automation capabilities to streamline data governance processes including metadata generation, documentation, data classification, lineage analysis, issue triage, and business glossary maintenance.
Increased governance efficiency through intelligent automation and reduced manual effort.


What You Bring


Bachelor's in a relevant field (e.g., data management, information technology, business analytics, informatics).
Proven experience and understanding of data governance, with a focus on metadata, reference and master data.
Strong understanding of data protection regulations and compliance requirements.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Strong collaboration and engagement skills across multiple stakeholders.
Experience with data governance tools and technologies such as informatica.
Understanding of how data quality, metadata, lineage, business context, and governance controls support ai, machine learning, generative ai, and intelligent automation use cases.
Experience using ai-enabled productivity and analytics tools to improve efficiency, automate repetitive tasks, and generate insights.
Familiarity with ai concepts such as large language models (llms), retrieval-augmented generation (rag), ai agents, semantic models, vector search, and knowledge management.
Experience developing prompts, workflows, copilots, agents, or other ai-enabled solutions is considered an asset.
Applied experience in data governance, particularly in data quality management.
Knowledge of industry leading data quality practices.
Familiar with implementation and use various data governance tools and software.
Familiar with DMBOK principles.
Understand of complete data lifecycle and related data governance requirements.
Understanding of GDPR and related legislation.
Ability to manipulate, analyze and transform large datasets to understand trends and patterns.
Working knowledge of cloud computing platforms. MS Azure preferred (Microsoft Synapse, Azure Data factory, Azure Data Lake, PowerBI).
Proficient in SQL or other programming languages.
Experience with data visualization and dashboarding (Power BI, Tableau).
Expert in Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access).


AI & Automation Skills


Understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and AI-ready data practices.
Experience using generative AI and copilots for business and data management activities.
Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI services, AI agents, and workflow automation tools.
Understanding of knowledge management, semantic models, vectorized content, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) concepts.
Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve governance, stewardship, and data management processes.
Experience creating prompts, agents, or AI-assisted workflows to improve business outcomes.


Who You Are

Business / Analytics Skills


Works to understand business need and how the data will be used to drive decisions into action plans that will grow the business.
Effectively navigates through ambiguity and complexity to provide clarity for the team and the requester.
Works well under pressure and can manage multiple tasks under time constraints.
Strong with process management including the development of processes and procedures.
Familiar with agile methodology and comfortable working in an agile environment.


Communication Skills


Works to understand the requester needs when building the upfront story to ensure clarity and actionability.
Listens carefully to understand requirements and seeks clarity as needed.
Provides well-structured reports and documents to convey analysis and insights that are clear, concise and reader-friendly.
Demonstrates understanding of the importance of storytelling by incorporating visual enhancements into presentations.
Strong interpersonal skills and team player.


Planning / Organizational Skills


Demonstrates the ability to organize and work with high volumes of data.
Establishes clear expectations to ensure smooth execution.
Handles multiple demands and conflicting priorities by quickly re-allocating time and resources.
Organizes self and the team in setting and managing priorities.
Demonstrates a high standard for attention to detail and holds others to the same.
Delivers on commitments on time and on budget.


People Engagement


Takes the time to acknowledge the efforts and contributions of others.
Works to build relationships with colleagues to both provide and receive the best support.


Collaboration Skills


Works productively in a matrix environment to move projects along and foster a positive team attitude.
Proactively asks for input and ideas from others to demonstrate the power of the team.


Salary Range: $70,000 – $85,000 CAD

This role will be a Hybrid working model, which will require 3 days per week at our temporary 20 York Mills Road, Toronto, Ontario location with travel, as needed, to our the Four Seasons Corporate Office located at 1165 Leslie Street, Toronto, Ontario

Four Seasons is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If contacted for an employment opportunity, please advise Human Resources if you require accommodation.

The Canada Infrastructure Bank (CIB) is responsible for investing in new infrastructure projects. The CIB’s mission is to work with provincial, territorial, municipal, federal, Indigenous and private sector investor partners to transform the way infrastructure is planned, financed and delivered in Canada.




The Analyst, Business Systems, is based in Toronto and reports to the Manager, Information Technology. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, data engineering, analytics and platform architecture, ensuring business requirements are translated into scalable, governed and trusted Fabric-based data products.




Your responsibilities include:

Business and requirements analysis (core BSA)

Translate business needs into: Epics, features and user stories; Functional and non-functional requirements; Clear acceptance criteria aligned to data outcomes
Develop and maintain key artifacts: Business and data requirements documentation; Process flows and use cases; Business glossaries and metric definitions




Microsoft Fabric data architecture enablement

Experience with data modelling: Dimensional modelling (facts, dimensions, measures); Transactional vs. analytical data structures; Data grain and aggregation strategies
Experience contributing to enterprise data warehouse design, including: Subject-area modelling; Historical data handling; Data retention and archival strategies
Understanding of: Query performance considerations from a modelling perspective; Partitioning and summarization concepts (at a requirement/design level)
Ability to assess downstream reporting impact of modelling decisions
Define and document: Source-to-target mappings; Transformation logic and business rules; Data lineage and traceability across Fabric workloads




Microsoft Fabric and Power BI–specific skills

Experience with Power BI semantic models
Familiarity with self-service enablement patterns in Fabric
Strong understanding of self-service BI and analytics concepts
Ability to define semantic layer requirements that balance flexibility and control
Experience documenting: KPI logic and calculation rules; Business-friendly data definitions; Reporting usage and limitations
Understanding of Direct Lake vs. Import trade-offs from a business perspective
Ability to support Power BI report validation and UAT with business stakeholders




Governance and controls for self-service analytics

Ensure self-service reporting adheres to: Enterprise data governance standards; Security, privacy and access controls; Metric consistency across domains
Partner with governance teams to: Maintain business glossaries and metadata; Ensure discoverability through Microsoft Purview




Your ideal profile:

Undergraduate degree in information systems, business, finance, computer science or equivalent
Two to four years of experience in a similar role
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including: Lakehouse and/or warehouse; Data Factory pipelines; Notebooks (Spark); OneLake architecture
Two to four years of experience in data analysis and reporting, preferably with Power BI
Knowledge of AI/ML architectures, Generative AI, LLMs, vector databases, and MLOps/LLMOps practices
Support AI initiatives through data preparation, feature engineering, validation, and performance monitoring
Experience evaluating the effectiveness of AI-enabled solutions and recommend continuous improvements
Strong proficiency in DAX, Power Query (M) and data modelling concepts
Strong SQL skills and experience with data modelling for analytics
Good understanding of ETL processes and data warehousing principles
Experience with Microsoft Purview, an asset
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate), an asset
Knowledge of Azure services (Data Lake, Synapse, Data Factory, etc.)
Familiarity with CI/CD for data pipelines (Azure DevOps, Git)
Familiarity with governance and security best practices in Power BI
Bilingual English/French, an asset




We thank you for your interest. Only those selected for further screening or an interview will be contacted.




At the CIB, we are committed to diversity and equitable access to employment opportunities. If you require an accommodation for the recruitment/interview process, please let us know at accessible@cib-bic.ca and we will work with you to meet your needs.

La Banque de l’infrastructure du Canada (BIC) a la responsabilité d’investir dans de nouveaux projets d’infrastructures. La mission de la BIC est de travailler avec ses partenaires provinciaux, territoriaux, municipaux, fédéral, autochtones et du secteur privé en matière d’investissement pour transformer la façon dont les infrastructures sont planifiées, financées et réalisées au Canada.




L’analyste, Systèmes commerciaux, sera basé à Toronto et relèvera du/de la gestionnaire, Technologies de l’information. Ce poste se situe à la croisée de la stratégie commerciale, de l’ingénierie des données, de l’analyse et de l’architecture de plate-forme, en veillant à ce que les besoins commerciaux soient traduits en produits de données évolutives, contrôlées et fiables sur Fabric.




Vos responsabilités :

Analyse commerciale et des exigences (base de l’analyse des systèmes commerciaux)

Traduire les besoins commerciaux en : épopées, fonctionnalités et récits d’utilisateurs; exigences fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles; critères d’acceptation clairs alignés sur les résultats des données
Développer et maintenir des artefacts clés : documentation liée aux besoins commerciaux et aux données; flux de processus et cas d’utilisation; glossaires commerciaux et définitions des indicateurs




Facilitation de l’architecture de données Microsoft Fabric

Expérience en modélisation de données : Modélisation dimensionnelle (faits, dimensions, mesures); Structures de données transactionnelles vs analytiques; Stratégies de granularité et d’agrégation des données
Expérience dans la conception d’entrepôts de données d’entreprise, notamment : Modélisation par domaine; Traitement des données historiques; Stratégies de conservation et d’archivage des données
Compréhension des éléments suivants : Considérations relatives aux performances des requêtes du point de vue de la modélisation; Concepts de partitionnement et de synthèse (au niveau des exigences/de la conception)
Capacité à évaluer l’impact en aval des décisions de modélisation sur l’établissement de rapports
Définir et documenter les éléments suivants : Mappages source-cible; Logique de transformation et règles commerciales; Lignée et traçabilité des données dans toutes les charges de travail Fabric




Compétences spécifiques à Microsoft Fabric et Power BI

Expérience avec les modèles sémantiques Power BI
Connaissance des modèles d’activation libre-service dans Fabric
Solide compréhension des concepts d’intelligence d’affaires et d’analyse en libre-service
Capacité à définir les exigences de la couche sémantique qui équilibrent flexibilité et contrôle
Expérience dans la documentation : Logique des indicateurs de rendement clé et règles de calcul; Définitions des données adaptées à l’entreprise; Utilisation et limites des rapports
Compréhension des compromis entre Direct Lake et Import d’un point de vue commercial
Capacité à prendre en charge la validation des rapports Power BI et les tests d’acceptation utilisateur avec les parties prenantes commerciales




Gouvernance et contrôles pour l’analyse en libre-service

Veiller à ce que les rapports en libre-service respectent : les normes de gouvernance des données d’entreprise; les contrôles de sécurité, de confidentialité et d’accès; la cohérence des métriques entre les domaines
Collaborer avec les équipes de gouvernance pour : tenir à jour les glossaires métier et les métadonnées; garantir la découvrabilité via Microsoft Purview




Le profil idéal :

Diplôme universitaire en systèmes d’information, commerce, finance, informatique ou équivalent
Deux à quatre ans d’expérience dans un poste similaire
Expérience avec Microsoft Fabric, notamment : « Lakehouse » et/ou « warehouse »; Flux Data Factory; « Notebooks » (Spark); Architecture OneLake
Deux à quatre ans d’expérience dans l’analyse de données et la création de rapports, de préférence avec Power BI
Connaissance des architectures IA/ML, de l’IA générative, des grands modèles de langage (LLM), des bases de données vectorielles et des pratiques MLOps/LLMOps
Soutien aux initiatives d’intelligence artificielle par la préparation des données, l’ingénierie des caractéristiques, la validation et la surveillance du rendement
Expérience dans l’évaluation de l’efficacité des solutions basées sur l’IA et formulation de recommandations d’amélioration continue
Maîtrise approfondie de DAX, Power Query (M) et des concepts de modélisation de données
Solides compétences en SQL et expérience de la modélisation de données à des fins d’analyse
Bonne compréhension des processus d’extraction, de transformation et de chargement, ainsi que des principes de stockage de données
Expérience avec Microsoft Purview, un atout
Expérience avec Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate), un atout
Connaissance des services Azure (Data Lake, Synapse, Data Factory, etc.)
Connaissance de l’intégration continue/déploiement continu pour les flux de données (Azure DevOps, Git)
Connaissance des meilleures pratiques en matière de gouvernance et de sécurité dans Power BI
Bilinguisme anglais-français, un atout




Merci de votre intérêt. Seules les personnes retenues pour la poursuite du processus de sélection ou pour une entrevue seront contactées.




La Banque de l’infrastructure du Canada tient à promouvoir la diversité ainsi que l’accès équitable aux occasions d’emploi. Dans le cas où vous auriez besoin d’un accommodement au cours du processus d’embauche ou d’entrevue, prière de le faire savoir en écrivant à accessible@cib-bic.ca.

Title: Quality Management and Data Support Specialist
Description:
Date: Aug 14, 2026

Location:

Pickering, ON, CA

Type of Position: Permanent

Type Of Position

Number of Positions: 1

Salary Min: $96,105.00

Salary Max: $113,072.00

Description

Do you want to be part of a team helping to strengthen every community across Ontario? Are you interested in seeing the importance of your work firsthand?

Become a Quality Management and Data Support Specialist with MPAC

The Municipal Property Assessment Corporation (MPAC) is made up of a team of experts who understand local communities and assess every property in Ontario. What we do provides the very foundation that municipalities use to base the property taxes needed to pay for the services we use every day.

Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Anti-Racism

MPAC is committed to Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Anti-Racism. We are taking important steps towards ensuring that all voices are respected, valued and being heard. MPAC is dedicated to fostering an environment where employees can bring their full, unique and authentic selves and are inspired to do their best work.

Job Description

What makes you great for this role?

You are a detailed oriented individual who can monitor, validate, maintain and improve data quality within MPAC.

We Have


A team of highly skilled, dedicated, and collaborative staff
Leadership that supports you
An enterprise that embraces change
A work environment that has flexible work locations (including hybrid), hours of work and overall employee wellness support


You Have


Completion post-secondary (college or university) education
A minimum of 7 years progressively responsible experience in data management and analytics in a similar industry with a minimum 5 years’ experience in quality control
Proven experience in one or more statistical programming languages such as R, SAS, SPSS, etc.
Knowledge and experience with assessment terminology, policies and procedures
Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills
Strong time management and organizational skills to meet tight deadlines and integrate multiple work assignments
Proficient use of Microsoft suite applications: Word, Excel, PowerPoint


Nice To Have


Completion of post-secondary (college or university) education in: Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business Administration
Working toward or the completion of a property valuation designation AIMA, MIMA, AACI FRICS, and/or Data Governance related designation
Experience in at least one general programming and/or scripting language such as Java, Python, C++, SQL, etc; and proficient with GIS and visualization tools such as QGIS, ArcView, Qlikview, Tableau and PowerBI


What You Will Do


Promote efficient, accurate records, and effective information management across MPAC, to achieve data standardization, transparency and traceability
Perform enterprise data quality health checks and analysis, identifies and evaluates concerns in governing data and suggests observations and/or work edits enhancements to management
Maintain data integrity and improves data quality throughout the data lifecycle in the development of deliverables and ingestion of data into existing systems
Support corporate stakeholders in building a strong data governance foundation by evaluating data sets including data usability, consistency, readiness, security and integrity
Design and automates the development of control structures; and conducts periodic data reviews to identify data anomalies to mitigate corporate risks
Work in collaboration with IT and business stakeholders and data stewards on data issue management and identifies data inconsistencies, and evaluates risks
Lead efforts to develop scalable, innovative approaches to extracting, managing, analysing and interpreting historical data results to identify trends or patterns in complex data sets
Serve as core team member on corporate projects, participate as a subject matter expert, and provide support to ensure data governance framework compliance


Additional Information


Requisition ID: 3052
Existing Vacancy: Yes
Job Type: Union
Closing Date: September 15, 2026


Ready to apply?

Please note, only applications submitted through the Applicant Tracking System will be accepted.

Successful candidates will be required to undergo a background verification with Mintz Global Screening. By applying to this job posting, you are providing your consent to MPAC to share your name, email address and phone number with Mintz, to conduct the criminal and driver abstract check and for Mintz to disclose the results to MPAC, should you be the successful incumbent.

MPAC is committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment where all employees and members of the public feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflect the diversity of the public and communities we serve.

Persons with disability who need accommodation in the application process or those needing job postings in an alternative format may email their request to careers@mpac.ca.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

Please note that MPAC prohibits employees from holding a current/valid real estate license and successful applicants must at least suspend their real estate licenses during their period of employment at MPAC as outlined in our Employee Code of Conduct.

Job advertisements for positions that have been designated bilingual will be posted in both English and French on our website. Positions that are not designated bilingual are not translated and are only posted in English on the English version of our website.

Title: Data Solutions Engineer
Description:
Location: Brampton, ON (Head Office) – Onsite

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: IT & Data Analytics

Salary Range: $85,000 to $105,000 (compensation is based on experience)




Competitive compensation, annual performance bonus, comprehensive benefits, RRSP matching, paid vacation, and professional development opportunities.




Build solutions that make a real business impact.

 

At Weston Forest, we're looking for someone who enjoys solving business problems with technology.




This isn't a traditional Power BI developer role. It isn't just software development or data science.

We're looking for a well-rounded Data Solutions Engineer who enjoys partnering directly with business users to understand how they work, identify opportunities for improvement, and build practical technology solutions that make their jobs easier.




One day you might be designing an interactive dashboard for Sales. The next you could be developing an internal application to automate a manual process, improving data pipelines for Operations, or building reporting tools that help leaders make better business decisions.




If you're energized by variety, enjoy working across different business functions, and like seeing your work make an immediate impact, we'd love to hear from you.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 

As part of Weston Forest's Data Analytics team, you'll work closely with leaders across Sales, Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, Credit, and other business areas to design and deliver innovative analytics and business solutions.

 

No two days are exactly alike. You'll have the opportunity to work on a wide variety of projects spanning analytics, application development, automation, business intelligence, and emerging technologies.

 

Your responsibilities will include:




Partnering with business stakeholders to understand challenges, gather requirements, and recommend practical technology solutions
Collaborate on the design and solution architecture of business, application, and data solutions, leveraging existing platforms, standards, and best practices to deliver consistent, scalable solutions.
Designing and developing intuitive business applications, dashboards, portals, and reporting solutions that present complex information in a clear, visually compelling manner, enabling faster and more informed business decisions.
Building automation tools that eliminate manual processes and improve productivity
Developing analytics solutions using SQL, Power BI, Python, and other technologies

Title: Revenue Operations Analyst II
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We're looking for a curious, driven analyst to join our Revenue Operations team. Revenue Operations serves as the backbone of the Revenue organization at Affirm. We follow a data-driven approach that combines elements of strategy, systems, process, and analytics to align go-to-market motions across the organization.

About The Role

As a Revenue Operations Analyst II, you will be a key partner to our Marketing, Business Development, and early Sales teams - focused on making the top of the funnel predictable, clean, and scalable. You'll design and optimize the processes, automation, and tooling that govern how leads, contacts, and accounts enter the revenue funnel, ensuring downstream teams can execute with confidence. The ideal candidate is equal parts tactical, building automation and workflows, and strategic thinking through lifecycle design, routing logic, and coverage models that scale with the business.

What You'll Do


Design and optimize top of funnel merchant lifecycle processes — from Marketing touch through Contact creation, Account readiness, and Discovery handoff — with an emphasis on automation, data quality, and clear documentation
Own and define lead routing logic, automation triggers, and lifecycle dependencies that govern how leads and accounts move through the top of funnel; partner with Business Systems for implementation
Own cross-functional initiatives end to end — managing stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Legal, Product, Revenue Ops, Analytics, and others
Support attribution tracking and funnel conversion analysis for Marketing, BDA, and early funnel performance to surface actionable insights
Own workflow automations (e.g., Slack notifications, cross-tool workflows, process triggers) that improve speed-to-lead and reduce manual work
Collaborate with the Business Systems team to improve Salesforce and adjacent GTM tooling for lead and account management efficiency; define processes to ensure data integrity at funnel entry
Partner with Revenue Enablement to train and support revenue teams on top of funnel processes and tooling changes


What We Look For


BA/BS or equivalent 4-year degree required
2+ years of revenue operations, sales operations, or marketing operations experience

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Company: College of Massage Therapists of Ontario
Description:
WHO WE ARE

The College of Massage Therapists of Ontario (CMTO) is a progressive regulatory body dedicated to protecting the public interest by upholding the highest standards for Registered Massage Therapists (RMTs). We hold RMT’s accountable for providing safe, ethical, and high-quality Massage Therapy care to the public.




At CMTO, we are dedicated to excellence in protecting the public interest, guiding registrants, and promoting the highest possible quality of the practice of Massage Therapy.




WORKING @ CMTO

This full-time, permanent position offers a competitive annual salary, a comprehensive benefits package, RRSP matching, and a professional development fund. At CMTO, we foster a collaborative team culture and a strong commitment to our mission. Our flexible, remote-first work environment allows staff to work remotely most of the time, while our office—located centrally, steps from TTC—is available when needed.

If you are looking to build a meaningful career in a highly varied role within a non-profit, regulatory organization, we want to meet you!




ABOUT THE ROLE

CMTO is seeking a Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst to support the transformation of complex data into clear, actionable insights to drive the College forward. The BI Analyst reports to the Manager, Projects and Data Analytics, provides insights that support regulatory operations, organizational performance and strategic decision-making.




KEY DUTIES

Collect, extract, integrate and analyze data from multiple sources to identify emerging risks.
Translate complex analytical findings into meaningful insights and practical recommendations tailored to technical and non-technical audiences.
Design and create impactful visualizations, dashboards, and reports using Microsoft Power BI to clearly communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Develop and maintain data governance standards, reports, business terminology and data dictionaries to promote consistency, accuracy and standardization.
Investigate data quality issues, identify root causes and work collaboratively with organization teams to implement corrective actions and improvements.
Partner with business leaders to define KPIs, metrics, reporting requirements and analytical priorities.
Develop and maintain datasets, semantic models, dashboards and reporting solutions leveraging CMTO's Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse environment to support enterprise reporting, analytics and decision-making.
Perform data validation, reconciliation and quality assurance projects to ensure the integrity, usability and reliability of organizational data used for reporting and analysis.
Support adoption of Power BI and self-service through user training, documentation, coaching and reporting best practices.
Identify opportunities to automate data collection, reporting and analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Present analytical findings, trends and recommendations to senior leadership and organizational teams to support discussions and planning.




SKILLS

Advanced analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Skilled in developing dashboards, reports and data visualizations and data storytelling.
Ability to translate data into actionable business insights and present findings.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment;
Ability to work independently and contribute effectively within a team.
Adaptability and continuous improvement mindset.




QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or equivalent business experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence or related field.
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience with at least 3 years of specialization in business intelligence or data analytics.
Expertise in designing, developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models and performance measurement frameworks.
Experience working with enterprise data platforms including Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse, data pipelines, semantic models and Power BI reporting environments.
Experience with ETL processes, cloud-based storage solutions, and advanced Excel.
Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse architecture, data engineering concepts, cloud-based analytics platforms, and emerging AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
Proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience using Python or other analytical programming languages.
Familiarity with data integration tools and AI-driven analytics is an asset.




LIFE at CMTO

Compensation and Time Off

Hiring salary: $90,000 - $100,000
15 vacation days plus 4 personal days
Office closure every year from December 25 to January 1




Benefits & Support

Group benefits starting on your first day
Health Care Spending Account
Annual professional development funding
Group Retirement Savings Plan
Maternity and parental leave top-up program




Work Environment

Remote-first workplace with in-office expectations 2 times per month on average
Collaborative, collegial team culture
Office located at 175 Bloor Street East, Toronto with easy transit and parking access




INTERESTED?

To be considered, apply online or via email to resumes@cmto.com on or before September 11, 2026. Please state the job posting title and your name in the subject line of the email.




Artificial intelligence is not used to screen, assess, or select applicants for this role. Recruiters may use AI‑supported tools only to help identify potential candidates on public platforms. All application reviews, assessments, and hiring decisions are made by people in accordance with Ontario employment and human rights laws.




CMTO is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity. We welcome applicants from all communities, including people of all religions, ethnicities, and racial backgrounds; persons with disabilities; LGBTQ2S+ communities; women; Indigenous Peoples; and anyone who may contribute to the diversity of perspectives within our organization.




CMTO upholds the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). We work to ensure that our recruitment, assessment, and selection processes are accessible and will provide accommodations upon request. If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, contact resumes@cmto.com.

Title: GIS and Data Visualization Specialist
Description:
Job Details

Permanent Full Time (CUPE 1329)




Posting Status

Open to all current Town of Oakville employees and external applicants




Closing Date

Applications for this position must be received at by no later than 11:59 p.m. on September 17, 2026.




This job posting is for an existing vacancy and therefore will be filled accordingly.




Reporting to the Supervisor, Spatial Solutions, the GIS and Data Visualization Specialist provides expertise and technical guidance in the planning, design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, review, and management of enterprise geospatial solutions, dashboards, visualizations, and data products. The position translates business and service requirements into clear, accurate, user-centered decision-support tools; establishes and sustains supporting processes, policies, procedures, technologies, and visualization standards; and advances the Town’s Enterprise Data Management Strategy through consistent, trusted, and well-governed use of spatial and analytical data. Key responsibilities also include requirements gathering, system testing, quality assurance, data governance, cross-departmental integration, continuous improvement, and long-term planning aligned with enterprise technology capabilities and business needs.




Job Responsibilities

Dashboard & Visualization Design and Delivery

Designs, builds, tests, and maintains enterprise dashboards and interactive visualizations using Power BI (including semantic models, DAX, and Fabric-enabled datasets), ArcGIS Dashboards, ArcGIS Experience Builder, and related visualization platforms.
Translates complex spatial and non-spatial data into intuitive, accurate, and actionable visual products aligned with business objectives.
Develops reusable dashboard templates, visualization patterns, and design components to support enterprise consistency and reuse, that reveal meaningful trends, performance drivers, service impacts, and emerging issues to support evidence-based planning and decision-making.
Ensures dashboards adhere to corporate accessibility requirements, branding standards, and information design best practices.
Creates executive-level, operational, and public-facing visualizations that support reporting, planning, transparency, and broader business objectives.
Leverages Microsoft Fabric to deliver scalable, governed analytics and reporting solutions.

GIS Application Development & Advanced Spatial Analysis

Designs, develops, enhances, and maintains GIS applications and solutions using the ESRI ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise, and web application frameworks.
Conducts advanced spatial analysis and investigates complex spatial and non-spatial data to identify underlying issues, patterns, trends, relationships, and anomalies that inform planning, infrastructure management, service delivery, policy analysis, and operational and strategic decision-making.
Integrates ArcGIS data with enterprise systems and analytics platforms, including Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, to enable location-based analytics, service performance reporting, and cross-system insights.
Supports advanced use cases including 3D GIS, digital twins, and integrated spatial visualization environments, and develops innovative geospatial solutions where business requirements are evolving, data is incomplete, or traditional reporting methods are insufficient.

User Requirements Gathering & System Testing

Leads user requirement gathering sessions to understand business questions, success criteria, and data needs.
Translates business requirements into functional and technical specifications for dashboards and GIS solutions.
Conducts system, user acceptance, and regression testing to ensure solutions meet functional requirements and quality standards.
Coordinates fixes, enhancements, and usability improvements based on testing outcomes and user feedback.

Standards, QA/QC, and Data Quality

Develops, documents, and maintains enterprise dashboard, visualization, and GIS standards, including naming conventions, layout guidelines, validation rules, and performance expectations.
Implements and applies QA/QC processes to ensure dashboards and geospatial products are accurate, reliable, repeatable, and consistent.
Reviews visualization and GIS deliverables for compliance with corporate standards, privacy legislation, security policies, and data governance practices.
Contributes to Enterprise Data Management, data governance, enterprise analytics and platform standards for Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and GIS data integration, including data certification, performance optimization, security, and privacy.
Advisory Services, Training & Continuous Improvement
Provides advisory support and best practice guidance to departments on the effective use of dashboards, GIS tools, and data visualizations.
Develops and delivers training materials, job aids, and documentation to support user adoption and self-service capabilities.
Monitors emerging trends and technologies in GIS, visualization, and analytics and recommends improvements to tools, standards, and methods.




Qualifications

Completion of a four (4) year University Degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geomatics, Computer Science, Data Visualization, Data Management, or related discipline.
At least three (3) years of relevant experience as it relates to the job description and qualifications.
Experience in a municipal or public sector environment is considered an asset.
Advanced proficiency with GIS platforms, particularly the Esri ArcGIS Suite (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise).
Strong experience designing and delivering dashboards and analytics using Power BI, including DAX, semantic models, and enterprise visualization patterns.
Practical experience working with Microsoft Fabric concepts (e.g., Lakehouses, pipelines, semantic models, and analytics integration) or demonstrated ability to adopt modern analytics platforms.
Strong understanding of information design, data storytelling, and visualization best practices across spatial and non-spatial data.
Proficiency in spatial and non-spatial data management, including SQL and data modelling concepts.
Working knowledge of Python, GIS automation tools, FME or scripting for data preparation and analytical workflows.
Experience gathering and documenting user and system requirements.
Demonstrated experience conducting system testing, UAT, and QA/QC for dashboards and GIS applications.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience leading projects and/or working with project teams and all levels of staff, including management.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Title: GIS Analyst
Description:
About the position… The GIS Analyst shall provide support in the planning, maintenance, implementation, and evolution of the corporate GIS system. The incumbent will be responsible for creating, maintaining, and updating corporate GIS data sets and spatial asset inventories, and producing cartographic, analytical, and web-based products for city departments and external organizations. Responsibilities will also include GPS field data collection, rigorous quality control and quality assurance of GIS data sets, as well as adherence to existing policies, procedures, and standards.




The duties listed are not meant to provide a description of every job performed, but only those which represent the core functions of the job.




Undertake data collection, creation, and distribution for a range of spatial asset and tabular data inventories.
Updating and maintenance of a wide range of corporate spatial data sets (including parcel fabric, address database, and infrastructure). This may involve researching historical plans and drawings.
Updating and transforming GIS datasets from CAD drawings and various other sources.
Scanning, filing, and linking of documents to GIS.
Provide spatial analysis and information products in support of various business unit operations and service delivery.
Provide and assist with technical support in the form of troubleshooting errors and performance issues.
Participate in the design, development, documentation, enhancement, and implementation of a range of GIS applications (including web applications).
Provide programming, scripting and SQL query writing for a wide range of applications.
Ensure rigorous quality control is maintained for data collected, converted, or acquired.
Assist with GIS-related training and the development of associated support materials.
Assist in the adherence of policies, guidelines, procedures, and standards as they relate to spatial data.
Prepare custom and standard maps, web application, reports, and presentations for a variety of clients.
Respond to inquiries from the public, consultants and internal clients as assigned.
GPS field data collection when required.
Perform all other duties as assigned.




QUALIFICATIONS:




Minimum two (2) year Diploma from a Community College of Applied Arts and Technology and a graduate certificate or diploma in GIS.
Two (2) years practical GIS work experience, including database skills, spatial data analysis, cartographic design, web application development, and analytical products within a municipal setting.
Possession of a valid Ontario Class “G” driver’s license
Professional standing with OACETT and/or GISCI (or eligible for certification) would be an asset.
Practical knowledge of GIS software including Esri ArcGIS suite of software, Manifold Systems, AutoCAD, MS SQL Server, and MS Access.

Title: People Analytics & Automation Specialist
Description:
About Opendoor

At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one. Homeownership matters. It's how people build wealth, stability, and community. It's how families put down roots, how neighborhoods strengthen, how the future gets built. We're building the modern system of homeownership giving people the freedom to buy and sell on their own terms. We’ve built an end-to-end online experience that has already helped thousands of people and we’re just getting started.

About The Role

Opendoor's People team is scaling how we use data and AI to drive compensation strategy, recruiting operations, and overall HR decision-making. We are looking for a hands-on People Analytics & Automation Specialist to help us bridge the gap between complex data and strategic action.

This role prioritizes hands-on AI capability. We are looking for someone who has built agents and automations. Alongside that, a strong data mindset, the ability to handle confidential projects with high discretion, and a growth orientation. Compensation experience is not required, and we are open to candidates from diverse analytical backgrounds who are eager to learn it.

What You'll Do


AI Agents & Enablement: Design, build, and ship agents and AI-driven workflows for compensation and People Operations. Job evaluation support, offer recommendation modelling, market data analysis, comp cycle preparation.
Dashboards & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for People Operations / Total Rewards (headcount, leveling, compensation analytics) and, where it overlaps, for Talent Acquisition (open requisitions, recruiting funnel and conversion), so leadership has current, trustworthy data ahead of every planning cycle.
Compensation & Leveling: Own the execution side of compensation and leveling projects, comp benchmarking, market studies, leveling structures, and equity or compensation scenario planning, using an established methodology.
Process Automation: Automate recurring People Operations work that currently eats up disproportionate time, equity grant approvals, comp cycle prep, headcount tracking, and other reporting that shouldn't take as long as it does.
TA Analytics Support: Act as a dotted-line analytics partner to Ariana and Talent Acquisition, helping surface insights like compensation-related offer rejections or band placement of recent hires, and supporting the TA team's own data storytelling when priorities overlap.
Systems & Data Quality: Work alongside the Rippling/HRIS administrator to build automations on top of Rippling, and help close data-quality and integration gaps as the team's data infrastructure matures.
Data Storytelling: Translate raw people and compensation data into clear, decision-ready narratives for leadership. This is as much a storytelling role as a data-building one.
Proactive Planning: Get ahead of the calendar by building and testing the automations and dashboards needed for major HR cycles (the upcoming mid-year comp review, annual market study, open enrollment) before they're needed, rather than under pressure.


What You'll Need


You have designed and shipped an AI agent or automated workflow that other people actually use. We will ask you to walk through it in detail: what you built, where you placed human approval gates, what you iterated on, and what broke.
A genuine data mindset and growth orientation. Backgrounds in analytical functions that involve sensitive or complex data are all strong fits.
High discretion and sound judgment. This role regularly touches confidential compensation and people data, and experience managing confidential projects (financial, M&A, or similar) is more important than a specific comp title.
Strong data storytelling and communication skills, able to turn a data set into a clear, persuasive point for an executive audience.
Comfort with Google Sheets (our primary working tool for comp data) and general data/BI fluency; SQL or Snowflake experience is a plus as we build toward more automated data infrastructure, but not required today.
Familiarity with an HRIS (Rippling or similar), comp survey platforms (AON Radford, Mercer, or similar), and equity administration tools (Equity Edge or similar) is a strong plus, not a requirement, and can be learned on the job.
Ability to work independently across two sets of priorities (People Operations/Total Rewards as the primary focus, with lighter-touch support to Talent Acquisition) and to prioritize when demands compete.


Location

This role is based in one of our offices, in-person four days per week. We're looking for candidates who are enthusiastic about an in-office culture; people who want to build alongside their teammates, not from a distance.

Title: Business Intelligence Developer
Description:
Who We Are

Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. The Company develops and publishes products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, Private Division, and Zynga. Our products are currently designed for console gaming systems, PC, and Mobile, including smartphones and tablets, and are delivered through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO.

While our offices (physical and virtual) are casual and inviting, we are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.

The Challenge

Take-Two Interactive, Inc., a leader in the interactive entertainment industry, is looking for a talented Business Intelligence Developer to join a team responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive decision-making across the organization.

The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in SQL-based data analysis, has experience with Tableau Server/Online Administration. If you are self-starter who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, can communicate data-driven insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, have a strong eye for design of dashboards and data sources and are excited by the opportunity to work at the intersection of data, design, and emerging AI/NLP technologies, this is the opportunity for you.

What You’ll Take On


Maintain and administer Tableau Server as a platform.
Build and optimize Tableau data sources, including live connections and scheduled extracts, ensuring high availability and rapid load performance.
Write, tune, and maintain SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data from relational databases and cloud data warehouses.
Partner with business teams, product managers, and analysts to translate complex requirements into scalable BI solutions that support a mix of strategic, tactical and operational reporting to ensure intuitive and visually compelling user experiences.
Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities that inform product and business decisions.
Define and enforce data visualization standards, naming conventions, and best practices to ensure consistency and scalability across all BI deliverables.
Evaluate and implement emerging AI and NLP tools, including Amazon Q, to enhance self-service analytics and natural language querying capabilities for business users.
Maintain clear documentation for dashboards, data sources, and analytical processes to support knowledge sharing, onboarding, and audit readiness.


What You Bring


4+ years of hands-on experience with building BI solutions preferably in Tableau.
2+ years of Tableau Server/Online administration experience, including user and permissions management, site configuration, workbook publishing, extract scheduling, and performance optimization of workbooks and data sources.
Solid SQL proficiency for data extraction, transformation, and analysis across relational databases and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Amazon Redshift, Snowflake).
Experience conducting data analysis tasks including data cleaning, blending, aggregation, and root-cause investigation of data quality issues.
Strong communication skills with the ability to present data-driven insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.
Comfortable working cross-functionally with business partners, data developers, and product teams in an agile environment to gather requirements and deliver BI solutions iteratively.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server/Online Administration — 2+ years (required)
SQL — intermediate to advanced (required)
Figma or equivalent design/prototyping tool (required)


Great to Have


Amazon Q or other NLP/AI analytics tools
AWS data services — Redshift, S3, QuickSight
Snowflake or other cloud data warehouse platforms
Python for data analysis and automation
Power BI or Looker
Experience in the gaming or interactive entertainment industry


What We Offer You


Great Company Culture. Ranked as one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.
Growth. As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.
Work Hard, Play Hard. Our employees bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, company parties, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.
Benefits. Medical, dental, vision, pension plan, employee stock purchase plan, commuter benefits, in-house wellness program, broad learning & development opportunities, a charitable giving platform with company match and more!
Perks. Fitness allowance, employee discount programs, free games & events, stocked pantries and the ability to earn up to $500+ per year for taking care of yourself and more.

However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program.

Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.

  • Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
  • Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
  • Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
  • Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
  • Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
  • Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets

What you may have:

  • 2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
  • Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
  • 2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
  • Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
  • Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
  • Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity

Serious bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
  • Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale

Job Description

Job Description: Business System Analyst(BSA) is a pivotal role that combines extensive data design expertise with business analysis skills. This role focuses on translating business needs into technical data solutions, ensuring data quality, and facilitating data-driven decision-making. The individual will leverage their in-depth experience in data warehousing, particularly within the SQL Server and Microsoft Azure stack, to drive data analysis, requirements gathering, and solution design.

Key Responsibilities

Data Design and Analysis: Utilize extensive data design expertise to analyze and interpret complex data sets, ensuring data quality and integrity. Develop and maintain data models, schemas, and data dictionaries to support business requirements.

Technical Solutions: Translate business needs into technical data solutions, leveraging the Microsoft Azure stack. Design and implement data warehousing solutions, ETL processes, and data pipelines to support data-driven decision-making.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Scrum Masters (SMs), Product Owners (POs), and Team Leads (TLs) in an Agile methodology. Facilitate communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure alignment of project goals and deliverables.

Documentation and Artifacts: Maintain necessary artifacts, including requirements documentation, data flow diagrams, and technical specifications. Ensure all documentation is up-to-date and accessible to relevant stakeholders.

Agile Methodology: Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance team performance and project outcomes.

Technical Skills

Data Warehousing: Proficient in data warehousing, including 2+ years with Microsoft Azure Data Lake ingestion and curation processes. Azure expertise is strongly preferred, including provisioning, configuration, and development using Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory.

ETL Processes: Expertise in designing and implementing ETL processes to extract, transform, and load data from various sources. Familiarity with tools such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, and other ETL technologies.

Data Models: Familiarity with data models, including snowflake and star schema Datawarehouse models, schemas, and data dictionaries. Experience with both relational and dimensional data modeling techniques.

SQL: SSIS, Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to write complex queries, optimize query performance, and troubleshoot SQL-related issues.

Business Analysis: Strong business analysis skills, including the ability to gather and document requirements, conduct gap analysis, and develop functional specifications. Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and familiarity with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is also preferred

Soft Skills

Communication: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly and efficiently.

Collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, with a focus on achieving project goals and delivering high-quality results.

Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and priorities, with a flexible and proactive approach to work.

Who We Are

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Every day, we strive to make every interaction, product, and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple for over 27 million households and businesses in Canada, the United States and around the world. More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Title: Software Developer - Data and AI (12 month contract)
Description:
Hammond Power Solutions Inc. is a global manufacturer headquartered in Guelph, Ontario, Canada. HPS has grown to become the leader in North America in the custom design and manufacture of dry type transformers. For the past century, HPS has grown to deliver electrical power solutions to global markets and provides solutions for complex applications like, mining, rectifier, drives, traction, wind, solar and many other electrical power applications. The world relies on HPS to continually conceive and produce state-of-the-art transformer technology. We currently have an opening for a Software Developer, Data and AI– 12 month contract, come grow with us!

Reporting to the Manager, Software Development, this role designs, develops and maintains enterprise data solutions that support business operations and strategic decision-making, including data solution architecture, integration and transformation. The incumbent also contributes to AI project lifecycle activities --- data preparation, model implementation, deployment, and ongoing support --- while building scalable, cloud-ready software applications.

Working closely with business stakeholders across departments, this role gathers requirements, implements and delivers data and AI-driven solutions, and ensures effective knowledge transfer through user training and support.

Key Responsibilities Include


Design end-to-end data solutions (data models, data warehouse, data marts, semantic layers and OLAP cubes) to support analytics, reporting and AI use cases.
Implement modernization and cloud migration for legacy warehouses and pipelines
Ensure data quality, lineage and observability across pipelines and models;
Design and deliver BI dashboards, self-service reports.
Document architecture, data flows and data definitions to support maintainability
Collaborate on AI/ML project design; translate business problems into data and modeling requirements.
Prepare datasets: cleaning, enrichment and feature engineering
Assist with model integration, deployment, monitoring and retraining procedures
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Efficiently leverage AI-powered coding assistants to develop and deliver high-quality software solutions.
Create and maintain efficient, scalable, and secure code.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement.
Streamline business processes by creating seamless data flows.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to existing data systems and software applications.


Do you qualify? We are seeking:


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
2+ years’ professional experience in SQL and ETL design, with solid understanding dimensional modelling and data warehousing concepts, ensuring efficient storage, retrieval and analysis of large datasets.
Experience with AI/ML technologies including: LLM, Prompt Engineering, Vector Databases, AI Agents, Agentic AI, AI-powered coding, and MCP.
Prior experience in Azure Technologies such as Data Fabric, Synapse, ADFS, App Service, CI/CD pipeline and Power BI.
AI-powered programming experience with Python, C or C#.
Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for software development.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.


NOTE: Hammond Power Solutions encourages applications from all qualified candidates. HPS has a great record of accommodating persons with disabilities. Contact our People & Culture team if you need accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information on our accommodation policies.

Some Of The Benefits Of Working At Hammond

At Hammond Power Solutions (HPS), we provide market‑competitive compensation that reflects performance, skills, and current market conditions. For this role, the base salary range is $96,800.00 to $145,200.00 with final offers determined by experience, qualifications, and role complexity.

We recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique strengths, and we do not want this range to limit or discourage anyone from applying. In addition to base pay, this position includes a comprehensive benefits package and is eligible for performance‑based incentives. We welcome open conversations about compensation throughout the hiring process.

We are Great Place to Work Certified! Our people work hard for us—so we make sure our benefits work hard for them. Our equitable pay, benefits, and practices prioritize security, health, and well-being while sharing in our business success through variable pay programs and our Employee Stock Ownership Program.

Our core benefits focus on wellness, mental health, and financial security when employees need them the most, early career or getting ready for retirement. We also support work-life balance through flexible work schedules, paid time off, and leaves of absence. Employees and their families also have access to our confidential, best-in-class Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP).

We are committed to sustainable business practices and offer opportunities for our employees to support the communities where we live and work through our Hammond Giving Strategy.
