Description:
Position Snapshot

Business area: Nestlé Purina

Location: Mississauga, ON located at 2500 Royal Windsor Dr, Mississauga ON L5J 1K8;

Hybrid

A Little Bit About Us

As a company made up of pet owners, we believe that pets and people are better together. If you share our passion for pets and you're looking for a career where you can take ownership, collaborate and contribute to challenging, satisfying and meaningful work, then you are the type of person we want at Nestlé Purina PetCare Canada. We are a leader in the pet care and pet nutrition industry, producing Canada’s best loved brands including Alpo ®, Beneful ®, Beyond ®, Dog Chow ®, Cat Chow ®, Fancy Feast®, Friskies®, Tidy Cats®, Pro Plan®, ONE, DentaLife®, Beggin'® and many more. Join us in enriching the lives of pets and the people who love them.

What to Expect:

As a Business Analyst, you will be responsible for data modeling, translating data into actionable intelligence, play a lead role in business review and promotional analysis/evaluations within the Pureplay team to drive key performance indicators and optimize investment. This position is an existing vacancy.

A day in the life:


Be proficient at building complex models to assess operational opportunities and drive implementation cross functionally. Leverage diverse technology platforms to refine and automate data sources, harmonize data points, and model "what if" scenarios that can be used to evaluate and predict the impact to performance.
Harmonize and make sense of disparate datasets to determine business and operational trends and drive action. The ability to analyze unstructured data, form relationships, and provide insights into key elements for various levels of the organization is crucial to success.
Clearly communicate insights in context, translate data into visualizations that aid decision-making, demonstrate business insight, and align with business priorities.
Play a key supportive role in building the annual business plan based upon analytical review of historical and competitive data and strategic direction for the category, brand, and customer.
Provides input to support Trade Spend management
Provide analyses of promotional performance to drive future decision-making and support development of optimal promotion and media calendar
Be the liaison in communication between cross functional groups internally focusing on Customer Insights, Trade Development (i.e., new item launches, seasonal opportunities), Sales Finance, Supply chain etc.
Manage and develop customer administration: Contracts, New Product Forms, Pricing Adjustments, Customer Listing Base / Distribution. Additional support as required on an ad-hoc basis within the Customer Business Team


Role Requirements


Hold a university degree or have equivalent experience in a Business-related field
Minimum of 2-3 years of business intelligence experience supporting CPG sales team(s).
Experience working in an analytic or category management role with Amazon and other digital retailers (i.e., Walmart, Loblaws and/or Viola).
Must have advanced proficiency with Amazon Vendor Central
Experience with Power BI (or comparable platform) is required, including visualization, parameters, report optimization, creating measures, modeling, reports/dashboards, and dataflows. Experience in the Power Platform is preferred (Power Automate, Power Apps).
Have some experience in the extraction and analysis with Nielsen.
Ability to look at the data trends and recommend solutions that tie together a business problem and technology solution that may not have a clearly defined relationship or organizationally paved path to create revenue and reduce loss.


Preferred Skills


Ability to develop selling story/recommendations as output of analysis.
Have financial acumen and an understanding of P&L drivers.
Ability to work on several large projects at one time, with many data streams and deadlines. Being able to balance work and prioritize effectively are crucial to the job.
Demonstrate curiosity, continuous exploration and improvement, and ability to adapt to the changing needs of the business.


Benefits


Comprehensive total rewards benefits package including Health and Dental benefits that start on day one of employment
Company matched pension plan
Three weeks of Vacation and five personal days (Personal Paid Holidays)
Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
Excellent training and development programs as well as opportunities to grow within the company
Access to Educational Assistance & Tuition Reimbursement
Bonus eligibility
Gender affirmation benefits to ensure access to necessary care, resources, and coverage for gender-affirming procedures
Fertility Services and Surrogacy Medical Coverage to support the pursuit of a path to parenthood regardless of medical conditions, gender or sexual orientation
Adoption benefits to remove some of the financial barriers associated with adoption
Up to 50% off – Nespresso Coffee Machine, Capsules and accessories
Access to the Discount Company store with Nestlé, Nespresso, and Purina products (Located across various Nestle offices/sites)
Bring your dog to work!


Compensation Range: CAD 81,000 - CAD 85,000 + Bonus Eligibility

  • Be proficient at building complex models to assess operational opportunities and drive implementation cross functionally. Leverage diverse technology platforms to refine and automate data sources, harmonize data points, and model "what if" scenarios that can be used to evaluate and predict the impact to performance.

  • Clearly communicate insights in context, translate data into visualizations that aid decision-making, demonstrate business insight, and align with business priorities.
  • Play a key supportive role in building the annual business plan based upon analytical review of historical and competitive data and strategic direction for the category, brand, and customer.
  • Provides input to support Trade Spend management
  • Provide analyses of promotional performance to drive future decision-making and support development of optimal promotion and media calendar

Title: MarTech Data & Insights Specialist
Description:
Company Description

About Us:

With a history that dates back over 80 years, Starcom is a global communications planning and media leader. We are an agency still grounded in our founding principle that people are at center of all we do. Each day, we apply this belief to harness the transformative power of data and technology to inspire and move people and business forward. With more than 7,000 employees in over 100 offices around the world, Starcom partners with the world's leading marketers and brands.

Within Canada, Starcom is a part of Publicis Media within Publicis Groupe, one of the world’s leading communications groups. Our team spans across our Windsor, Toronto and Montreal offices. We truly love the world of Media and Advertising. We see the planning and buying process as art. However, it is an art that is always best when backed by the science of empirical data.

You will be joining a well recognised agency with credentials:


Great Places to Work certified three years in a row
Only communications company to be ranked in LinkedIn’s Top 25 Great Places to Work
2022 Media Agency of the Year
2023 Media Agency of the Year finalist


What We Offer


Work Your World program enabling you to experience working from anywhere in Canada or overseas for up to 6 weeks a year
Extended long weekends throughout the year with an additional day off each long weekend
Wellness & Tech benefits to support what’s most important to you
Birthday leave
Extensive Learning & Development opportunities, including more than 15,000 learning programs via our online learning platform as well as a Professional Development Allowance
Local and Global Mobility within the Publicis Groupe network


Overview

The Data Activation Specialist will be responsible for utilizing digital platforms and transforming vast data sets into actionable insights that inform targeting and optimization; specifically,

connecting or extracting data, tracking, measuring, and analyzing and optimizing digital media for improved conversion and business performance. You will be part of a growing team, reporting to the Data Activation Manager and will have the opportunity to learn and grow in the emerging field of data strategy, data activation and data analysis.

Responsibilities


Ingest disparate digital data sources across Paid, Owned and Earned Digital Media into a consolidated environment for tracking
Learn how to set up automated process for data extraction, via API, SFTP, SQL etc.
Extract, transform and load data for ingestion into business intelligence platforms
Learn how to build dashboards in business intelligence platforms
Build and deploy semi-automated Excel and PowerPoint digital reporting solutions such as campaign performance tracking
Provide the Planning and Buying teams with analysis, insights and data-informed recommendations from the aforementioned reporting areas
Opportunity to work across key business intelligence platforms for digital media, mainly Datorama
Translate strategy into implementation tactics Data mapping and enhancement
Create segments relevant to objectives that can be pushed to relevant destinations for activation
Translate objectives into digital media measurement plans
Analyze and report on campaign performance through standardized ad-server attribution models
Learn how to build simplistic algorithmic attribution models and implement them
Work alongside data scientists to deploy more complex algorithmic attribution models
Make data-informed recommendations for optimizing digital media and content
Opportunity to work on key attribution platforms such as Google’s Data-Driven
Attribution model with DoubleClick, and proprietary Publicis Media platforms


Qualifications


3-4 years’ experience in Digital Media in Planning/Buying and/or 1 – 2 years Data Science experience
Technically competent and capable of working with and learning new digital and tech platforms
Strong numerical and analytical skills
Demonstrated ability to convert data analysis into meaningful action for brands
Experience with or strong knowledge of ad servers and web analytics platforms such as
DoubleClick, Adobe Media Optimizer, Sizmek, Google Analytics or Adobe Omniture
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Ability to cope under pressure and deliver to tight deadlines autonomously.


Additional Information

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process upon request.

Salary

Transparency matters to us. The salary range for this position is $45 - 50k per year. Actual compensation within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and applicable certifications. This range reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on current market data.

AI Use

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications or analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision-making. We believe in a human-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people.

Starcom is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion. We create and nurture a vibrant work environment that celebrates, values and leverages all aspects of diversity and inclusiveness, attracts world-class talent and serves as the industry benchmark for best practices. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and will provide appropriate accommodation for candidates with disabilities or accessibility needs throughout the recruitment process, upon request. Please contact our recruiter for any questions, accommodations or specific requests. We thank all candidates for their interest in Starcom however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted

Title: Analyst, Data Strategy
Description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is a global, luxury hotel management company. We manage over 130 hotels and resorts and 50 private residences in 47 countries around the world and growing. Central to Four Seasons employee experience and social impact programming is the company’s commitment to supporting cancer research, and the advancement of diversity, inclusion, equality and belonging at Four Seasons corporate offices and properties worldwide. At Four Seasons, we are powered by people and our culture enables everything we do.

Analyst, Data Strategy

As a Data Strategy Analyst, you will report to the Director, Data Strategy and Product Assurance and work closely with the Manager of Data Strategy, playing a crucial role in supporting the organization's data strategy and governance initiatives. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will gather data requirements, assist in developing and implementing comprehensive data strategies, and ensure the alignment of data usage with business goals.

You will leverage your data analytics expertise to help maintain data roadmaps, build process data flows, manage project management tools, support certification of products based on governance standards and help execute overall data strategy. This position will also work in collaboration with the delivery team, and product managers to ensure the analytics program is enabling the overall data strategy.

This role is based in our temporary location of 20 York Mills Rd, then the Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts, Toronto Corporate Office. This role involves interactions with both internal and external stakeholders at various levels.

What You’ll Be Doing


Support the manager in implementing relevant data governance policies and work closely with product owners to ensure data products are certified for use.
Assist in maintaining the data roadmap, ensuring alignment of data usage with evolving business strategies, emerging technologies, and data sources.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with data stewards, product owners, and other key stakeholders to facilitate collaboration and data stewardship.
Facilitation and maintenance of the ongoing data strategy and roadmap.
Support intake of new data products through stakeholder communication, maintenance of templates, and scheduling of oversight and governance meetings.
Collaborate with project managers and delivery teams to support the development and delivery of data products that provide value to the business.
Assist in strengthening the organization’s data foundation through the implementation of effective policies, standards, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
Work with the manager to create and maintain training materials, playbooks, and reference guides to promote consistent adoption of data governance practices across teams.
Provide ongoing support and training on product certification requirements.
Oversee implementation of data strategy.
Support the manager in tracking and reporting on budget utilization across data and analytics projects, highlighting key variances and potential risks.
Assist in preparing program level budget and spend summaries to inform planning and prioritization.
Collaborate with D&A teams to create initial cost and resource estimates for new project requests.
Program Budget and Performance Tracking.
Identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement in data management processes.
Communicate the value of data-driven decision making and foster a data-driven culture by promoting awareness and understanding of the importance of data.
Proactive research and promote use of data to enable FS strategy.


What You Bring


Bachelor’s in a relevant field (e.g. Data Management, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Informatics).
Strong understanding of data governance frameworks and principles.
Experience managing data lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to align data strategy with business goals.
Experience in data strategy development and implementation.
Ability to adapt data strategies to evolving business needs and changing landscape.
Analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends, detect anomalies, and translate complex data sets into actionable insights and strategies.
Experience with data governance tools and technologies such as informatica.
Strong knowledge of data protection regulations, and compliance standards.
Applied experience in data governance and / or data management.
Knowledge of industry leading data governance practices.
Familiar with implementation and use various data governance tools and software.
Familiar with DMBOK principles.
Understand of complete data lifecycle and related data governance requirements.
Understanding of GDPR and related legislation.
Ability to manipulate, analyze and transform large datasets to understand trends and patterns.
Working knowledge of cloud computing platforms. MS Azure preferred (Microsoft Synapse, Azure Data factory, Azure Databricks, PowerBI).
Proficient in SQL or other programming languages.
Experience with data visualization and dashboarding (Power BI, Tableau).
Expert in Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access).
Working knowledge of project management tools such as Monday.com and Jira.


Who You Are

Business / Analytics Skills


Works to understand the business need and how the data will be used to drive decisions into action plans that will grow the business.
Effectively navigates through ambiguity and complexity to provide clarity for the team and the requester.
Works well under pressure and can manage multiple tasks under time constraints.
Strong with process management including the development of processes and procedures.
Familiar with agile methodology and comfortable working in an agile environment.


Communication Skills


Works to understand the requester needs when building the upfront story to ensure clarity and actionability.
Listens carefully to understand requirements and seeks clarity as needed.
Provides well-structured reports and documents to convey analysis and insights that are clear, concise and reader-friendly.
Demonstrates understanding of the importance of storytelling by incorporating visual enhancements into presentations.
Strong interpersonal skills and team player.


Planning / Organizational Skills


Demonstrates the ability to organize and work with high volumes of data.
Establishes clear expectations to ensure smooth execution.
Handles multiple demands and conflicting priorities by quickly re-allocating time and resources.
Organizes self and the team in setting and managing priorities.
Demonstrates a relentlessly high standard for attention to detail and holds others to the same.
Delivers on commitments on time and on budget.


People Engagement


Takes the time to acknowledge the efforts and contributions of others.
Works to build relationships with colleagues to both provide and receive the best support.


Collaboration Skills


Works productively in a matrix environment to move projects along and foster a positive team attitude.
Proactively asks for input and ideas from others to demonstrate the power of the team.


Salary Range: $70,000 – $85,000 CAD

This role will be a Hybrid working model, which will require 3 days per week at our temporary 20 York Mills Road, Toronto, Ontario location with travel, as needed, to our Four Seasons Corporate Office located at 1165 Leslie Street, Toronto, Ontario

Four Seasons is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If contacted for an employment opportunity, please advise Human Resources if you require accommodation.

Title: Data Scientist II
Description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Job Overview:

At Coursera, our Data Science team is helping to build the future of education through data-driven decision-making and data-powered products. We drive product and business strategy through measurement, experimentation, and causal inference to help Coursera deliver effective content discovery and personalized learning at scale. We believe the next generation of teaching and learning should be personalized, accessible, and efficient. With our scale, data, technology, and talent, Coursera and its Data Science team are positioned to make that vision a reality.

We’re looking for a knowledgeable Data Scientist - Business Analytics to support decision-making for our business and consumer leadership teams. This role will be leveraging the rich data captured by over 200M+ learners and thousands of instructors engaging on the platform to identify business trends, define and track KPIs, and deliver data-driven insights that help shape consumer strategy. This role will partner closely with business leaders across the organization to align on strategic priorities and measure business performance. Our ideal candidate possesses strong analytical and reporting skills, familiarity with trend analysis and KPI frameworks, strong business acumen, and the ability to translate analysis into actionable recommendations that inform consumer and business strategy.

Responsibilities:


Develop a deep understanding of Coursera’s business, market, and learners to identify trends and translate them into actionable insights and recommendations.
Analyze business performance, define and track KPIs, and conduct deep dives into consumer behavior and business trends.
Partner with business leaders to shape consumer strategy and inform strategic prioritization.
Support analytics teams to build dashboards and reporting systems for tracking key business and consumer metrics.
Present findings and recommendations to business leaders and cross-functional partners clearly and concisely.


Basic Qualifications:


Background in economics, statistics, data science, computer science, or a related technical field
3+ years of experience as a data scientist, data analyst, or business intelligence analyst
Strong SQL skills and proficiency with at least one scripting language (e.g. Python, R)
Proficiency in BI tools (e.g. Sigma, Databricks, Looker, Tableau)
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data findings into actionable insights
Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously


Preferred Qualifications:


5+ years of experience using data to advise business, marketing, or consumer strategy teams
Advanced proficiency with SQL and Python to produce clear and actionable insights
Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate data analysis, generate insights, or enhance analytical workflows
Familiarity with online education platforms, specifically with platforms like Coursera and Udemy


If this opportunity interests you, you might like these courses on Coursera:


Go Beyond the Numbers: Translate Data into Insights
Design of Experiments
Google Advanced Data Analytics


Compensation:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The starting base pay for this role is between $113,600 CAD and $142,000 CAD. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, and location. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role is also eligible for bonus, equity, and benefits.

OverviewApplication

About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.

We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.

We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

OUR MISSION

Robotics will become the largest industry in human history — larger than anything that has come before it. As intelligent machines move into the physical world, they will dramatically expand global GDP, raise the material standard of living for everyone, and ultimately help make humanity a multiplanetary civilization. None of that happens without one thing: enormous amounts of high-quality, real-world data.

Mecka AI builds that foundation. We are the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI — the substrate that teaches machines to perceive, reason, and act in reality. Get this right, and we accelerate the most important technological transition of our time.

OUR CULTURE

Excellence as the baseline. We hold an extremely high bar and expect the best work of your career. Mediocrity isn't interesting to us.

Highly technical. We reason from first principles, not by analogy. The best argument wins — regardless of title or tenure.

Truth-seeking. We are relentlessly honest with ourselves and each other. We chase reality — measured, not assumed — and kill our own bad ideas fast.

Maniacal urgency. The work matters and the clock is real. We move fast, ship, measure, and iterate.

Extreme ownership. You own outcomes end-to-end — no hand-offs, no excuses, no waiting for permission.

Hardcore. This is a high-intensity environment for people who want to do the defining work of their lives.

THE ROLE

Own the last mile of Mecka's business

We're hiring a Data Delivery Lead to turn our raw captured, labeled, and validated data into the exact deliverable a frontier robotics lab pays for — assembled correctly, validated ruthlessly, and documented clearly.

This is a hands-on, data-native role. You come from a data analytics or data engineering background and are fluent in SQL and working with large, messy datasets. You'll live at the seam between our internal data systems and our customers' specs: translating what a lab asks for into concrete queries and quality gates, pulling and packaging the final cut, running it through validation before anyone else sees it, and producing the reports and catalogs that ship alongside it.

You make sure that when a deliverable leaves Mecka, it is exactly right — and that we are our own strictest customer long before the actual customer opens the box.

The role blends deep data analysis with technical delivery ownership. You won't necessarily write production pipelines day-to-day, but you'll understand our data stack well enough to direct engineering, query it directly, and catch problems no dashboard would surface.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Deliverable assembly & export


Pull the final delivery cut from our internal data systems (document and columnar databases, and file stores)
Format data to each customer's schema; generate manifests, indexes, and packaging
Stage and hand off deliveries to customer buckets and cloud storage reliably and reproducibly
Own the mechanics of the drop end-to-end, so nothing ships half-assembled


Delivery QA & validation — the strictest-customer bar


Run every deliverable through Mecka's ship-gates before it goes out
Design and execute validation: coverage stats, stratified sample audits, schema compliance, quality-drift detection
Set an internal acceptance bar higher than the customer's own QC — catch it here, never there
Build and maintain golden reference sets and repeatable checks so quality is measured, not assumed


Spec translation


Turn a customer's data specification into concrete, testable gates and queries
Translate back into what capture, labeling, and CV operations must actually produce to hit that spec
Serve as the technical interpreter between customer requirements and internal execution


Customer-facing delivery artifacts


Produce delivery reports, data catalogs, sample packs, and schema documentation that accompany each drop
Keep a canonical "our strongest work, today" reference pack always current
Make the quality and shape of the data legible to a technical customer at a glance


Throughput & delivery management


Track delivery performance against timelines and SLAs; ensure they're consistently met
Identify bottlenecks in the assembly-to-ship path and drive them out
Ensure the delivery process scales as volume and customer count grow


Cross-functional & stakeholder execution


Partner with data capture, labeling operations, and engineering to close spec gaps
Own delivery communication with internal teams and external customers
Keep timelines, risks, and deliverable status transparent to everyone who needs it


WHO YOU ARE

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE


1–3 years in data analytics, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a similarly data-heavy role
Fluent in SQL; comfortable querying and reshaping large, imperfect datasets independently
Working proficiency with a scripting language (Python preferred) for data manipulation, validation, and automation
Solid grasp of data pipelines, schemas, and data-quality concepts
Proven ability to own a data workflow or deliverable end-to-end
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management abilities


STRONG SIGNALS


Experience in fast-paced startups or high-growth environments
Exposure to ML / AI training data, data labeling, or dataset delivery
Experience with NoSQL / document stores and/or columnar analytics databases (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake)
Built QA / validation tooling or data-quality checks
Strong intuition for prioritization and tradeoffs between speed, quality, and cost


YOU ARE


Rigorous and detail-obsessed — you find the error before the customer does
Structured in your thinking but flexible in execution
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast-changing environments
Data-native — your instinct is to measure, not assume
Calm under pressure, able to run multiple deliveries in parallel without dropping quality

Robotics will become the largest industry in human history — larger than anything that has come before it. Title: Pricing Analyst/Strategist
Description:
Position Overview

We’re looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Pricing Specialist to help shape and execute our pricing strategy across Canada and the U.S. This is not a role for someone who simply maintains price lists. We’re looking for someone who is curious about why a product should be priced a certain way, how pricing impacts customer behaviour, margin and revenue, and how different pricing strategies should work across channels and markets.




You’ll work across our ecommerce business, sales channels and internal systems to help ensure our pricing is competitive, commercially sound and designed to maximise revenue and profitability.

This role is ideal for someone who loves data, enjoys solving puzzles and is comfortable moving between strategy and execution. One day you may be analysing competitor pricing and identifying opportunities across thousands of products; the next, you may be digging into ecommerce pricing logic, investigating why a price is displaying incorrectly or helping design a new pricing rule.




Key Responsibilities and How You’ll Make an Impact

Help develop and execute pricing strategy across our Canadian and U.S. businesses
Analyse pricing performance across products, categories, brands, customer segments and sales channels
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, margin, conversion and overall competitiveness
Monitor competitor pricing and market dynamics to understand where we are positioned and where opportunities exist
Develop pricing recommendations based on customer behaviour, competitive data, product economics and business objectives
Explore and refine ecommerce pricing logic, including how prices, promotions, discounts and customer-specific pricing are displayed online
Analyse price elasticity and test new pricing approaches and measure their impact
Work directly within internal systems and pricing tools to implement, test and troubleshoot pricing changes
Investigate pricing discrepancies and determine the root cause across systems, data feeds and ecommerce platforms
Build and maintain pricing rules, guardrails and processes that allow the business to make faster, smarter pricing decisions
Evaluate promotional pricing and discount strategies to understand their impact on revenue and profitability
Partner with Marketing, Sales, Purchasing, Finance, Data, Ecommerce and Technology teams on pricing initiatives
Analyse large datasets to uncover patterns, anomalies and opportunities that may not be immediately obvious
Partner with the Data team on reporting and dashboards that make pricing performance and opportunities easy to understand
Continuously look for opportunities to automate, improve and scale how pricing decisions are made across the organisation




What We’re Looking For

A highly analytical thinker who genuinely enjoys working with numbers and solving complex problems
Someone who is naturally curious and likes asking “Why is this happening?” and “How could we make this better?”
Strong commercial instincts and an understanding of how pricing influences revenue, profitability and customer behaviour
Comfortable working at both the strategic and executional level
Experience with SQL, Python, pricing automation or data visualisation tools is mandatory
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience working with large datasets is important
Experience with BI, analytics, ERP, ecommerce or pricing platforms is an asset
Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with large product catalogues and complex pricing structures
Ability to take an ambiguous business problem, dig into the data and develop a clear recommendation
Comfortable collaborating across multiple departments and translating analysis into practical business decisions
Experience in ecommerce, distribution, retail, B2B or another high-SKU environment would be particularly valuable




You’ll Love This Role If You...

Love finding patterns in data.
Get satisfaction from figuring out why something doesn’t make sense.
Think of a complicated pricing problem as a puzzle you want to solve.
Enjoy testing hypotheses rather than accepting “that’s how we’ve always done it.”
Can think strategically but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and getting into the system.
And like the idea of having a direct impact on how a growing North American business makes one of its most important commercial decisions: what we charge.

High-impact role with real ownership
Collaborative HR team and supportive leadership
Opportunity to help build and scale talent programs
A fun, focused, and execution-driven environment

Title: BI Engineer
Description:
Who We Are:

At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful.

We’re a technology company building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.

We’re a data company helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.

And we’re an innovation company accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Values:

Driven Waybuilders. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.

Relentless Curiosity. We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.

Smart Risk-Taking. We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.

Fearless Ownership. We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.
 

We’re Looking For:

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Engineer who is solutions-oriented, proactive, and thrives in ambiguity. This individual will not simply respond to requests but will lead initiatives, identify opportunities, and use data to unlock business growth. You will play a key role in maintaining data flow across systems, building scalable data models, and partnering across teams to inform decision-making. The ideal candidate will have 2+ years of experience in Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing, with deep expertise in SQL, data pipelines, visualization tools, and cloud-based data architecture.

You Are:

Proactive. You take full ownership of your domain and drive action independently.

Insightful. You generate meaningful, data-driven insights that fuel decision-making.

Collaborative. You work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex problems and improve processes.

Technical. You have a strong command of data engineering, visualization, and analytical tools.

You Will:

Take ownership of the Business Intelligence domain, surfacing insights, solving problems, and driving data-driven decisions

Partner with stakeholders in product, sales, and operations to ensure data quality, availability, and effective usage

Manipulate and transform large datasets using SQL and scripting languages to generate impactful business insights

Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to optimize strategies

Apply data science fundamentals to build predictive models and trend analyses

Develop scalable data models, dashboards, and reports using tools such as Domo

Continuously improve data pipelines, infrastructure, and analytical capabilities

Mentor colleagues to enhance analytics capabilities and foster a data-driven culture

Who You Will Work With:

This role reports into the BI Manager and collaborates cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Operations, and Data Engineering teams. You will also work closely with senior leadership to support key strategic initiatives.

Must Have’s:

2+ years of experience in Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence

Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, SQL Server)

Strong experience in ETL/ELT development and data pipeline management

Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java, Scala)

Strong foundation in data modeling, governance, and structuring datasets for long-term use

Expertise in data visualization and dashboarding (Domo preferred)

Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel, Google Sheets)

Self-starter with strong problem-solving and strategic thinking capabilities
 

Nice to Have’s:

Experience working with DOMO specifically

Understanding of cloud-based data architectures and security best practices

Experience creating and implementing data governance strategies

Background in data science or machine learning application

Familiarity with API integrations and automation techniques


What We Offer:

Competitive pay

Medical, dental, and vision benefits with employer HSA contributions (US) and FSA options (US)

Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match

Paid Vacation, Personal, and Sick Time

Paid maternity and paternity leave (US)

Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D (US)

Robust Employee Assistance Program

Employer paid Leap into Service Day to volunteer

Tuition Reimbursement for eligible programs

Opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge across a publicly traded, global organization

Company culture of internal promotions, diverse career paths, and meaningful advancement

Sound like a match? Apply Now - We can't wait to hear from you!
 

Compensation Range of

Annual Salary: $110,000.00 - $120,000.00 CAD

(Depending on experience, skill set, qualifications, and other relevant factors.)

Title: Lead, Reporting
Description:
Come Build Your Career at Aecon!

Aecon delivers some of the most complex and impactful infrastructure projects — from transformative transportation networks to critical energy, industrial and nuclear programs. The projects we build connect communities and power future generations. With deep roots in North America and a strong footprint internationally, Aecon brings global expertise and proudly serves public and private sector clients through its Construction and Concessions segment.

Safety Always is not only our #1 core value – it is the standard that anchors our culture. We believe the most ambitious projects deserve the most committed people. At Aecon, you won’t just build your career — you’ll help build what matters to enable future generations to thrive.

At Aecon, You Can Count On


Safety Always. Our number one core value. The safety of our people, projects, partners, and stakeholders is our priority focus – today and always.
Integrity. We lead by example, with humility and courage.
Accountability. We’re passionate about delivering on our commitments.
Inclusion. We provide opportunities where people feel valued, supported, and empowered to contribute fully.



We deliver infrastructure with purpose, and our people are at the heart of everything we do. Aecon employees are incredibly proud to build some of the most impactful infrastructure of this generation – we call it Aecon Proud.

At Aecon We


Ensure you and your family receive the services and benefits needed to support your mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
Are intentional when it comes to investing in your development. We help you build your career and advance your skills through our Aecon University, tuition reimbursement, and Leadership Programs.
Are committed to creating work environments focused on mutual respect, teamwork, collaboration, and new ideas, through meaningful initiatives, training, partnerships with Veteran groups, our Aecon Women in Trades and diversity programs, as well as our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), to ensure we are building with top talent and harnessing our collective strengths within every aspect of our culture.
Operate responsibly by managing risk, safety, and environmental considerations across all our projects and surrounding communities.



Our success is built on the passion, expertise, and dedication of our people. Together, we embrace strong execution, innovation, and continuous improvement — values that come to life through the unique talents and collaborative spirit of every team member. If you’re inspired to make a difference through future-building projects, join our best-in-class team.

What is the Opportunity?

Reporting to the Project Controls Manager, the Senior Reporting & Analytics Lead will lead project reporting, business intelligence, and analytics initiatives, delivering integrated reporting solutions that provide visibility into project performance. The role will drive the adoption of Microsoft Power Platform technologies, integrate data across multiple enterprise systems, establish reporting governance standards, and provide actionable insights on cost, schedule, risk, and operational performance to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement across the project lifecycle.

What You'll Do Here


Develop, maintain, and continually enhance an integrated project reporting framework, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and alignment across cost, schedule, risk, resource, estimating, and operational reporting.
Lead the design, development, deployment, and governance of Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Microsoft Fabric, and related technologies to support reporting, analytics, automation, and operational processes.
Lead the integration of project systems including SAP, Primavera P6, InEight, Aconex, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and other enterprise platforms, ensuring data consistency and scalability across reporting and analytics solutions.
Develop reporting requirements in collaboration with stakeholders, management, and operations teams, and deliver standardized reporting solutions that provide meaningful insights into project performance and support data-driven decision-making.
Analyze and report on project performance, including cost, schedule, progress, forecasting, trends, risks, opportunities, and other key performance indicators, providing actionable recommendations to senior leadership and project executives.
Establish reporting and data governance standards, including KPI definitions, reporting controls, data validation processes, reporting calendars, data ownership, quality assurance processes, and a single source of truth for project performance reporting.
Provide leadership and subject matter expertise in reporting, analytics, data management, and Power Platform solutions, promoting best practices and supporting capability development across the project team.
Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reporting processes, streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and maximize project performance.



What You Bring To The Team


Minimum 6 years' experience in reporting, business intelligence, project controls, data analytics, or a related role, preferably within large-scale construction, infrastructure, transit, rail, or transportation projects.
Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
Advanced experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Microsoft Fabric, with demonstrated experience developing enterprise reporting, analytics, and workflow automation solutions. Microsoft Power BI, Power Platform, Fabric, or related Microsoft certifications are considered an asset.

Description:
Systems Administr ator & Business Analyst

Department: Information Technology/ Business Systems

Location: On -Site Niagara Falls, Ontario

Employment Type: Full Time

Reports To: IT Director

Innovation Flows Here.

Officially opening its doors in 2024, the University of Niagara Falls Canada (UNF) is an innovative and digitally oriented institution that prepares graduates for leadership in the digital world. We believe in delivering programs that provide a direct pathway to meaningful careers in high-demand industries. UNF is part of the Global University Systems Canada group of institutions and Global University Systems, an international network of higher education institutions.

Our location

Our campus is located in historic downtown Niagara Falls. Beyond being Canada’s #1 travel destination, Niagara Falls is a small vibrant city that offers up a slice of metropolitan living at a different pace. From world-class dining and entertainment options to luxury shopping and cultural experiences. Our location offers the amenities of a large urban centre within a comfortable, liveable community.

Position Summary

The University of Niagara Falls Canada is seeking an experienced Systems Administrator & Business Analyst to support the administration, optimization and continued development of the university's Ellucian Colleague student information system and related enterprise systems.

This is a hybrid role that combines two complementary skill sets. As a Systems Administrator, the incumbent keeps Colleague and its connected systems secure, reliable and well-maintained — owning configuration, upgrades, access, monitoring, backups and integrations. As a Business Analyst, they work directly with operational teams — particularly the Registrar's Office and Finance — to understand business needs, improve processes, gather and document requirements, and translate them into practical system solutions, reports and enhancements.

It is a hands-on, dual-skilled position requiring strong technical and system-administration capability alongside solid business-analysis and process-improvement skills, plus the stakeholder engagement to serve as a key link between institutional departments, internal IT, external vendors and Ellucian.

Key Responsibilities

System Administration


Administer, configure and maintain Ellucian Colleague and related enterprise systems, including application, environment and integration layers.
Manage system upgrades, patches, testing and release management across development, test and production environments.
Provision and manage user accounts, roles, permissions and security in line with institutional policy.
Monitor system performance, availability, capacity and data integrity; proactively identify and resolve issues.
Administer backups, recovery and business-continuity processes for supported systems.
Maintain system documentation, configuration records and technical standard operating procedures.
Coordinate incidents, changes and scheduled maintenance with internal IT, Ellucian and third-party vendors.
Develop and maintain scripts and automation to streamline administrative and operational tasks.


Business Analysis


Partner with university departments to elicit, analyze and document business and functional requirements.
Map current-state processes, perform gap analysis and design improved workflows supported by Colleague.
Translate operational requirements into functional specifications, system configurations and technical solutions.
Facilitate requirements-gathering and design sessions and manage stakeholder expectations.
Plan and coordinate system testing, including preparing test cases and leading user acceptance testing (UAT).
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency, accuracy and service delivery.
Develop process maps, standard operating procedures, user documentation and training materials.
Ensure system processes support institutional policies, regulatory requirements and operational best practices.


Registrars office & Student Records Support


Provide dedicated support for student records, registration, enrolment, course scheduling, academic standing, grading and graduation processes.
Assist with the development and optimization of Registrar workflows and reporting requirements.
Support data-quality initiatives relating to student records and academic information.
Help resolve complex student-record and registration issues requiring technical intervention.
Support integrations and projects involving academic records, scheduling and student-lifecycle management.


Finance Support


Support the Finance team with Colleague processes relating to student accounts, tuition, fees, payments, refunds, financial reporting and reconciliation.
Develop and maintain financial reports and operational dashboards.
Assist with integrations involving payment platforms, banking systems and other financial applications.
Support Finance with process improvements, system testing and issue resolution.
Work with Finance and Registrar teams to ensure consistency between student, enrolment and financial data.


Reporting, Analytics, & Dashboards


Design, build and maintain operational reports, executive reports and dashboards.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, data definitions and performance indicators.
Develop automated reporting processes to reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets.
Support institutional data governance and ensure reports are accurate, consistent and appropriately secured.
Assist leadership and operational teams with timely access to reliable information for decision-making.
Collaborate with analytics teams to support live dashboards and institutional reporting requirements.


Systems Integration & Project Support


Support current and future integrations between Ellucian Colleague and other institutional systems.
Participate in the planning, design, testing and implementation of new applications and integrations.
Develop and maintain data extracts, interfaces, APIs and scheduled data-transfer processes where required.
Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to ensure integrations are secure, reliable and properly documented.
Provide technical support for strategic institutional projects involving student, academic, financial or operational systems.
Participate in requirements gathering, testing, implementation planning and post-launch support.


Stakeholder Engagment & Training


Act as a key technical and functional resource for Colleague users across the university.
Build strong working relationships with department leaders, subject-matter experts and system users.
Facilitate requirements-gathering sessions and translate business needs into practical solutions.
Provide training, guidance and knowledge transfer to staff.
Develop user guides, training materials and technical documentation.
Communicate system changes, risks, issues and project progress clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.


Data Governance, Security & Compliance


Support the accuracy, completeness and consistency of institutional data.
Ensure appropriate access controls, security practices and privacy requirements are followed.
Assist with audit requests, compliance reporting and data validation.
Identify and address data-quality issues in collaboration with relevant departments.
Support the development of institutional standards for system use, reporting and data management.


Qualifications


Postsecondary degree or diploma in information technology, computer science, information systems, business systems or a related field.
Demonstrated experience administering and supporting Ellucian Colleague in a postsecondary education environment.
Solid system-administration experience — configuration, upgrades and patching, user and access management, monitoring, backups and environment management.
Strong business-analysis experience — requirements gathering, process mapping, gap analysis, functional specification and user acceptance testing.
Strong understanding of student information systems and higher-education business processes.
Experience supporting functions such as student records, registration, finance, admissions or academic operations.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, data extracts and operational analytics.
Experience with system integrations, APIs, data interfaces or middleware.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical audiences.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with multiple Ellucian Colleague modules, particularly Student, Finance and related administrative functions.
Experience with Ellucian reporting and analytics tools.
Knowledge of SQL, database concepts, data warehousing or business-intelligence tools.
Experience with Power BI or comparable dashboard and visualization platforms.
System-administration experience with Windows / Linux servers, scripting (e.g. PowerShell or Python) or scheduled-job management.
Familiarity with CRM, learning-management, payment, scheduling or document-management integrations.
Experience participating in an Ellucian Colleague implementation, migration or major enhancement project.
Knowledge of Canadian postsecondary reporting, privacy and regulatory requirements.
Business-analysis (e.g. CBAP / CCBA), ITIL or project-management certification would be considered an asset.


Key Competencies


Strong technical, system-administration and analytical capability.
Ability to understand both technical systems and operational business processes.
Service-oriented and responsive approach.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and system reliability.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
Collaborative approach to working with academic, administrative and technical teams.
Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong documentation, requirements and organizational skills.
Commitment to continuous improvement and institutional effectiveness.


Success Measures


Reliable, secure and effective operation of Ellucian Colleague and related systems.
Improved support for the Registrar's Office, Finance and other university functions.
Reduction in manual processes and system-related operational issues.
Accurate, well-documented requirements translated into effective system solutions.
Timely delivery of accurate reports and dashboards.
Successful implementation of integrations and system enhancements.
Improved data quality, documentation and user adoption.
Positive feedback from institutional stakeholders.


Application process

Interested candidates are invited to submit an application, using ONE document that includes a cover letter, resume/curriculum vitae (CV) including evidence of teaching experience and scholarly accomplishments, and teaching portfolio (if applicable), as well as the names of three references. A single PDF document is preferred. Note: file maximum of 5MB per attached upload.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Title: Customer Data Consultant
Description:
Axonify is the AI-Powered Frontline Enablement Platform that helps organizations close the gap between learning and execution. By unifying learning, execution and insights capabilities, Axonify drives real business impacts for the world's largest frontline organizations across retail, grocery, healthcare, and financial services.

More than 4 million employees across 160+ countries rely on Axonify today. It's an exciting time to join as we transform the company and build what's next.

We're a team that thinks deeply, moves with intention, and embraces new ideas. We learn quickly, keep a sharp focus on real-world impact, and take meaningful action to drive progress. And we do it as one team, with openness, creativity, and a shared drive to keep pushing what's possible.

The Role

The Customer Data Consultant is a key member of Axonify's Customer Solutions team, serving as the primary resource for customers looking to unlock the full value of their Axonify data. You'll partner directly with customers to answer complex business questions, lead analytical engagements, deliver executive-ready insights, and build scalable solutions that help customers maximize the impact of their frontline programs.

This role blends customer consulting, data analytics, technical problem solving, and business storytelling. You'll lead everything from custom data requests and Business Value Analyses to enterprise API integration consulting, while helping build the tools, frameworks, and best practices that scale how data is delivered across our customer base.

What You’ll Build

Customer Data Discovery & Custom Data Requests


Partner with customers to understand their business questions and data needs through structured discovery conversations.
Scope, prioritize, and execute Custom Data Requests by translating ambiguous business questions into clear, actionable analytical deliverables.
Own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer data requests, from intake and scoping through delivery and stakeholder presentations.
Build and maintain reusable queries, templates, and frameworks that accelerate delivery across common customer data scenarios.


Business Value Analysis


Lead the Business Value Analysis (BVA) process end-to-end—from data gathering and statistical analysis to executive-ready storytelling that quantifies program ROI.
Connect Axonify program outcomes to measurable business impact, including reduced turnover, improved compliance, and increased sales performance.
Develop scalable Business Value Analysis methodologies and analytical standards that can be consistently applied across the customer portfolio.
Collaborate with Customer Success Managers to identify Business Value Analysis opportunities throughout the customer lifecycle, including onboarding, Quarterly Business Reviews, renewals, and expansions.


In-Life API Solutions & Integrations


Lead the technical onboarding and integration of enterprise customers, guiding them from API discovery through successful production launch.
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customer development teams, troubleshooting API integrations, authentication issues, and payload mismatches.
Architect customized API solutions that align customer workflows with Axonify's product capabilities while supporting long-term scalability.


Internal Tools & Scalable Data Infrastructure


Design and build internal tools and automations that streamline data workflows, reduce manual effort, and enable scalable delivery of customer insights.
Develop scalable content auditing and data subscription capabilities that ensure consistent, high-quality customer outputs.
Establish best practices and documentation for repeatable customer reporting solutions.
Partner with Product to identify platform capability gaps and influence future productized data solutions.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Collaborate with Marketing to identify analytics opportunities that strengthen customer campaigns.
Support pre-sales and renewal conversations with data-driven business case materials.
Ensure data initiatives align with customer objectives and Axonify data governance standards.
Mentor Data Analysts by providing technical guidance and sharing best practices in data consulting and analysis.


What You’ll Bring


Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Business Analysis, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, systems analysis, or business analysis, ideally within a SaaS environment.
Proven ability to conduct customer-facing discovery conversations and translate business questions into analytical scopes.
Strong proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing relational databases or data warehouses.
Proficiency in Python or R with practical experience applying statistical methods to business problems.
Expertise with analytics and reporting tools, particularly Power BI.
Experience building Business Value Analyses and ROI models that connect program data to executive-level business outcomes.
Experience building internal tools or automation solutions that improve operational efficiency.
Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets. Experience with Google AppScript is considered a strong asset.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear strategic insights for non-technical stakeholders.
A strong consulting mindset with experience managing multiple customer engagements simultaneously.


Work Location

This role is open to candidates who are located in, and authorized to work in, Canada.

For our hybrid employees, we embrace a hybrid-flexible work environment. Most days, you choose the location that best supports your work—your home office or our Waterloo or Toronto offices. On Wednesdays, Axonifers within commuting distance come together for Work from Work Wednesdays—a day designed for collaboration, connection, and meaningful in-person moments.

Whether you are working remotely or in a hybrid environment at Axonify, you will have the tools, resources, and support you need to succeed.

What You'll Love About Axonify

We offer a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and overall success. Here's what you can expect:

Competitive Compensation: The estimated base salary range for this role is:


$103,000 - $128,000 - $153,000 CAD for candidates based in Canada.


This range reflects growth from building capability in the role to fully excelling over time, with most new hires joining near the midpoint. Actual salaries may vary within the range, or above or below it, based on factors such as experience, skills, location, and business needs.

Comprehensive Health Benefits: Health benefits from day one to support your overall wellbeing.

Time Off: 4 weeks of vacation, 7 Life Care Days, and a flexible holiday program to choose the religious, spiritual, and cultural holidays that matter most to you.

Wellbeing Support: Wellness Spending Account to support whatever wellbeing looks like for you.

Home Workspace Set-Up: Home Office Spending Account so your workspace works for you.

Family & Future Support: Parental top-up, New Parent Days, and matched retirement savings for a secure future.

Growth & Learning: Professional Development Budget to learn new skills and grow your craft.

Community Impact: Paid Volunteer Time to give back to the causes that matter to you.

In-Office Connection: Tasty Tuesdays in the office every other week because good food brings people together.

AI at Axonify

We believe AI should help people do their best work, not replace the human judgment, creativity, and connection that make us who we are. AI is a tool we use to learn fast, elevate our craft, and focus on the work that truly creates impact. That shows up in our hiring process too.

We use AI-assisted tools to create a smoother, more organized, and ultimately more human candidate experience. These tools allow our team to spend more time on real conversations and thoughtful decision-making—the things that matter.

What AI doesn't do at Axonify is make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people, using real judgment and grounded in our values.

Here's What That Means For You As a Candidate


Feel free to use AI to support your thinking—not replace it. We use AI to learn and level up, and you can too.
Be open about how you use AI if asked. Transparency helps us understand your process and how you approach problem-solving.
Stay authentic. We're hiring people, not prompts. Your ideas, your experiences, and your voice are what matter.


Diversity & Accessibility

We believe our team's unique experiences, backgrounds, cultures, beliefs, and abilities add richness to our culture and depth to our ideas. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates an environment that supports, empowers, and delivers a sense of belonging for all team members.

We want to remove any barriers that may limit you from joining Axonify. Email accessibility@axonify.com to let us know how we can support you with reasonable accommodations throughout the candidate journey.

What's Next?

Apply. Our Talent Acquisition team is committed to providing an outstanding experience throughout your journey with us.

Learn more about Axonify at www.axonify.com/careers.

Job Description

Job Description: Business System Analyst(BSA) is a pivotal role that combines extensive data design expertise with business analysis skills. This role focuses on translating business needs into technical data solutions, ensuring data quality, and facilitating data-driven decision-making. The individual will leverage their in-depth experience in data warehousing, particularly within the SQL Server and Microsoft Azure stack, to drive data analysis, requirements gathering, and solution design.

Key Responsibilities

Data Design and Analysis: Utilize extensive data design expertise to analyze and interpret complex data sets, ensuring data quality and integrity. Develop and maintain data models, schemas, and data dictionaries to support business requirements.

Technical Solutions: Translate business needs into technical data solutions, leveraging the Microsoft Azure stack. Design and implement data warehousing solutions, ETL processes, and data pipelines to support data-driven decision-making.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Scrum Masters (SMs), Product Owners (POs), and Team Leads (TLs) in an Agile methodology. Facilitate communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure alignment of project goals and deliverables.

Documentation and Artifacts: Maintain necessary artifacts, including requirements documentation, data flow diagrams, and technical specifications. Ensure all documentation is up-to-date and accessible to relevant stakeholders.

Agile Methodology: Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance team performance and project outcomes.

Technical Skills

Data Warehousing: Proficient in data warehousing, including 2+ years with Microsoft Azure Data Lake ingestion and curation processes. Azure expertise is strongly preferred, including provisioning, configuration, and development using Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory.

ETL Processes: Expertise in designing and implementing ETL processes to extract, transform, and load data from various sources. Familiarity with tools such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, and other ETL technologies.

Data Models: Familiarity with data models, including snowflake and star schema Datawarehouse models, schemas, and data dictionaries. Experience with both relational and dimensional data modeling techniques.

SQL: SSIS, Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to write complex queries, optimize query performance, and troubleshoot SQL-related issues.

Business Analysis: Strong business analysis skills, including the ability to gather and document requirements, conduct gap analysis, and develop functional specifications. Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and familiarity with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is also preferred

Soft Skills

Communication: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly and efficiently.

Collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, with a focus on achieving project goals and delivering high-quality results.

Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and priorities, with a flexible and proactive approach to work.
