Description:
Company Overview

Vortex FreightSystems (www.vortexfreight.com) is a growing third-party logistics (3PL) company that focuses on delivering customized supply chain solutions for organizations with operations in Canada, USA and Mexico. With our flexible solutions, service model and years of industry expertise, we are able to provide our customers a complete logistics program that is supported with advanced technology, proactive communication channels and exceptional customer service.




Job Overview

We are looking for a Pricing Analyst to join our five-member Pricing Team, reporting directly to the Director of Pricing &Analytics of a private equity backed company. The position is a newly created role as a result of strong organic growth to support the organization with strategic planning and analysis. The position will be responsible for developing pricing strategies, monitoring key revenue driving metrics, and provide in-depth analysis for internal reporting. The ideal candidate wants to analyze data, drive operational improvements, and make a significant impact at our mid-sized entrepreneurial organization. He/she will have strong attention to detail, be intellectually curious, driven to succeed, and a great communicator and will work closely with the leadership.




Hours of operation will be 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Candidates located within the GTA will work on‑site Monday to Friday. Candidates outside the GTA/ Moncton location will work remotely. Travel within Canada will occur 1–2 times per year. For those outside the GTA, 1–2 weeks of on‑site training will be required at one of our branch locations.




Responsibilities:

Analyze data and provide recommendations to help respond to Request For Quotes (“RFQs”) for pricing new and existing customers.
Ad hoc financial analysis by analyzing operational and financial data to support the management team.
Proactively suggest recommendations that will drive profitable growth based on your review of Vortex’s financial and operational data.
Develop an understanding of Vortex’s operational processes and IT systems, with an eye to identifying opportunities to document and streamline tasks in a new ERP
Assist with due diligence on competitors, customers, and suppliers related to acquisitions, sales expansion strategies, and new strategic initiatives.
Collaborate across the organization to assist with project plans and timelines for new initiatives being rolled out across the organization by the leadership.
We are a hands-on, team-focused company.
Participates confidently in meetings at all levels and supports tasks of any scope, contributing wherever needed to help the team succeed.




Qualifications:

1-3 years of experience in pricing, financial analysis, consulting or accounting.
Completion of an economics, math, business or engineering degree.
Experience in entrepreneurial organizations (can be professional experience, side hustles ,or volunteer experience).
Intermediate to advanced knowledge of MS Excel. Competency with Word, PowerPoint and Gmail.
Experience with Truckmate or Excel, Power BI an asset, but not required.
Proactive desire to learn, explore new ideas, and seek information that enhances decision‑making and continuous improvement.
Shows strong perseverance and determination, consistently following through on tasks and overcoming challenges to achieve results.
Experience with additional data analytics tools an asset, but not required.
Exceptional work ethic and ability to work as a self-starter.
Excellent verbal and written communications.
A competitive person who enjoys winning as part of a team.
A committed team player with a complete absence of politics.
History of participation in and/or leadership of team sports a significant plus.




This posting is for a new vacancy. We are actively reviewing resumes for this open role.

Grow into a leader in the finance / pricing organization at Vortex, or with other affiliated companies.

Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement within the company.

Dynamic and collaborative team environment.
Make a direct impact on the company's growth and success.

Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.


The salary range for this position is $60,000-$90,000. The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation for this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

Title: Pricing Analyst/Strategist
Description:
Position Overview

We’re looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Pricing Specialist to help shape and execute our pricing strategy across Canada and the U.S. This is not a role for someone who simply maintains price lists. We’re looking for someone who is curious about why a product should be priced a certain way, how pricing impacts customer behaviour, margin and revenue, and how different pricing strategies should work across channels and markets.




You’ll work across our ecommerce business, sales channels and internal systems to help ensure our pricing is competitive, commercially sound and designed to maximise revenue and profitability.

This role is ideal for someone who loves data, enjoys solving puzzles and is comfortable moving between strategy and execution. One day you may be analysing competitor pricing and identifying opportunities across thousands of products; the next, you may be digging into ecommerce pricing logic, investigating why a price is displaying incorrectly or helping design a new pricing rule.




Key Responsibilities and How You’ll Make an Impact

Help develop and execute pricing strategy across our Canadian and U.S. businesses
Analyse pricing performance across products, categories, brands, customer segments and sales channels
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, margin, conversion and overall competitiveness
Monitor competitor pricing and market dynamics to understand where we are positioned and where opportunities exist
Develop pricing recommendations based on customer behaviour, competitive data, product economics and business objectives
Explore and refine ecommerce pricing logic, including how prices, promotions, discounts and customer-specific pricing are displayed online
Analyse price elasticity and test new pricing approaches and measure their impact
Work directly within internal systems and pricing tools to implement, test and troubleshoot pricing changes
Investigate pricing discrepancies and determine the root cause across systems, data feeds and ecommerce platforms
Build and maintain pricing rules, guardrails and processes that allow the business to make faster, smarter pricing decisions
Evaluate promotional pricing and discount strategies to understand their impact on revenue and profitability
Partner with Marketing, Sales, Purchasing, Finance, Data, Ecommerce and Technology teams on pricing initiatives
Analyse large datasets to uncover patterns, anomalies and opportunities that may not be immediately obvious
Partner with the Data team on reporting and dashboards that make pricing performance and opportunities easy to understand
Continuously look for opportunities to automate, improve and scale how pricing decisions are made across the organisation




What We’re Looking For

A highly analytical thinker who genuinely enjoys working with numbers and solving complex problems
Someone who is naturally curious and likes asking “Why is this happening?” and “How could we make this better?”
Strong commercial instincts and an understanding of how pricing influences revenue, profitability and customer behaviour
Comfortable working at both the strategic and executional level
Experience with SQL, Python, pricing automation or data visualisation tools is mandatory
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience working with large datasets is important
Experience with BI, analytics, ERP, ecommerce or pricing platforms is an asset
Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with large product catalogues and complex pricing structures
Ability to take an ambiguous business problem, dig into the data and develop a clear recommendation
Comfortable collaborating across multiple departments and translating analysis into practical business decisions
Experience in ecommerce, distribution, retail, B2B or another high-SKU environment would be particularly valuable




You’ll Love This Role If You...

Love finding patterns in data.
Get satisfaction from figuring out why something doesn’t make sense.
Think of a complicated pricing problem as a puzzle you want to solve.
Enjoy testing hypotheses rather than accepting “that’s how we’ve always done it.”
Can think strategically but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and getting into the system.
And like the idea of having a direct impact on how a growing North American business makes one of its most important commercial decisions: what we charge.

Title: Data Scientist, International
Description:
About the Team

The Analytics team is looking for Data Analysts and Data Scientists to guide measurement, strategy, and tactical decision-making using Advanced Analytics approaches, as we expand our logistics platform across the globe. Data Scientists at DoorDash work to uncover insights and turn them into actionable recommendations, helping drive decisions for the entire organisation. Analytics is very integral to all operational areas at DoorDash.

About the Role

Data Science at DoorDash involves diving deeper into our data to solve crucial business problems, ideate & run experiments to solve for insights gleaned from this deep dive and work with a cross-functional team to drive real-world operational change. It is NOT just about building Machine Learning models and putting them into production. This is a rare operational and actionable data-driven experience.

We solve many exciting challenges from all three sides of our marketplace including customer acquisition, balancing supply and demand, fraud and support, marketing, marketplace efficiency, and more. If you enjoy finding patterns amidst chaos, are excited to build a market from 0 to 1, and have experience using analytics to affect revenue, growth, operations or beyond, we're looking for someone like you!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Be a first-class thought partner to our product, business, finance and executive teams and help them make decisions on what's next for DoorDash
Use quantitative analysis and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand what drives our business
Build full-cycle analytics experiments, reports, and dashboards using SQL, Python, R, or other scripting and statistical tools
Produce recommendations and use statistical techniques and hypothesis testing and other experimentation techniques to validate your findings
Provide insights to enable our cross-functional team to understand marketplace dynamics, user behaviours, and long-term trends
Identify and measure levers to help move essential metrics and make recommendations
Possess excellent stakeholder management skills, know how to effectively collaborate well with strategy, operations, product, finance and engineering and set priorities
Be excited to travel to meet with business partners and the teams in each market


We're excited about you because…


3+ years of experience in data analytics, consulting, or related role
The insight to take ambiguous problems and solve them in a structured, hypothesis-driven, data-supported way
The determination to initiate and lead/own strategic projects to completion with a cross-functional team
Experience working with experimentation techniques (A/B testing, Causal Inference) and interpreting hypothesis testing
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, R,...)
Expertise with SQL queries, ETLs, etc…
Proficiency in one or more analytics & visualization tools
Experience building and training statistical and machine learning models (classifiers, regression models...)

Title: Data Solutions Engineer
Description:
Location: Brampton, ON (Head Office) – Onsite

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: IT & Data Analytics

Salary Range: $85,000 to $105,000 (compensation is based on experience)




Competitive compensation, annual performance bonus, comprehensive benefits, RRSP matching, paid vacation, and professional development opportunities.




Build solutions that make a real business impact.

 

At Weston Forest, we're looking for someone who enjoys solving business problems with technology.




This isn't a traditional Power BI developer role. It isn't just software development or data science.

We're looking for a well-rounded Data Solutions Engineer who enjoys partnering directly with business users to understand how they work, identify opportunities for improvement, and build practical technology solutions that make their jobs easier.




One day you might be designing an interactive dashboard for Sales. The next you could be developing an internal application to automate a manual process, improving data pipelines for Operations, or building reporting tools that help leaders make better business decisions.




If you're energized by variety, enjoy working across different business functions, and like seeing your work make an immediate impact, we'd love to hear from you.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 

As part of Weston Forest's Data Analytics team, you'll work closely with leaders across Sales, Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, Credit, and other business areas to design and deliver innovative analytics and business solutions.

 

No two days are exactly alike. You'll have the opportunity to work on a wide variety of projects spanning analytics, application development, automation, business intelligence, and emerging technologies.

 

Your responsibilities will include:




Partnering with business stakeholders to understand challenges, gather requirements, and recommend practical technology solutions
Collaborate on the design and solution architecture of business, application, and data solutions, leveraging existing platforms, standards, and best practices to deliver consistent, scalable solutions.
Designing and developing intuitive business applications, dashboards, portals, and reporting solutions that present complex information in a clear, visually compelling manner, enabling faster and more informed business decisions.
Building automation tools that eliminate manual processes and improve productivity
Developing analytics solutions using SQL, Power BI, Python, and other technologies
Creating and maintaining reliable data integrations, reporting datasets, and semantic models
Supporting enterprise reporting, business intelligence, and data governance initiatives
Evaluating emerging technologies such as AI and machine learning where they provide measurable business value
Participating in solution design, testing, deployment, documentation, user training, and ongoing support
Continuously improving existing analytics and business solutions across the organization

 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT:

 

Unlike many analytics positions, this role isn't limited to building reports or maintaining dashboards.

 

You'll have the opportunity to work across the full solution lifecycle—from understanding business challenges and gathering requirements to designing applications, developing automation, integrating data, creating analytics, and supporting users after implementation.

 

This is an opportunity to become a trusted technology partner to business leaders while helping shape Weston Forest's digital transformation and analytics strategy.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 

We're interested in curious people who enjoy learning, solving problems, and building practical business solutions.

 

You'll likely be successful if you have:




A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or a related field
Three (3) or more years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, software development, data engineering, or a similar role
Strong SQL, Python, Microsoft Excel (including Power Query), and Power BI skills.
Experience designing and developing dashboards, business applications, and reporting solutions.
Experience with APIs, system integrations, and Git or other source control systems.
Experience with ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, and data warehousing.
Experience working directly with business users to gather requirements and deliver practical technology solutions
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
A passion for continuous improvement and delivering practical business solutions that create measurable value

 

NICE TO HAVE:

 

Experience with any of the following would be considered an asset:




· Experience applying AI technologies to practical business problems.

· Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.

· Experience with web technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

 

Don't meet every qualification? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're looking for someone with the right mindset, curiosity, and problem-solving ability—not just someone who checks every box.

 

WHY JOIN WESTON FOREST?

 

At Weston Forest, technology isn't just a support function—it's an enabler of business transformation.

 

You'll join a small, collaborative Data Analytics team that works closely with business leaders across the organization. Rather than being assigned a narrow area of responsibility, you'll have the opportunity to contribute across a broad range of initiatives, helping shape how analytics, automation, and technology are used throughout the business.

 

Working directly with leaders across Sales, Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, Credit, and other business functions, you'll build solutions that improve business processes, enhance decision-making, and create measurable value.

 

You'll enjoy:




Meaningful work with visible business impact
Direct collaboration with decision-makers across the organization
The opportunity to build applications, automation, analytics, and reporting solutions—not just dashboards
Exposure to a wide variety of business challenges, technologies, and projects
A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture that encourages innovation and continuous improvement
Real autonomy, ownership, and opportunities for professional growth

 

If you're someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and seeing your work make a difference, you'll fit right in.

 

Weston Forest – “You’ll Love Doing Business with Us”

 

WHO WE ARE:

 

Weston Forest is more than a distributor and remanufacturer of wood products—we're a trusted partner committed to empowering our customers' success.

 

Since 1953, we've grown from a family-owned business into one of North America's leading distributors of industrial wood products, panel products, custom packaging, and supply chain solutions. Every day, we help our customers Build, Package, and Deliver through innovative products, value-added services, and technology-driven solutions.

 

Our success is built on long-term partnerships, entrepreneurial thinking, and a commitment to continuous improvement. We're proud to be recognized as:

 

One of Canada's Best Managed Companies
A Great Place to Work®
Recipient of Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures Award
Canadian Business Excellence Award for Private Businesses recipient

 

At Weston Forest, we're investing in technology, analytics, and digital transformation to support the future of our business—and we're looking for talented people who want to help shape that future.

 

OUR CULTURE:

 

Our values guide everything we do.

 

People & Safety – Results matter, but people matter more.
Entrepreneurial Spirit – We continuously improve and embrace innovation.
Integrity – We do what we say.
Growth – We inspire personal and professional development.
Partnership – Your success is our success.
Community – More than just a place to work.

 

Our vision is simple: to be the right partner for our employees, customers, and suppliers.

 

READY TO JOIN US?

 

If you're passionate about solving business problems with technology and enjoy building practical, user-focused solutions that make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

 

Apply today and help shape the future of analytics, automation, and business technology at Weston Forest.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

 

Weston Forest is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please advise Human Resources. Any information received relating to accommodation will be treated confidentially.

Title: People Analytics & Automation Specialist
Description:
About Opendoor

At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one. Homeownership matters. It's how people build wealth, stability, and community. It's how families put down roots, how neighborhoods strengthen, how the future gets built. We're building the modern system of homeownership giving people the freedom to buy and sell on their own terms. We’ve built an end-to-end online experience that has already helped thousands of people and we’re just getting started.

About The Role

Opendoor's People team is scaling how we use data and AI to drive compensation strategy, recruiting operations, and overall HR decision-making. We are looking for a hands-on People Analytics & Automation Specialist to help us bridge the gap between complex data and strategic action.

This role prioritizes hands-on AI capability. We are looking for someone who has built agents and automations. Alongside that, a strong data mindset, the ability to handle confidential projects with high discretion, and a growth orientation. Compensation experience is not required, and we are open to candidates from diverse analytical backgrounds who are eager to learn it.

What You'll Do


AI Agents & Enablement: Design, build, and ship agents and AI-driven workflows for compensation and People Operations. Job evaluation support, offer recommendation modelling, market data analysis, comp cycle preparation.
Dashboards & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for People Operations / Total Rewards (headcount, leveling, compensation analytics) and, where it overlaps, for Talent Acquisition (open requisitions, recruiting funnel and conversion), so leadership has current, trustworthy data ahead of every planning cycle.
Compensation & Leveling: Own the execution side of compensation and leveling projects, comp benchmarking, market studies, leveling structures, and equity or compensation scenario planning, using an established methodology.
Process Automation: Automate recurring People Operations work that currently eats up disproportionate time, equity grant approvals, comp cycle prep, headcount tracking, and other reporting that shouldn't take as long as it does.
TA Analytics Support: Act as a dotted-line analytics partner to Ariana and Talent Acquisition, helping surface insights like compensation-related offer rejections or band placement of recent hires, and supporting the TA team's own data storytelling when priorities overlap.
Systems & Data Quality: Work alongside the Rippling/HRIS administrator to build automations on top of Rippling, and help close data-quality and integration gaps as the team's data infrastructure matures.
Data Storytelling: Translate raw people and compensation data into clear, decision-ready narratives for leadership. This is as much a storytelling role as a data-building one.
Proactive Planning: Get ahead of the calendar by building and testing the automations and dashboards needed for major HR cycles (the upcoming mid-year comp review, annual market study, open enrollment) before they're needed, rather than under pressure.


What You'll Need


You have designed and shipped an AI agent or automated workflow that other people actually use. We will ask you to walk through it in detail: what you built, where you placed human approval gates, what you iterated on, and what broke.
A genuine data mindset and growth orientation. Backgrounds in analytical functions that involve sensitive or complex data are all strong fits.
High discretion and sound judgment. This role regularly touches confidential compensation and people data, and experience managing confidential projects (financial, M&A, or similar) is more important than a specific comp title.
Strong data storytelling and communication skills, able to turn a data set into a clear, persuasive point for an executive audience.
Comfort with Google Sheets (our primary working tool for comp data) and general data/BI fluency; SQL or Snowflake experience is a plus as we build toward more automated data infrastructure, but not required today.
Familiarity with an HRIS (Rippling or similar), comp survey platforms (AON Radford, Mercer, or similar), and equity administration tools (Equity Edge or similar) is a strong plus, not a requirement, and can be learned on the job.
Ability to work independently across two sets of priorities (People Operations/Total Rewards as the primary focus, with lighter-touch support to Talent Acquisition) and to prioritize when demands compete.


Location

This role is based in one of our offices, in-person four days per week. We're looking for candidates who are enthusiastic about an in-office culture; people who want to build alongside their teammates, not from a distance.

Title: GIS and Data Visualization Specialist
Description:
Job Details

Permanent Full Time (CUPE 1329)




Posting Status

Open to all current Town of Oakville employees and external applicants




Closing Date

Applications for this position must be received at by no later than 11:59 p.m. on September 17, 2026.




This job posting is for an existing vacancy and therefore will be filled accordingly.




Reporting to the Supervisor, Spatial Solutions, the GIS and Data Visualization Specialist provides expertise and technical guidance in the planning, design, development, testing, implementation, maintenance, review, and management of enterprise geospatial solutions, dashboards, visualizations, and data products. The position translates business and service requirements into clear, accurate, user-centered decision-support tools; establishes and sustains supporting processes, policies, procedures, technologies, and visualization standards; and advances the Town’s Enterprise Data Management Strategy through consistent, trusted, and well-governed use of spatial and analytical data. Key responsibilities also include requirements gathering, system testing, quality assurance, data governance, cross-departmental integration, continuous improvement, and long-term planning aligned with enterprise technology capabilities and business needs.




Job Responsibilities

Dashboard & Visualization Design and Delivery

Title: Analyst, Walmart Services – Insights & Reporting (WFS)
Description:
Position Summary...The Analyst, Insights & Reporting will support the Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) Account Management team by generating data-driven insights and identifying opportunities the team can act on to grow seller adoption, performance, and program participation. This role will also partner closely with Campaigns & Events teams to ensure WFS-enrolled items are properly featured, in-stock, and positioned for success across all major campaigns and seasonal events throughout the year. The ideal candidate is analytically curious, comfortable working across dashboards and datasets, and confident using AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, and reporting.

What You'll Do...


Generate actionable insights and opportunity recommendations for the WFS Account Management team, surfacing seller-level trends, program gaps, and growth levers they can act on directly.
Partner with Account Management to translate insights into prioritized outreach lists, program enrollment targets, and seller engagement strategies.
Collaborate with Campaigns & Events teams to plan ahead of the annual events calendar, ensuring WFS-enrolled items are adequately featured, represented, and inventory-ready for every major campaign and seasonal moment throughout the year.
Monitor business performance and key metrics across WFS programs, proactively flagging trends, anomalies, and risks to relevant stakeholders before they become issues.
Support ad-hoc analysis requests from Account Management and cross-functional partners, turning raw data into clear, actionable narratives and recommendations.
Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify emerging opportunities for WFS sellers and surface them to Account Management.
Assist in preparing business reviews and presentations that summarize performance, insights, and recommended next steps for leadership and stakeholders.
Partner across Account Management, Campaigns & Events, Strategic Account Management, and Product teams to make sure WFS priorities are represented in planning calendars and event roadmaps.
Leverage AI tools to support research, analysis, automation, and day-to-day productivity.


Qualifications


1-3 years of experience in account management, analytics, business operations, insights, or account/program support, preferably within retail, CPG, 3PL, logistics, e-commerce, or marketplace environments.
University degree, MBA Preferred
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
Hands-on experience building or maintaining dashboards in Looker, Tableau, and/or Power BI.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SQL, R, and/or Python is a plus.
Comfortable leveraging AI tools to support research, analysis, automation, and productivity.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to work cross-functionally with Account Management, Campaigns & Events, and other partner teams.
Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent insight requests and stay ahead of a fast-moving events and campaigns calendar.


Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Demonstrates and encourages respect for others; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all; embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas, and experiences; supports workplaces where associated feel seen and connected through a culture of belonging, so all associates thrive and perform; contributes to an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work.

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Follows the law, our code of conduct and company policies, and encourages others to do the same; supports an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns; reinforces our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action; acts with accountability for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Is consistently humble, self-aware, honest, and transparent.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a broad perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions; supports innovation and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Implements and supports continuous improvements and willingly embraces new digital tools and ways of working.

The pay range for this position is $64,700.00 - $88,990.00. Pay will be determined based on relevant experience.

Become a Quality Management and Data Support Specialist with MPAC

The Municipal Property Assessment Corporation (MPAC) is made up of a team of experts who understand local communities and assess every property in Ontario. What we do provides the very foundation that municipalities use to base the property taxes needed to pay for the services we use every day.

Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Anti-Racism

MPAC is committed to Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Anti-Racism. We are taking important steps towards ensuring that all voices are respected, valued and being heard. MPAC is dedicated to fostering an environment where employees can bring their full, unique and authentic selves and are inspired to do their best work.

What makes you great for this role?

You are a detailed oriented individual who can monitor, validate, maintain and improve data quality within MPAC.

We Have


A team of highly skilled, dedicated, and collaborative staff
Leadership that supports you
An enterprise that embraces change
A work environment that has flexible work locations (including hybrid), hours of work and overall employee wellness support


You Have


Completion post-secondary (college or university) education
A minimum of 7 years progressively responsible experience in data management and analytics in a similar industry with a minimum 5 years’ experience in quality control
Proven experience in one or more statistical programming languages such as R, SAS, SPSS, etc.
Knowledge and experience with assessment terminology, policies and procedures
Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills
Strong time management and organizational skills to meet tight deadlines and integrate multiple work assignments
Proficient use of Microsoft suite applications: Word, Excel, PowerPoint


Nice To Have


Completion of post-secondary (college or university) education in: Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business Administration
Working toward or the completion of a property valuation designation AIMA, MIMA, AACI FRICS, and/or Data Governance related designation
Experience in at least one general programming and/or scripting language such as Java, Python, C++, SQL, etc; and proficient with GIS and visualization tools such as QGIS, ArcView, Qlikview, Tableau and PowerBI


What You Will Do


Promote efficient, accurate records, and effective information management across MPAC, to achieve data standardization, transparency and traceability
Perform enterprise data quality health checks and analysis, identifies and evaluates concerns in governing data and suggests observations and/or work edits enhancements to management
Maintain data integrity and improves data quality throughout the data lifecycle in the development of deliverables and ingestion of data into existing systems
Support corporate stakeholders in building a strong data governance foundation by evaluating data sets including data usability, consistency, readiness, security and integrity
Design and automates the development of control structures; and conducts periodic data reviews to identify data anomalies to mitigate corporate risks
Work in collaboration with IT and business stakeholders and data stewards on data issue management and identifies data inconsistencies, and evaluates risks
Lead efforts to develop scalable, innovative approaches to extracting, managing, analysing and interpreting historical data results to identify trends or patterns in complex data sets
Serve as core team member on corporate projects, participate as a subject matter expert, and provide support to ensure data governance framework compliance


Additional Information


Requisition ID: 3052
Existing Vacancy: Yes
Job Type: Union

Title: Power BI
Description:
About Us

Kumaran Systems: Engineering Future-Ready Transformations Since 1992, Kumaran Systems has been helping enterprises bridge the past and the future, reimagining legacy systems and embracing AI-led possibilities. With over 34 years of delivery excellence, we specialise in re-engineering core applications, driving cloud transformation, and building automation-first, GenAI-enabled ecosystems across the Banking and Financial Services, Insurance, Telecom, and Automotive sectors. We help organisations not just upgrade their systems but reimagine what’s possible.

Why Kumaran?

We blend engineering discipline with AI innovation, helping clients modernise with confidence, automate with clarity, and scale with purpose. Our global delivery model ensures agility, responsiveness, and seamless collaboration, with clients always at the heart of every engagement. At Kumaran, we don’t just solve problems, we engineer future-ready transformations.

Job Summary

Seeking an experienced Power BI Developer to design, develop, and maintain enterprise-level business intelligence and analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Power BI, ThoughtSpot, Databricks, Azure Cloud, SQL, and Alteryx, with experience transforming complex data into meaningful insights that support business decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and scorecards using Power BI.

Develop self-service analytics solutions leveraging ThoughtSpot for business users.

Build and optimize data pipelines using Azure Data Services and Databricks.

Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL/ELT) activities using Alteryx and SQL.

Create and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and data models.

Collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to gather reporting and analytics requirements.

Design scalable semantic models and implement best practices for Power BI datasets.

Monitor report performance and optimize dashboard responsiveness.

Ensure data quality, data governance, security, and compliance with banking standards.

Support production deployments, troubleshooting, and enhancements of BI solutions.

Translate business requirements into technical specifications and analytical solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

Strong experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling, Power BI Service).

Experience with ThoughtSpot for search-driven analytics and reporting.

Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud Services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Storage, and Azure SQL.

Strong proficiency in Databricks, Spark, and data engineering concepts.

Advanced knowledge of SQL for data analysis, reporting, and optimization.

Experience with Alteryx Designer for data preparation, transformation, and workflow automation.

Understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks and data warehousing concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in the Banking or Financial Services industry.

Knowledge of data governance, data security, and regulatory compliance.

Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Familiarity with enterprise reporting and analytics environments.

Understanding of cloud-based data architectures and big data platforms.

Key Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality solutions.

Experience Required

5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering.

3+ years of hands-on experience in Power BI development.

Experience with Databricks, Azure, SQL, ThoughtSpot, and Alteryx in enterprise environments.

Educational Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, or related field.

Relevant certifications in Microsoft Power BI, Azure, Databricks, or Alteryx are preferred.

Title: Analyst, Data Governance
Description:
What You Will Do


Data Governance Leadership: Support the development, implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and enforcement of data governance standards, policies, procedures, and controls to ensure adherence to privacy, compliance, risk, regulatory, and legal requirements. This includes AI Governance to ensure ethical use and compliance with regulatory standards for AI-driven processes.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with leadership, IT departments, business units, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk teams, data producers and consumers, and IT data platform teams to align on data governance goals and support the operationalization of a robust data governance framework.
Promote data literacy by developing materials and conducting training on best practices.
Policy Development: Assist in the creation and enforcement of data management policies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
Contribute to shaping the data governance accountabilities and operating model and enable data stewardship.
Data Quality Assurance: Contribute to the enhancement and implementation of robust data quality frameworks and conduct regular audits to maintain high data standards.
Support the development and evolution of data governance metrics and KPIs; monitor & measure the overall efficacy of the data governance program.
Proactively monitor data, metadata, and reference data to ensure quality across the CTB data lifecycle.
Implement and leverage data governance tools and platforms to enable capabilities; manage and maintain metadata and other data governance artifacts such as glossaries, classifications, and lineage.
Risk Management: Identify potential risks related to data governance and develop mitigation strategies.
Support data sharing and collaboration across teams and departments; ensure proper data access, usability, and monitoring of data sharing agreements.
Project Oversight: Contribute to large-scale data governance projects from inception to completion.
Stay updated on industry trends, standards, and regulatory requirements related to data governance; recommend appropriate modifications to existing policies and practices.


What You Bring


Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, or a related field.
Proven experience with corporate data environments supporting cross-functional governance.
Proficient in PL\SQL and confident working in a structured data environment.
Knowledge of business intelligence, modern data warehousing techniques, cloud solutions such as Azure or GCP.
Experience with ETL/ELT processes and modern integration frameworks like API and event streaming.
Experience in IBM Cloud Pak for Data and/or Databricks Unity Catalog.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Visio, PowerPoint, and Excel.
Expertise in creating/enforcing data governance policies to ensure data integrity, privacy, compliance, security.
Ability to work with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and Risk partners
Hands-on experience with data analysis, quality assessment, metadata management.
Excellent communication skills for presenting complex concepts to non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to problem-solve and handle ambiguity.
Effective stakeholder management; ability to build trusted relationships and influence decision-making.
Experience in process design/improvement initiatives and leveraging automation.
CDMP certification is an asset.


We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:


Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs
Performance incentives, Continuing Education Programs
Other perks to support your well-being
Career growth opportunities and product discounts


Our typical hiring range is between $53,000 and $88,000 Salary decisions are also dependent on other factors such as your experience, job-related knowledge, skills and competencies, market location, industry benchmarks, internal equity and other role-specific requirements.

Description:

At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful.

We’re a technology company building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.

We’re a data company helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.

And we’re an innovation company accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Values:

Driven Waybuilders. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.

Relentless Curiosity. We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.

Smart Risk-Taking. We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.

Fearless Ownership. We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.
 

We’re Looking For:

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Engineer who is solutions-oriented, proactive, and thrives in ambiguity. This individual will not simply respond to requests but will lead initiatives, identify opportunities, and use data to unlock business growth. You will play a key role in maintaining data flow across systems, building scalable data models, and partnering across teams to inform decision-making. The ideal candidate will have 2+ years of experience in Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing, with deep expertise in SQL, data pipelines, visualization tools, and cloud-based data architecture.

You Are:

Proactive. You take full ownership of your domain and drive action independently.

Insightful. You generate meaningful, data-driven insights that fuel decision-making.

Collaborative. You work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex problems and improve processes.

Technical. You have a strong command of data engineering, visualization, and analytical tools.

You Will:

Take ownership of the Business Intelligence domain, surfacing insights, solving problems, and driving data-driven decisions

Partner with stakeholders in product, sales, and operations to ensure data quality, availability, and effective usage

Manipulate and transform large datasets using SQL and scripting languages to generate impactful business insights

Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to optimize strategies

Apply data science fundamentals to build predictive models and trend analyses

Develop scalable data models, dashboards, and reports using tools such as Domo

Continuously improve data pipelines, infrastructure, and analytical capabilities

Mentor colleagues to enhance analytics capabilities and foster a data-driven culture

Who You Will Work With:

This role reports into the BI Manager and collaborates cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Operations, and Data Engineering teams. You will also work closely with senior leadership to support key strategic initiatives.

Must Have’s:

2+ years of experience in Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence

Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, SQL Server)

Strong experience in ETL/ELT development and data pipeline management

Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java, Scala)

Strong foundation in data modeling, governance, and structuring datasets for long-term use

Expertise in data visualization and dashboarding (Domo preferred)

Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel, Google Sheets)

Self-starter with strong problem-solving and strategic thinking capabilities
 

Nice to Have’s:

Experience working with DOMO specifically

Understanding of cloud-based data architectures and security best practices

Experience creating and implementing data governance strategies

Background in data science or machine learning application

Familiarity with API integrations and automation techniques


What We Offer:

Competitive pay

Title: Social Media Insights Analyst
Description:
Job Description:

ICUC is the global leader in Social Media solutions for over 20 years. To date, the ICUC team consists of over 350 people, in over 35 countries, covering 50 languages around the clock. In an environment where the only constant is change, we create common ground between brands and audiences across communities and social media. Fueled by a unique culture built in and around meritocracy, we bring the passion, the know-how and the balance necessary to maintain the charted course we set for ourselves: to be the best, we employ the best. Are you ready to be part of the ICUC team?

Position overview:

In the role of an Insights Analyst, you will be responsible for harnessing the power of social media data to translate complex insights into impactful narratives. You'll leverage your expertise in data storytelling to uncover how social media directly influences a business's brand performance. We seek a highly adaptable and results-oriented analyst who thrives in a fast-paced virtual environment. You'll possess a strong foundation in social media data analysis, coupled with a keen ability to learn new tools and methods to stay ahead of the curve. This role demands both independent initiative and collaborative spirit, as you'll work closely with the team to deliver actionable social media insights to our clients.

Responsibilities:


Proactively stay abreast of current and emerging trends, best practices, and relevant information pertaining to digital marketing.
Collect, compile, and format large datasets from diverse social media platforms and other sources, ensuring data integrity and adherence to established data governance protocols.
Develop comprehensive workbooks and other documentation to support your data analysis efforts. Leverage your advanced understanding of the data to extract actionable insights that generate tangible value for the client beyond basic reporting.
Craft compelling reports and presentations that effectively communicate your insights to the client. These deliverables should reflect the high quality of your work and uphold the ICUC brand image.
Participate in quality control initiatives, data management best practices, and workflow optimization efforts. Contribute to brainstorming and other initiatives designed to elevate the quality of ICUC Insights & Analytics.
Provide support for revenue and growth initiatives through ad-hoc requests that bolster the Insights department’s position and contribute to achieving strategic business goals.



KPIs:


Complete all assigned reports every month, ensuring 99% of deadlines are met, to deliver timely and relevant insights to clients and stakeholders.
Attend 95% of team meetings during the year, including any mandatory connects, to actively contribute insights, share knowledge, and foster collaboration within the team.
Successfully complete required learning courses from our internal hub to stay updated on company policies and requirements.
Identify and complete two relevant non-required learning courses per quarter to enhance expertise in data storytelling, advanced analytics techniques, or emerging social media platforms and technologies.
Maintain a 98% accuracy rate in all reports by proactively monitoring data discrepancies, investigating potential issues, and implementing timely solutions to ensure data integrity and consistency.
Implement one workflow optimization per quarter to streamline analysis processes, improve efficiency, and enhance the delivery of actionable insights.
Contribute to a minimum of two non-recurring requests per quarter aimed at supporting revenue growth and/or marketing initiatives



The ideal candidate will have:


Minimum 2 years of experience in social media analytics, with a demonstrably strong track record of utilizing social listening tools to generate valuable insights. Prior experience with quality assurance will be considered an asset.
Advanced proficiency in industry-standard social media analytics and listening tools such as Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Sprinklr, and Khoros.
Ability to effectively communicate complex social media data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A strong desire to contribute to a high-performing team environment, fostering open communication and collaboration to achieve shared goals.
Experience applying industry best practices to ensure data accuracy, analysis effectiveness, and report quality.
The ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently, ensuring adherence to established quality standards.
Proven ability to analyze complex data sets, identify trends and patterns, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
The ability to create clear, compelling, and visually appealing presentations and reports that effectively communicate data insights. Experience with graphic design is a plus.
Solid understanding of computer applications, spreadsheet software, and Microsoft Office Suite.
The ability to actively listen to client needs and project requirements to ensure alignment and deliver high-quality results.



Additional Requirements:


The ability to utilize a desktop computer or laptop that meets minimum system requirements, ensuring efficiency in remote work environments.
Access to high-speed internet, with a minimum speed of 30 mb/s, to support work activities and online collaboration.
Adequate headset/mic and webcam, facilitating clear and effective communication in virtual meetings and presentations.
Fluency in English, with the ability to speak and write clearly and persuasively. Proficiency in additional languages is considered an asset, reflecting the global nature of the role.



Additional information:

Vacancy: Is this posting for the purposes of filling an existing vacancy? Yes

The salary range for this position is CAD $63,000-75,000k. Actual salary within the salary range will be based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, knowledge, and skills. A range of medical, dental, RRSP, paid time off, and/or other benefits also are available to all permanent employees.

Title: Healthcare Research & Data Analyst
Description:
Clarivate provides advisory and management consulting services to industry leading and emerging pharmaceutical, biotechnology and MedTech companies. We combine deep domain expertise and data driven analysis to deliver relevant insights and customized, actionable solutions for our clients in the areas of new product planning, commercial strategy and pricing & market access.

We are seeking a Healthcare Research & Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will support high‑impact analytical and market insights projects by interpreting complex healthcare datasets, identifying key trends, and developing actionable recommendations for clients. You will collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams, engage directly with customers, and help deliver the trusted intelligence that enables our clients to accelerate innovation and improve patient outcomes.

About You – Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments


Bachelor’s degree with a concentration in sciences, healthcare, data analytics, or business.
Minimum 3 years of experience in quantitative data analysis, ideally with exposure to healthcare datasets.
Proven experience working with complex datasets, investigate data issues, identify trends/gaps, and produce actionable insights.
Proficient in SQL, with experience querying and managing large, multi-dimensional data sources.
Strong client-facing communication skills, including presenting data insights to internal and external stakeholders.


It would be great if you also have…


Advanced degree
Experience with life sciences customers
Familiarity with additional data languages (e.g., Python, R), which would help expand analytical capabilities and improve efficiency in working with complex healthcare datasets
Exposure to or experience with project management responsibilities, including planning, coordination, and stakeholder communication across cross-functional teams


What You Will Be Doing In This Role...


Lead end-to-end market research projects delivering quantitative insights on global medical device markets, while building market models using Clarivate’s proprietary healthcare datasets.
Develop deep expertise in healthcare data and the medical industry, building strong knowledge of backend datasets, data dictionaries, and product methodology to confidently interpret, explain, and apply insights.
Engage directly with clients—from Fortune 500 companies to startups—to understand their pain points, manage calls with high-level knowledge of their product portfolios, and provide strategic solutions that address their challenges.
Deliver impactful presentations and training, using concise PowerPoint summaries to clearly communicate findings, key trends, and recommendations to both internal and external stakeholders.
Investigate complex data challenges by deep-diving into data pipelines and sample chain perspectives, proactively identifying issues, highlighting gaps/trends, and proposing actionable solutions.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers and cross-functional teams, capturing client feedback, informing statement of work documentation, and contributing to product enhancements, features, and data model evolution.


Hours of Work


This is a full-time position, working primarily core business hours EST zone
This is a hybrid position working in the office up to 3 days a week within our offices centrally located in Toronto


The expected base salary for this position is $54,400 - $68,000 CAD per year. This role is eligible for sales incentive earnings. Individual pay is based upon experience, education, skill and ability, expertise, and relevant factors. In addition to a competitive remuneration package, you will be eligible to participate in a benefits package that includes medical, dental, prescription drug, life insurance, 401k with match, long term disability coverage, vacation, sick time, volunteer time, discount programs, and many more.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.
